https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/c.title: COP31: From Health Resilience to Energy Transition, Global Climate Commitments Face the Test of Delivery
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/c.summary: The first week of COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, was marked by renewed calls for climate action, major announcements on health resilience, clean energy and climate finance, and growing demands for stronger protection of vulnerable communities. From health resilience and clean energy to climate finance, urban adaptation and the protection of vulnerable communities, the first week has produced several initiatives and financial announcements.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/c.summary_zh: 在土耳其安塔利亚举行的COP31第一周以再次呼吁采取气候行动、推动卫生韧性、清洁能源和气候融资方面的重要宣布，以及要求加强对弱势社区保护的呼声为特点。从卫生韧性、清洁能源到气候融资、城市适应和弱势社区保护，第一周期间推出多项举措并公布多项资金安排。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/c.body: The first week of COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, was marked by renewed calls for climate action, major announcements on health resilience, clean energy and climate finance, and growing demands for stronger protection of vulnerable communities. With more than 100 world leaders in attendance, discussions exposed both the opportunities for international cooperation and persistent disagreements over fossil fuels, adaptation funding and the pace of the energy transition. While several initiatives and financial commitments emerged, the negotiations also revealed the difficult work ahead in turning climate promises into concrete outcomes. Chiemelie Ezeobi , who covered some of these events, reports Last week, precisely on November 9, 2026, nearly 200 countries arrived in Türkiye’s Mediterranean city of Antalya for COP31 with an ambition that has increasingly defined the climate debate: moving beyond declarations to concrete action. One week later, as the conference crosses its halfway mark, the gap between commitments and delivery remains a central challenge, with competing national interests, financing shortfalls and disagreements over the future of fossil fuels shaping the negotiations. From health resilience and clean energy to climate finance, urban adaptation and the protection of vulnerable communities, the first week has produced several initiatives and financial announcements. Yet, beneath the activity on the conference floor, difficult negotiations continue over how far countries are prepared to go and who should bear the cost of addressing the climate crisis. The opening of COP31 reflected the urgency of the moment as UN Climate Chief Simon Stiell warned that global progress remained nowhere near sufficient or fair enough, underscoring the need for countries to move from promises to measurable outcomes. So what happened on the first day? The first day placed food, agriculture and health at the centre of discussions, reflecting the growing recognition that climate change affects not only ecosystems but also food security and public health. Given that health is one of the 10 priority areas of the COP31 Action Agenda, and the Antalya Initiative for Health Resilience was launched to advance the issue. Countries were also urged to implement the Belém Health Action Plan agreed at COP30, reinforcing the need to translate existing commitments into stronger health systems and practical resilience measures. The conversation subsequently turned to energy, where the question of how quickly the world should move away from fossil fuels remains one of the most difficult issues in climate diplomacy. Brazil’s COP30 presidency launched a voluntary roadmap proposing an initial expansion of clean energy, followed by efforts to phase out coal, oil and gas after 2031. A proposal to welcome the roadmap appears in the draft cover decision, alongside an option supporting continued implementation of the energy transition agreement reached at COP28. Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva added political weight to the debate, telling civil society representatives that Brazil should host the third global conference on transitioning away from fossil fuels, potentially in 2028. The proposal has renewed attention on the pace and direction of the global energy transition, even as countries continue to differ over the language and commitments they are willing to accept. The arrival of more than 100 national leaders and UN Secretary-General António Guterres brought the climate justice debate into sharper focus. Guterres called for an agreement that would tax fossil fuel companies to help countries bearing the greatest burden of the climate crisis. His position reflects growing demands that those responsible for a significant share of emissions contribute more towards addressing the consequences of climate change. UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced Britain’s first special representative for climate security, while Nepal, Bhutan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan and Pakistan called for stronger protection of glaciers and mountain communities. The vulnerability of cities also received unprecedented attention during the Leaders’ Summit, which held its first high-level dialogue on urban resilience. With up to three billion people lacking adequate housing, cities require approximately $4.5 trillion in annual climate investment through 2030. Yet current financing covers only about a fifth of that requirement. Despite the funding challenge, 69 mayors representing more than 250 million people committed to another year of climate action, a 60 per cent increase on last year’s participation. The presidency also launched the Antalya Compact for Energy Efficient Buildings to promote improvements in building energy performance. Another major initiative is Türkiye’s 35-by-35 pledge, which seeks to increase electricity’s share of global final energy consumption from 23 per cent to 35 per cent by 2035. At least 14 countries, including Australia, Ethiopia, Germany, Norway, South Korea and Pakistan, have endorsed the pledge, with the European Union widely expected to follow. However, the initiative has exposed differences over the meaning of clean electrification. Although it seeks to expand electricity consumption, it does not specify how the electricity should be generated. Palau warned that electrification must not distract from phasing out fossil fuels, while Seychelles insisted that the initiative must be linked to cleaner sources of power. Saudi Arabia was openly sceptical, arguing that electrification would not necessarily reduce emissions if the source of electricity generation was ignored. To support implementation in developing countries, Türkiye and Ethiopia launched a finance coalition for clean electrification. If the first week demonstrated the breadth of climate ambitions, the discussions on finance exposed the difficulty of paying for them. Guterres warned that even tripling adaptation finance would meet less than 30 per cent of what is required. An assessment highlighted at COP31 also suggests that annual climate finance could fall $840 billion short of the $1.3 trillion goal if current trends continue. Some new commitments emerged. Development finance institutions from Britain, Norway and Canada plan to mobilise $10 billion for climate projects in emerging markets by 2030, while philanthropic organisations pledged more than $480 million towards methane and other potent greenhouse gases. Türkiye secured a $1.6 billion agreement with the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, while a new UN platform aims to unlock more than $3 billion to protect 75 million people from climate shocks by 2030. The Solomon Islands also became the first small island state to contribute to a Green Climate Fund replenishment, pledging $400,000. However, the funding picture remains uneven. At a pledging event for the Pacific Resilience Facility, developed countries largely re-announced existing commitments, leaving the facility approximately $300 million short of its $500 million target. The shortfall highlights the continuing difficulty vulnerable countries face in securing predictable financing, despite repeated international commitments to support climate adaptation and resilience. While public announcements have generated momentum, the formal negotiations remain more complicated. The draft cover decision is essentially a collection of proposals submitted by different countries, with some large developing countries pushing back against the document and sectoral targets. A heavily bracketed text on the Mitigation Work Programme remains under discussion, while a proposal for a new Just Transition Mechanism has attracted criticism over its limited scope. Adaptation finance is another major sticking point. African countries are demanding that funding be tripled to at least $120 billion annually by 2035, while one draft option proposes a review of the target adopted at COP30. Questions about the future structure of the climate conference process have also emerged. Arab states, Mexico, South Korea and Switzerland have proposed moving to biennial COP meetings. Meanwhile, arrangements for the 2028 conference are shifting following China’s decision to withdraw from hosting COP33. As COP31 enters its second week, Stiell has described progress as constructive, noting that negotiations started on time. A stocktaking plenary on Saturday night is expected to reveal countries’ initial red lines, as ministers arriving in Antalya take on the responsibility of resolving outstanding disagreements. A fuller draft decision is expected early next week. The final test for Antalya will not be the number of initiatives launched or the volume of commitments announced, but whether countries can turn them into an agreed political outcome before November 20. With the conference’s first week delivering a broad range of proposals but leaving major differences unresolved, the second week will be critical. For a summit that has placed delivery above declarations, the question is whether nearly 200 countries can find enough common ground to make that ambition a reality. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/c.body_zh:
第31届联合国气候变化大会在土耳其安塔利亚举行的第一周，重新响起了采取气候行动的呼声，各方就健康韧性、清洁能源和气候融资作出重要宣布，要求加强对脆弱社区保护的呼声也不断高涨。逾100位世界领导人与会，使各项讨论既展现了国际合作的机会，也暴露出各方在化石燃料、适应资金和能源转型速度方面持续存在的分歧。尽管多项倡议和资金承诺相继提出，谈判也揭示出将气候承诺转化为具体成果仍面临艰巨工作。报道其中部分活动的Chiemelie Ezeobi称，上周，也就是2026年11月9日，近200个国家抵达土耳其的地中海城市安塔利亚，参加第31届联合国气候变化大会，并带着一个日益界定气候辩论走向的雄心：超越宣言，采取具体行动。一周后，随着大会进入后半程，承诺与落实之间的差距仍是核心挑战，各国相互竞争的国家利益、资金缺口以及围绕化石燃料未来的分歧正在影响谈判。从健康韧性、清洁能源到气候融资、城市适应和脆弱社区保护，第一周达成了多项倡议并宣布了多项资金安排。然而，在会场各项活动热闹进行的同时，各国仍在艰难谈判，准备采取多大行动，以及谁应承担应对气候危机的成本。

第31届联合国气候变化大会开幕反映出当前的紧迫性。联合国气候问题负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔警告称，全球进展仍远未达到足够或公平的程度，凸显各国需要从承诺转向可衡量成果。那么，第一天发生了什么？

第一天把粮食、农业和健康置于讨论中心，反映出人们日益认识到，气候变化不仅影响生态系统，也影响粮食安全和公共卫生。鉴于健康是第31届联合国气候变化大会行动议程的10个优先领域之一，大会还启动了安塔利亚健康韧性倡议，以推动相关议题。各国还受到敦促，落实在第30届联合国气候变化大会上达成的《贝伦健康行动计划》，进一步强调需要把现有承诺转化为更健全的卫生系统和切实可行的韧性措施。

讨论随后转向能源，其中世界应多快摆脱化石燃料，仍是气候外交中最棘手的问题之一。巴西在担任第30届联合国气候变化大会主席国期间启动了一份自愿路线图，提出先扩大清洁能源规模，随后逐步在2031年后淘汰煤炭、石油和天然气。草案主席决定中出现了一项欢迎该路线图的提案，同时列有支持继续落实第28届联合国气候变化大会所达成能源转型协议的选择方案。巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦为这场讨论增添了政治分量。他对公民社会代表表示，巴西应主办第三届关于摆脱化石燃料的全球会议，时间可能定在2028年。这项提案再次引发对全球能源转型速度和方向的关注，而各国在愿意接受的措辞和承诺方面仍存在差异。

逾100位国家领导人和联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯抵达，使气候正义辩论更加聚焦。古特雷斯呼吁达成一项协议，对化石燃料企业征税，以帮助承担气候危机最重负担的国家。他的立场反映出，人们越来越要求对排放作出较大贡献者承担更多责任，以应对气候变化造成的后果。

英国首相安迪·伯纳姆宣布设立英国首个气候安全特别代表。与此同时，尼泊尔、不丹、吉尔吉斯斯坦、塔吉克斯坦和巴基斯坦呼吁加强冰川和山区社区的保护。

在领导人峰会期间，城市脆弱性也受到前所未有的关注，峰会首次就城市韧性举行高级别对话。鉴于多达30亿人口缺乏适当住房，城市到2030年每年需要约4.5万亿美元的气候投资。然而，当前提供的资金只能满足这一需求的约五分之一。尽管面临资金难题，代表逾2.5亿人口的69位市长承诺再开展一年气候行动，参与人数较上年增长60%。主席国还启动了《安塔利亚高效建筑契约》，以促进建筑能源绩效提升。

另一项重大倡议是土耳其的“35乘35”承诺，目标是把电力占全球终端能源消费的比例从23%提高到2035年的35%。包括澳大利亚、埃塞俄比亚、德国、挪威、韩国和巴基斯坦在内的至少14个国家已endorse该承诺，欧洲联盟预计也将跟进。然而，这项倡议暴露出各方对清洁电气化含义的理解差异。该倡议虽然旨在扩大电力消费，却没有说明电力应如何产生。帕劳警告，电气化不得分散人们淘汰化石燃料的注意力；塞舌尔则坚称，该倡议必须与更清洁的电力来源相联系。沙特阿拉伯公开表示怀疑，认为如果不考虑电力来源，电气化未必能减少排放。为支持发展中国家的落实工作，土耳其和埃塞俄比亚启动了一个清洁电气化融资联盟。

如果说第一周展现了气候雄心的广度，那么围绕资金的讨论则暴露了为这些雄心买单的困难。古特雷斯警告称，即使把适应资金增加到三倍，也只能满足所需资金的不到30%。第31届联合国气候变化大会上公布的一项评估还显示，如果当前趋势持续，年度气候资金可能比1.3万亿美元的目标短缺8400亿美元。

新的资金承诺陆续出现。英国、挪威和加拿大的开发金融机构计划到2030年为新兴市场气候项目动员100亿美元，慈善组织则承诺为甲烷及其他强效温室气体相关工作提供逾4.8亿美元。土耳其与亚洲基础设施投资银行达成了16亿美元协议，一项新的联合国平台则旨在筹措逾30亿美元，到2030年保护7500万人免受气候冲击。所罗门群岛还成为首个向绿色气候基金补充资金的小岛屿国家，承诺出资40万美元。

然而，资助格局仍不均衡。在太平洋韧性基金认捐活动上，发达国家大多重新宣布现有承诺，使该基金距离5亿美元目标仍短缺约3亿美元。这一资金缺口凸显出，尽管国际社会反复承诺支持气候适应和韧性，脆弱国家在获得可预测资金方面仍面临持续困难。

虽然公开宣布推动了进展，正式谈判却更加复杂。草案主席决定本质上汇集了不同国家提交的提案，一些大型发展中国家反对该文件和部门目标。有关减缓工作方案的文本仍有大量括注，尚在讨论之中；一项设立新的公正转型机制的提案则因范围有限而受到批评。

适应资金是另一个主要症结。非洲国家要求到2035年把资金增加到每年至少1200亿美元，即增至三倍，而一项草案选择方案提议审查在第30届联合国气候变化大会上通过的目标。有关气候大会进程未来结构的问题也已浮现。阿拉伯国家、墨西哥、韩国和瑞士提议把联合国气候变化大会改为每两年举行一次。与此同时，在中国决定退出第33届联合国气候变化大会主办方后，2028年大会的安排正在调整。

随着第31届联合国气候变化大会进入第二周，斯蒂尔称进展富有建设性，并指出谈判已按时开始。周六晚举行的盘点全体会议预计将揭示各国初步划定的红线，届时抵达安塔利亚的部长将承担解决悬而未决分歧的责任。更完整的决定草案预计于下周初出炉。

安塔利亚面临的最终考验，不是 launched了多少项倡议或宣布了多少资金承诺，而是各国能否在11月20日前把它们转化为各方认可的政治成果。大会第一周提出了广泛多项建议，却留下重大分歧未解，第二周将至关重要。对于一场把落实置于宣言之上的峰会，问题在于，近200个国家能否找到足够共同点，使这一雄心成为现实。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: President Lee Jae Myung has approved requests for parliamentary confirmation hearings for Justice Minister nominee Lee Yong-cheol and Ahn Duk-su, his pick to head the National Tax Service (NTS), the presidential office said Monday. Their confirmation hearings are expected to focus on their qualifications and policy positions on key government issues, including prosecution reform and tax administration. Lee Yong-cheol worked on prosecution reform while serving as senior presidential secretary for civil affairs and legal affairs under former President Roh Moo-hyun, who served from 2003 to 2008. Lee also served on the transition team after Lee Jae Myung was elected mayor of Seongnam, south of Seoul, in June 2010. Before his nomination, he headed the Defense Acquisition Program Administration (DAPA). Questions are expected to focus on allegations surrounding his role in the 2015 Daejang-dong development project, which was launched while Lee Jae Myung was mayor of Seongnam. Ahn is a career tax official with extensive experience in tax investigations and administration. He has headed the Seoul Regional Tax Office since July and previously oversaw investigations into companies suspected of tax evasion. As head of the NTS' Investigation Bureau, Ahn was recognized for cracking down on tax evasion involving stock market manipulation and other unfair trading practices that harmed retail investors. His hearing is expected to focus on his plans to promote tax fairness and strengthen efforts to combat tax evasion. The National Assembly is required to complete the hearings within 20 days of receiving the president's requests

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: MANILA — North Korea's nuclear weapons program is unlikely to feature prominently at an unprecedented summit among the leaders of the United States, China and Russia set to be held this week, though the gathering could provide a limited opening for renewed diplomatic contact between Washington and Pyongyang, U.S. experts said Monday. U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are scheduled to hold their first-ever trilateral summit Thursday in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, where nuclear arms reduction is expected to be discussed. Although Trump has previously expressed interest in meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong-un again, a U.S. administration official said last week that there are no plans for engagement with Pyongyang during the president's Asia trip. The White House has not responded to a Yonhap News Agency inquiry on whether North Korea will be discussed during the trilateral summit. Andrew Yeo, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, said North Korea's nuclear program is unlikely to be discussed at the summit, citing considerable differences between Washington and Moscow over Pyongyang's nuclear ambitions. "Any mention of nuclear arms reduction from the three leaders will be a generally worded and vague statement," Yeo told Yonhap News Agency. Ellen Kim, a senior fellow at the Korea Economic Institute of America (KEI), said the three leaders might briefly discuss North Korea behind closed doors, possibly at Trump's initiative, but other issues would likely take precedence. "However, nuclear arms control among the U.S., Russia and China, along with the war in Iran, will likely take priority at the meeting," she said. Scott Snyder, president and chief executive officer (CEO) of KEI, shared a similar assessment. "I doubt that North Korea's nuclear program will be accepted as a discussion topic among the three leaders," Snyder said. Despite the limited prospects for substantive discussions on North Korea, some suggest the summit could create an indirect opening for renewed diplomatic engagement between Trump and Kim. Yeo said the trilateral meeting itself would not have much bearing on a Trump-Kim meeting but noted that Kim may consider a future meeting with Trump if he views the trilateral gathering positively. Kim of KEI said the summit could, at best, help open diplomatic channels between Washington and Pyongyang, but is unlikely to lead directly to renewed engagement between Trump and the North Korean leader. "Xi and Putin could convey Trump's messages to Kim," she said. "But they may be reluctant to support U.S.-North Korea negotiations for fear of losing their influence over North Korea." Sydney Seiler, a former U.S. national intelligence officer for North Korea, suggested Xi and Putin could encourage Trump to continue reaching out to Pyongyang and consider incentives, including possible sanctions relief, without assuming a direct mediating role. "It is most unlikely that either Xi or Putin is interested in taking a more active role in mediating a U.S.-DPRK summit," Seiler said, referring to North Korea by its official name, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The experts generally dismissed comparisons between the upcoming summit and the 1945 Yalta Conference, where the U.S., Britain and the Soviet Union discussed the postwar international order without the participation of other countries directly affected by their decisions. Robert Rapson, a former acting U.S. ambassador to South Korea, described such comparisons as misleading and said major differences among the three countries would make meaningful agreements difficult. "Unlike Yalta, this meeting is not deciding the world order," Rapson said. "It's largely symbolic and performative, albeit not without some consequences." Despite expectations of limited substantive results, Rapson warned that U.S. allies, including South Korea, should closely monitor the discussions to ensure their security interests are not compromised. "As for allies and partners, including Seoul, they are somewhat out in the cold and will have to look to Trump's key senior advisers, to the extent possible, to keep them apprised of developments and to help ensure the president does not go off the rails with respect to their core interests," Rapson said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 专家称，朝鲜核问题不太可能在特朗普、习近平和普京峰会上占据突出位置
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 马尼拉消息：美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人定于本周举行的史无前例峰会不太可能重点讨论朝鲜核武计划，不过美国专家周一表示，这次会晤可能为华盛顿与平壤恢复外交接触提供有限机会。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京定于周四在中国深圳举行首次三方峰会，地点安排在亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会期间，届时预计将讨论削减核武的问题。尽管特朗普此前曾表示有兴趣再次会见朝鲜领导人金正恩，但美国政府官员上周表示，总统亚洲之行期间没有与平壤接触的计划。白宫尚未回应韩联社关于三方峰会是否会讨论朝鲜问题的询问。布鲁金斯学会高级研究员安德鲁·约表示，由于华盛顿与莫斯科对平壤核野心存在巨大分歧，朝鲜核计划不太可能在峰会上成为讨论议题。约对韩联社说：“三位领导人若提及削减核武，措辞通常会较为笼统和模糊。”美国韩国经济研究院（KEI）高级研究员艾伦·金表示，三位领导人可能会在闭门会议上简要讨论朝鲜问题，也可能是由特朗普主动提出，但其他议题很可能更受重视。她说：“不过，美国、俄罗斯和中国之间的核军备控制，以及伊朗战争，预计将在会议期间占据优先位置。”KEI总裁兼首席执行官斯科特·斯奈德也作出了类似评估。斯奈德说：“我怀疑朝鲜核计划会被列为三位领导人的讨论议题。”尽管就朝鲜问题展开实质性讨论的前景有限，但一些人认为，此次峰会可能为特朗普与金正恩恢复外交接触创造间接机会。约表示，三方会议本身不会对特朗普与金正恩会晤产生太大影响，但他指出，如果金正恩对三方峰会的评价积极，他可能会考虑未来与特朗普会面。KEI的金表示，峰会至多有助于打通华盛顿与平壤之间的外交渠道，但不太可能直接促成特朗普与朝鲜领导人恢复接触。她说：“习近平和普京可以向金正恩转达特朗普的信息。不过，他们可能不愿支持美朝谈判，因为他们担心会失去对朝鲜的影响力。”美国前朝鲜国家情报官员悉尼·塞勒认为，习近平和普京可以鼓励特朗普继续向平壤伸出手，并考虑提供激励措施，包括可能放松制裁，而无需承担直接斡旋的角色。塞勒在提及朝鲜官方名称“朝鲜民主主义人民共和国”时说：“习近平或普京都不太可能有意在促成美朝峰会方面扮演更积极的斡旋角色。”这些专家普遍否定将即将举行的峰会与1945年雅尔塔会议相提并论。在那次会议上，美国、英国和苏联讨论了战后国际秩序，而没有其他受其决定直接影响的国家参与。美国前驻韩国代办罗伯特·拉普森称，此类比较具有误导性，并表示三国之间的重大分歧将使达成有意义的协议十分困难。拉普森说：“与雅尔塔会议不同，这次会议并不是在决定世界秩序。它在很大程度上具有象征和表演性质，尽管并非毫无后果。”尽管预计实质成果有限，拉普森仍警告，美国的盟友和伙伴，包括韩国，应密切关注相关讨论，以确保自身安全利益不受损害。拉普森说：“至于包括首尔在内的盟友和伙伴，他们在某种程度上被冷落了，只能尽可能依靠特朗普的高级幕僚，让他们及时了解事态进展，并帮助确保总统不会在他们的核心利益方面偏离轨道。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 外交部周一表示，政府一直寻求重建其位于华盛顿的老旧使馆大楼，该项目预计耗资2646亿韩元（1.98亿美元），但相关资金申请尚未纳入明年的政府预算提案。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The foreign ministry said Monday that it has been seeking to reconstruct its aging embassy building in Washington in a project estimated to cost 264.6 billion won ($198 million), but its funding request has not yet been included in next year's government budget proposal. The ministry made the request to rebuild the building, which was erected in 1954, in 2023, last year and this year due to safety issues, limits to performing diplomatic activities in the aging facilities and concerns about the impact on the national image, it said. The budget subcommittee of the National Assembly's finance, economy, planning and budget committee did not discuss the embassy reconstruction issue in a recent budget deliberation session, an official at the legislature's foreign affairs committee said, a sign that the project could again fail to move forward this year. Major reconstruction projects for overseas diplomatic missions are funded through the finance ministry's state property management fund rather than the foreign ministry's general account budget. Thus the reconstruction issue falls under the jurisdiction of the Assembly's finance committee. In 1990, Korea bought the current embassy building from another country that used it as its military attache's office
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 在资金不确定的情况下，韩国寻求重建美国境内老旧大使馆
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 外交部周一表示，该部一直寻求重建其位于华盛顿、年久失修的大使馆大楼，项目估算耗资264.6亿韩元（1.98亿美元），但其资金申请尚未列入明年的政府预算提案。该部表示，由于安全问题、陈旧设施限制外交活动以及担忧影响国家形象，于去年和今年再次提出重建这栋建于1954年的大楼。国民议会财政、经济、规划和预算委员会的预算小组委员会在最近一次预算审议会议上没有讨论大使馆重建问题。议会外交事务委员会的一名官员称，这表明该项目今年可能再次无法推进。驻外外交机构的大型重建项目通过财政部的国家财产管理基金而非外交部的一般账户预算提供资金。因此，大使馆重建问题属于国民议会财政委员会的管辖范围。1990年，韩国从曾将现有使馆大楼用作武官办公室的另一国家手中买下该建筑

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Korea AeroSpace Administration jointly hosted the second Global New Space Forum at the Four Seasons Hotel Seoul on Monday, bringing together representatives of about 40 Korean companies and government officials from 18 countries and international organizations. Kwon Hyun-joon, deputy administrator of the Korea AeroSpace Administration, said the private-sector-led space era had made space a new arena for international cooperation.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 外交部与韩国航天航空管理局于周一首尔四季酒店联合主办第二届全球新太空论坛，汇聚了约40家韩国企业以及来自18个国家和国际组织的代表与政府官员。韩国航天航空管理局副局长权贤俊表示，由私营部门主导的太空时代已使太空成为国际合作的新舞台。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: Korea's space industry seeks to turn its growing technological capabilities into international business opportunities as government officials and industry representatives from 18 countries gather in Seoul for a forum focused on commercial space cooperation. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Korea AeroSpace Administration jointly hosted the second Global New Space Forum at the Four Seasons Hotel Seoul on Monday, bringing together representatives of about 40 Korean companies and government officials from 18 countries and international organizations. The gathering aims to connect Korean space companies with overseas agencies and identify opportunities for joint research, technology demonstrations and commercial partnerships. The forum follows the successful fifth launch of Korea's Nuri rocket in October and builds on diplomatic efforts to expand the country's international space network, the organizers said. Kim Jin-a, second vice foreign minister, said in a video address that the growing role of private companies in space exploration had created new diplomatic challenges involving technology cooperation, market access, safety and sustainability. She highlighted three priorities for space diplomacy: creating practical cooperation opportunities between governments and businesses, contributing to the development of international space rules and helping Korean companies enter overseas markets through diplomatic missions and global networks. Kwon Hyun-joon, deputy administrator of the Korea AeroSpace Administration, said the private-sector-led space era had made space a new arena for international cooperation. He called for strengthening Korea's position as a responsible partner in the global space community, accelerating international space exploration projects and building commercial space supply chains with trusted partners. Ibrahim Al Qasim, deputy director-general of the United Arab Emirates Space Agency, delivered the keynote address on the role of governments in encouraging private sector innovation and international cooperation. Two panel discussions examined how geopolitical changes are affecting space partnerships and what policies are needed to expand commercial cooperation. More than 70 one-on-one business-to-government meetings were arranged between Korean companies and overseas officials, offering opportunities to discuss specific projects. The organizers said they would continue supporting Korean companies through overseas business delegations, including planned visits to Mexico and Brazil in December. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 韩国寻求全球太空合作伙伴关系，私营部门发挥主导作用
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 韩国正力图将其不断增强的技术能力转化为国际商业机遇。18个国家政府官员和业界代表齐聚首尔，参加一场聚焦商业航天合作的论坛。外交部与韩国宇宙航空厅于周一首尔四季酒店联合主办第二届全球新空间论坛，汇集韩国约40家企业的代表、18个国家政府官员以及国际组织代表。此次会议旨在为韩国航天企业牵线海外机构，并寻找联合研究、技术示范和商业合作机会。主办方表示，此次论坛承接韩国“阿里三号”火箭于10月成功完成第五次发射，并延续了扩大韩国国际航天网络的外交努力。外交部次官金振娥在视频致辞中表示，私营企业在航天探索中的作用日益增强，带来了涉及技术合作、市场准入、安全和可持续发展的新外交挑战。她提出航天外交的三项重点：创造政府与企业之间务实合作机会，推动国际空间规则制定，并通过外交使团和全球网络帮助韩国企业进入海外市场。韩国宇宙航空厅副厅长权贤俊表示，由私营部门主导的航天时代使太空成为国际合作的新舞台。他呼吁加强韩国作为全球航天共同体负责任伙伴的地位，加快国际航天探索项目，并与值得信赖的合作伙伴共同构建商业航天供应链。阿拉伯联合酋长国航天局副局长易卜拉欣·卡西姆发表主旨演讲，探讨政府如何鼓励私营部门创新与国际合作。两场专题讨论分析了地缘政治变化如何影响航天伙伴关系，以及扩大商业合作需要哪些政策。活动还安排了70多场韩国企业与海外官员之间的一对一会谈，为讨论具体项目提供机会。主办方表示，将继续通过海外商务代表团支持韩国企业，其中包括计划于12月组织赴墨西哥和巴西的访问。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显周五在会见中国外交部长王毅时表示，朝鲜半岛和平符合韩国和中国的共同利益，并呼吁加强双边沟通，推动半岛局势发展。赵显在开场发言中说：“朝鲜半岛问题事关韩国的重大利益，半岛的和平与稳定符合两国共同利益。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun said Friday that peace on the Korean Peninsula serves the shared interests of South Korea and China during a meeting with his Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, calling for stronger bilateral communication to advance the situation on the peninsula. The ministerial talks took place in Beijing ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen next week, where President Lee Jae Myung and Chinese President Xi Jinping are expected to meet. "The Korean Peninsula issue is a vital interest for South Korea, and peace and stability on the peninsula serve the shared interests of both countries," Cho said in his opening remarks. "I hope the two countries will continue to strengthen strategic communication to make progress on the situation on the Korean Peninsula," he added, expressing hope that a meeting between the two leaders in Shenzhen would provide an opportunity to further develop their strategic cooperative partnership. Wang said bilateral relations had returned to a normal track following the leaders' reciprocal visits last year and early this year, stressing the need to maintain high-level exchanges and further develop their strategic partnership. Noting that bilateral trade is expected to reach a record high this year, he expressed hope that people-to-people exchanges would recover to around 10 million annually. With the two countries hosting the APEC summit consecutively, Wang called for joint efforts to promote regional development and prosperity, expressing hope that the upcoming summit would give fresh momentum to bilateral ties. South Korea hosted last year's APEC summit in the southeastern city of Gyeongju. At that time, the two ministers exchanged views on bilateral relations and Korean Peninsula issues, with Cho calling for Beijing to play a constructive role in bringing North Korea back to dialogue. Before departing for Beijing for a two-day visit earlier in the day, Cho said he and Xi planned to discuss issues that need to be coordinated ahead of the APEC summit, as well as North Korea-related matters, including the possibility of U.S.-North Korea talks. Other issues on the agenda include pending bilateral matters, such as ways to enhance economic and cultural exchanges and cooperation, as well as Chinese structures installed in the Yellow Sea. The talks come amid deepening ties between China and North Korea, following Xi's visit to Pyongyang in June and a series of high-level exchanges between the two countries. Wang accompanied Xi during his visit to the United States in August. He was also present during Kim's surprise visit to the Chinese border city of Dandong last month. Inter-Korean relations, however, remain frozen. Pyongyang defines ties with Seoul as those between two hostile states and has rejected the Lee Jae Myung administration's calls for dialogue. There has been speculation about a possible meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during Trump's trip to Asia for the APEC summit, as the U.S. president has expressed interest in resuming dialogue with Pyongyang. Asked whether he believes China is willing to mediate between Washington and Pyongyang, Cho expressed uncertainty over how actively Beijing might pursue such efforts. "I don't think there is much chance of China actively inviting (Kim) to the APEC summit for talks, but it is still too early to tell," the minister said. A South Korean presidential official said Thursday that a meeting between Trump and Kim on the sidelines of the APEC summit was unlikely, while noting that it was difficult to predict whether contact between the two leaders might take place before or after the summit
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 赵兑烈在会见王毅期间表示，朝半岛和平符合韩国与中国的共同利益
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显周五在会见中国 counterparts 王毅时表示，朝鲜半岛的和平符合韩国和中国的共同利益，并呼吁加强双边沟通，推动半岛局势发展。这场部长级会谈在北京举行，先于下周在深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会；韩国总统李在明和中国国家主席习近平预计将在峰会上会晤。赵显在开场发言中说：“朝鲜半岛问题是韩国的核心利益，半岛的和平稳定符合两国共同利益。我希望两国继续加强战略沟通，推动朝鲜半岛局势取得进展。”他还表示，希望两国领导人在深圳会晤能为进一步发展战略合作伙伴关系提供机会。王毅表示，在两国领导人去年及今年年初相互访问后，双边关系已回到正常轨道，并强调需要保持高层交往，进一步发展战略伙伴关系。他指出，预计今年双边贸易额将创历史新高，并希望民间交往恢复到每年约1000人次的水平。鉴于两国将连续主办APEC峰会，王毅呼吁共同努力，促进区域发展与繁荣，并希望即将举行的峰会为双边关系注入新的动力。韩国去年在东南部城市庆州主办了APEC峰会。当时，两国外长就双边关系和朝鲜半岛问题交换了意见，赵显呼吁北京在促使朝鲜重返对话方面发挥建设性作用。当天早些时候，在启程前往北京进行为期两天的访问之前，赵显表示，他与习近平计划讨论APEC峰会前需要协调的议题以及与朝鲜有关的事务，包括举行美朝会谈的可能性。议程中的其他议题还包括尚未解决的双边事务，例如加强经济文化交流与合作的办法，以及黄海上的中国设施。会谈是在中国与朝鲜关系日益密切的背景下举行的。此前，习近平于6月访问平壤，两国之间进行了一系列高层交往。8月习近平访问美国时，王毅陪同出访。上个月，朝鲜最高领导人金正恩突然访问中国边境城市丹东时，王毅也在场。然而，朝韩关系仍陷于僵局。平壤将首尔关系定义为两个敌对国家之间的关系，并拒绝李在明政府提出的对话倡议。随着美国总统唐纳德·特朗普赴亚洲出席APEC峰会，外界一直在猜测特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩可能会晤，因为这位美国总统已表示有兴趣恢复与平壤的对话。当被问及是否认为中国愿意在华盛顿与平壤之间进行调解时，赵显对北京会多积极地推进相关努力表示不确定。这位部长说：“我认为中国主动邀请（金正恩）参加APEC峰会会谈的可能性不大，但现在下结论还为时过早。”一名韩国总统府官员周四表示，特朗普与金正恩在APEC峰会期间会面的可能性不大，同时指出，难以预测两位领导人是否会在峰会前或峰会后进行接触

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.summary: When it came to making the score for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, the composers wanted to find something special to emphasize the Korean settings in parts of the video game. Jonathan Mayer, founder of video game music production company Spider Farm Productions, invited the Korean band JAMBINAI to work with composers Stephen Barton and Jason Graves. After seeing the official trailers and other videos available for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Lee evaluated highly the accuracy of the Korean settings.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.summary_zh: 在为《使命召唤：现代战争4》创作配乐时，作曲家们希望寻找一些独特元素，突出电子游戏部分场景中的韩国特色。电子游戏音乐制作公司Spider Farm Productions创始人乔纳森·梅耶邀请韩国乐队JAMBINAI与斯蒂芬·巴顿和杰森·格雷夫斯两位作曲家合作。李在观看《使命召唤：现代战争4》的官方预告片及其他可用视频后，高度评价了韩国场景设定的准确性。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.body: When it came to making the score for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, the composers wanted to find something special to emphasize the Korean settings in parts of the video game. The military first-person shooter, which has received global attention after being released by Activision on Oct. 23, centers on a military conflict that begins on the Korean Peninsula. Jonathan Mayer, founder of video game music production company Spider Farm Productions, invited the Korean band JAMBINAI to work with composers Stephen Barton and Jason Graves. "We wanted to include a lot of the traditional sounds of Korean music but in ways that felt woven into the fabric of the music rather than sprinkled on top," Mayer said. "The moment we heard JAMBINAI's music we all were super excited because we were hearing so many of the instruments we knew we wanted to explore being played in very modern, innovative and different ways than we were hearing elsewhere. We thought right away that their music, on its own, was already very cinematic and epic." JAMBINAI is a post-rock instrumental band that has developed a unique sound with its use of traditional Korean instruments, transcending binary distinctions between tradition and modernity, and East and West. "We have never viewed traditional instruments as tools limited to expressing a particular culture or identity, but rather as instruments that can be used freely in contemporary music," the band members said. "For this project, the production team respected our longstanding musical approach and gave us sufficient creative freedom. This allowed us to focus on the narrative and complex emotions within the work and create music in the way we do best." Three of the band's five members — Lee Il-woo (saenghwang, piri and taepyeongso), Kim Bo-mi (haegeum) and Sim Eun-yong (geomungo) — contributed musical arrangements and performances for the traditional Korean instrument parts on nine tracks of Barton and Graves' original score, including the main theme. "They weren't simply looking to use traditional Korean instruments as decorative elements to create a stereotypically Korean atmosphere," the band said. "Instead, they were genuinely interested in the music we had already created and the ways we use our instruments. They wanted to integrate that musical approach naturally into the score itself." The band members disclosed to The Korea Times that the collaboration was carried out under strict confidentiality, and they were given no information about the game's storyline or specific scenes during production. "We knew that Korea would be one of the settings, and since the game deals with modern warfare, we imagined that the story might involve North and South Korea," they said. They were provided with guide tracks and musical direction to understand the atmosphere and emotions each piece needed to convey. "Even without knowing the specific narrative, we were able to communicate clearly about the musical direction and approach the work in our own way," they said. The band members expressed satisfaction with the creative freedom they were given for this project, and their appreciation for how well the producers understood their music. "For once, we didn't have to explain what kind of band we are or prove that we don't fit into a particular category. That was a really refreshing experience," they said. "We never started the band with the intention of modernizing traditional Korean music or combining different genres. We've always created our own music using the instruments and musical experiences each of us brings to the band. Because we use traditional Korean instruments, our music has often been placed within particular genre or cultural categories. Sometimes, people seem more interested in which instruments we play than in the music we're actually making. What we appreciated most about this collaboration was that we didn't have to explain any of that." Of the three bandmates, Lee is the biggest gamer. He said he remembers playing the first Call of Duty game many years ago, and enjoyed how the game presented World War II from the perspectives of American, British and Soviet soldiers. After seeing the official trailers and other videos available for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Lee evaluated highly the accuracy of the Korean settings. He said the Korean urban environments felt more natural and authentic, and felt the game did a much better job in its portrayal than earlier projects, which he criticized for inaccurate portrayals of Korean settings, often mixing in visual elements associated with China, Japan or Southeast Asia. This project marks a big leap into a completely new creative environment for the band members, and gives them a chance to share their music with gamers around the world, who might never have encountered JAMBINAI otherwise. "What made this collaboration particularly meaningful wasn't simply being part of a globally successful game," they said. "It was the experience of having the music we've spent years developing understood and valued for what it is, and finding that it had a genuine place in someone else's creative vision." JAMBINAI has appeared at major international music festivals including Glastonbury in the United Kingdom, Coachella in the United States, Primavera Sound in Spain and Hellfest in France. Last year, the band also sold out a performance with the London Contemporary Orchestra at London's Barbican Centre. They are currently working on an album based on the music from "RED CLIFFS," a performance production that premiered earlier this year at the ARKO Arts Theater in Seoul, with plans to release the album next year. Several of their previously released tracks also appear in Abner Pastoll's film "Nervous," which premiered this summer
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.title_zh: 《使命召唤》吸纳JAMBINAI，为其评分增添韩国特色
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.body_zh:
为《使命召唤：现代战争4》制作配乐时，作曲者们希望找到一种特别的方式，突出电子游戏部分场景中的韩国背景。这款军事第一人称射击游戏由Activision于10月23日发行后获得全球关注，故事围绕一场始于朝鲜半岛的军事冲突展开。电子游戏音乐制作公司Spider Farm Productions创始人Jonathan Mayer邀请韩国乐队JAMBINAI与作曲家Stephen Barton和Jason Graves合作。Mayer说：“我们希望融入大量韩国传统音乐元素，但要让它们自然融入音乐的肌理，而不是生硬地添加在表面。我们第一次听到JAMBINAI的音乐时都非常兴奋，因为其中运用了许多我们一直想探索的乐器，而且演奏方式非常现代、创新，与我们以往听到的截然不同。我们立刻觉得，仅凭他们自身的音乐就已经很有电影感和史诗感。”

JAMBINAI是一支后摇器乐乐队，他们运用韩国传统乐器形成了独特的声音，超越了传统与现代、东方与西方之间的二元区分。乐队成员说：“我们从未把传统乐器视为只能表达特定文化或身份的工具，而认为它们可以在当代音乐中自由运用。在这个项目中，制作团队尊重我们长期坚持的音乐理念，并给予我们充分的创作自由。这使我们能够专注于作品中的叙事和复杂情感，并以自己最擅长的方式创作音乐。”

乐队五名成员中的三人——Lee Il-woo（筌篥、筙和太平簫）、Kim Bo-mi（奚琴）和Sim Eun-yong（Geomungo）——为Barton和Graves原创配乐中的九个曲目创作了韩国传统乐器部分的编曲并演奏，其中包括主主题曲。乐队说：“他们并不是只想把韩国传统乐器当作装饰元素，用来营造一种刻板印象式的韩国氛围。相反，他们真心关注我们已经创作的音乐，以及我们使用乐器的方式。他们希望把这种音乐理念自然地融入配乐本身。”

乐队成员向《韩国时报》透露，这次合作在严格保密的情况下进行，制作期间没有向他们提供任何有关游戏故事线或具体场景的信息。他们说：“我们知道韩国会是其中一个场景，而且由于这款游戏讲述现代战争，我们想象故事可能涉及朝鲜和韩国。”制作方为他们提供指导音轨和音乐方向，以帮助他们理解每首作品需要传达的氛围与情感。乐队成员说：“即使不了解具体叙事，我们也能够就音乐方向进行清晰沟通，并以自己的方式投入创作。”

乐队成员对项目给予的创作自由表示满意，也感谢制作方对其音乐的深刻理解。他们说：“这一次，我们不必解释自己是一支什么样的乐队，也不必证明自己不属于某个特定类别。这是一次非常耳目一新的体验。我们组建乐队时，从未打算让韩国传统音乐现代化，也不打算融合不同类型。我们始终利用每个人带到乐队中的乐器和音乐经历，创作自己的音乐。因为我们使用韩国传统乐器，我们的音乐经常被归入某个特定流派或文化类别。有时，人们似乎对我们演奏哪些乐器，比对我们实际创作的音乐更感兴趣。这次合作最让我们欣慰的是，我们不必解释这一切。”

这三名乐队成员中，Lee是最热衷电子游戏的人。他说，自己记得许多年前玩过第一代《使命召唤》，很喜欢这款游戏从美国、英国和苏联士兵的视角呈现第二次世界大战的方式。在观看《使命召唤：现代战争4》的官方预告片及其他公开视频后，Lee高度评价了游戏对韩国背景的准确呈现。他说，韩国城市环境显得更加自然和真实，游戏对韩国背景的刻画也比以往项目出色得多；他批评一些早期项目对韩国背景的描绘不准确，往往混入与中国、日本或东南亚有关的视觉元素。

这个项目标志着乐队成员迈入一个全新的创作环境，也让他们有机会与世界各地的玩家分享自己的音乐，而这些玩家原本可能永远不会接触JAMBINAI。乐队成员说：“让这次合作具有特殊意义的，并不只是参与一款全球成功的游戏。我们多年来精心打磨的音乐得到了理解，人们也认可它的价值，并发现它确实能在别人的创作构想中占有一席之地。这种经历对我们来说意义重大。”

JAMBINAI曾亮相多场重要国际音乐节，包括英国的格拉斯托伯里音乐节、美国科切拉音乐节、西班牙的Primavera Sound音乐节以及法国的Hellfest音乐节。去年，该乐队还与London Contemporary Orchestra在伦敦巴比肯艺术中心合作演出并售罄门票。他们目前正在制作一张以《RED CLIFFS》音乐为基础的专辑；该演出制作于今年早些时候在首尔ARKO Arts Theater首演，专辑计划于明年发行。该乐队此前发布的数首作品也被收录于Abner Pastoll执导的电影《Nervous》中，该片于今年夏季首映

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: Lee pledges to expand AI, cultural cooperation with ASEAN
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: MANILA — President Lee Jae Myung pledged to expand cooperation with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), an 11-member regional bloc, on artificial intelligence (AI) and cultural industries during the annual Korea-ASEAN summit in the Philippines, Monday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 马尼拉——星期一，在菲律宾举行的年度韩国—东盟峰会上，李在明总统承诺扩大与拥有11个成员国的地区组织东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）在人工智能和文化产业方面的合作。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: MANILA — President Lee Jae Myung pledged to expand cooperation with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), an 11-member regional bloc, on artificial intelligence (AI) and cultural industries during the annual Korea-ASEAN summit in the Philippines, Monday. “Korea will take the lead in ensuring that everyone benefits from advances in AI technology and that the cultural creativity of ASEAN’s young people leads to new opportunities,” Lee said in his keynote speech at the Philippine International Convention Center in Manila. The president proposed the two areas of cooperation as the next steps in advancing his Korea-ASEAN Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP) vision, saying the framework unveiled a year earlier is beginning to produce concrete results. The vision sets out three roles for Korea — a contributor to dreams and hope, a springboard for growth and innovation and a partner for peace and stability. It accordingly encompasses people-to-people exchanges, economic cooperation and joint responses to security challenges. “Building on these achievements, I would like to propose two new initiatives: the ASEAN-ROK AI Companionship Initiative and the ASEAN-ROK Cultural and Creative Industries Initiative,” Lee said, using the acronym for Korea’s official name, the Republic of Korea. He highlighted efforts to combat transnational crime, strengthen maritime safety and upgrade the Korea-ASEAN free trade agreement (FTA) as examples. Lee’s proposal last year for closer coordination between Korean police and ASEANAPOL, a regional police cooperation body, has developed into the first Korea-ASEAN police cooperation project. The initiative provides an additional safety network in a region visited by about 9 million Koreans annually. The anti-scam project includes working-group meetings, discussions on victim rescue operations, visits to national anti-scam centers and training. Participants are also discussing a database to strengthen their response to scam-related crimes. Coast guard cooperation has taken shape through the Korea-ASEAN Maritime Safety Academy, which offers training in maritime law enforcement, search and rescue and pollution response through courses in Korea and participating countries. “From cyberspace to the seas, Korea and ASEAN will work together to safeguard our peoples’ lives and security,” Lee said. Turning to trade, he welcomed the start of negotiations to upgrade the Korea-ASEAN FTA. “By proactively responding to the changing global trade environment, we will work toward achieving $300 billion in annual bilateral trade,” he said. The first formal negotiating round took place in June, followed by a second in Singapore from September to October. The talks seek to reflect changes in digital trade and supply chains. The president called for closer solidarity in the face of deepening geopolitical conflicts and economic uncertainty, emphasizing ASEAN’s growing importance to regional cooperation. “The greater the uncertainty in international affairs, the more important ASEAN’s role becomes as the focal point for regional cooperation,” he said. In that context, Lee reaffirmed Korea’s support for ASEAN Community Vision 2045, the bloc’s long-term blueprint for a people-centered, innovative, dynamic and resilient community. “It is not simply ASEAN’s goal,” he said. “It is the future Korea wants to build together.” Later in the day, Lee attended the Korea-Mekong summit, a forum bringing together Korea and five countries along the Mekong River — Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand and Vietnam — to promote regional development and address shared challenges, including transnational crime. Lee is visiting Manila through Tuesday for ASEAN-related summits as part of a four-day trip that will take him to Shenzhen, China, for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit Wednesday and Thursday. On Tuesday, he will attend the ASEAN Plus Three summit, bringing together leaders from ASEAN member countries, Korea, China and Japan, as well as the East Asia Summit, a broader forum for regional security and cooperation
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 李在明承诺扩大与东盟在人工智能和文化领域的合作
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 马尼拉——星期一，在菲律宾举行的年度韩国—东盟峰会上，李在明总统承诺扩大与东盟这一由11个成员国组成的地区组织的合作，重点推进人工智能和文化产业领域。韩国—东盟峰会期间，李在明总统在马尼拉菲律宾国际会议中心发表主旨演讲时说：“韩国将发挥带头作用，确保每个人都能从人工智能技术的进步中受益，让东盟青年的文化创造力带来新的机遇。”李总统提出将这两个合作领域作为推进韩国—东盟全面战略伙伴关系愿景的下一步措施，并表示，一年前公布的框架已开始取得具体成果。该愿景明确了韩国的三项角色——为梦想与希望作出贡献，为增长与创新充当跳板，以及成为和平与稳定的伙伴。因此，该愿景涵盖人文交流、经济合作以及共同应对安全挑战。李说：“在这些成果的基础上，我希望提出两项新倡议：东盟—韩国人工智能伙伴关系倡议，以及东盟—韩国文化与创意产业倡议。”他在讲话中使用了韩国正式国名“大韩民国”的简称。李列举了打击跨国犯罪、加强海上安全以及升级韩国—东盟自由贸易协定等努力作为例子。李去年提议加强韩国警方与东盟警察组织（ASEANAPOL）这一地区警察合作机构之间的协调，该提议现已发展为首个韩国—东盟警察合作项目。这项倡议为每年约有900万名韩国人到访的地区提供了一层额外的安全保障网络。反诈骗项目包括工作组会议、讨论受害者救援行动、访问各国反诈骗中心以及开展培训。参与方还在讨论建立一个数据库，以加强应对诈骗相关犯罪的能力。通过韩国—东盟海事安全学院，海警合作已逐步成形。该学院通过在韩国及参与国开设课程，提供海上执法、搜救和污染应对方面的培训。李说：“从网络空间到海洋，韩国和东盟将携手合作，维护我们人民的生命与安全。”谈到贸易问题时，他对启动升级韩国—东盟自由贸易协定的谈判表示欢迎。他说：“通过主动应对不断变化的全球贸易环境，我们将努力实现双边年贸易额达到3000亿美元。”首轮正式谈判于6月举行，随后于9月至10月在新加坡举行第二轮会谈。各方寻求在协定中体现数字贸易和供应链的变化。总统呼吁在地缘政治冲突加剧、经济不确定性加深的情况下加强团结，并强调东盟对地区合作日益重要。他说：“国际事务越不确定，东盟作为地区合作焦点的作用就越重要。”在此背景下，李重申韩国支持《东盟共同体愿景2045》，即该组织以人为本、富有创新、充满活力且具备韧性的共同体长期蓝图。他说：“这不仅仅是东盟的目标。它也是韩国希望与各方共同建设的未来。”当天稍晚，李出席了韩国—湄公河峰会。该论坛汇聚韩国和湄公河沿岸的五个国家——柬埔寨、老挝、缅甸、泰国和越南——旨在促进地区发展并应对包括跨国犯罪在内的共同挑战。李此次访问马尼拉将持续至星期二，参加与东盟有关的各项峰会。这也是他为期四天行程的一部分；星期三和星期四，他还将前往中国深圳出席亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会。星期二，他将参加东盟 Plus Three 峰会。该会议汇聚东盟成员国、韩国、中国和日本的领导人；此外，他还将参加东亚峰会这一更广泛的地区安全与合作论坛。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title: Seoul stocks dip over 3% on tech losses amid lingering Nvidia jitters
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary: South Korean stocks sank by more than 3 percent Monday as foreign investors sold tech shares amid lingering artificial intelligence (AI) boom concerns following the fallout at Nvidia. The decline extended Friday's losses amid uncertainty over the outlook for the global AI industry following the ouster of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, a key figure in driving the global AI boom.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary_zh: 星期一，韩国股市跌幅超过3%。在Nvidia风波之后，投资者仍担忧人工智能（AI）热潮降温，外国投资者抛售科技股。Nvidia首席执行官黄仁勋被免职后，全球人工智能行业前景仍存在不确定性，而他是推动全球人工智能热潮的关键人物；受此影响，股市跌幅进一步扩大至超过周五的跌幅。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: South Korean stocks sank by more than 3 percent Monday as foreign investors sold tech shares amid lingering artificial intelligence (AI) boom concerns following the fallout at Nvidia. The Korean won strengthened against the US dollar. The benchmark Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) lost 190.03 points, or 3.59 percent, to close at 5,100.5, extending its losses to a third session. The decline extended Friday's losses amid uncertainty over the outlook for the global AI industry following the ouster of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, a key figure in driving the global AI boom. Investor sentiment remained cautious ahead of Nvidia's earnings report and Anthropic's anticipated Nasdaq debut later this week, amid concerns that the high-profile listing could divert investment from other technology stocks. Trade volume was light at 209.27 million shares worth 15.8 trillion won ($11.8 billion), with decliners far outnumbering advancers 612 to 263. Foreigners and institutions sold a net 1.38 trillion won and 451.26 billion won, respectively, while individuals bought a net 1.34 trillion won. "The market came under pressure from persistent concerns over Nvidia, which weighed on semiconductor and other AI-related stocks, as investors awaited Nvidia's earnings report and Anthropic's planned listing later this week," said Kang Jin-hyuk, an analyst at Shinhan Securities. Top market cap Samsung Electronics fell 4.47 percent to 196,800 won, and chip giant SK hynix plunged 7.89 percent to 1.12 million won. Samsung Electro-Mechanics sank 8.19 percent to 785,000 won, and SK Square, the parent of SK hynix, tumbled 9.71 percent to 688,000 won. Leading automaker Hyundai Motor slipped 1.48 percent to 265,500 won. The Korean won was trading at 1,335.7 won against the US dollar as of 3:30 p.m., up 1.9 won from the previous session's close
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title_zh: 科技股 losses 导致首尔股市下跌逾3%，Nvidia不确定性持续
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body_zh: 韩国股市周一跌逾3%，在Nvidia风波余波之际，外国投资者持续担忧人工智能（AI）热潮降温，抛售科技股。韩国元兑美元走强。基准的韩国综合股价指数（KOSPI）下跌190.03点，跌幅3.59%，收于5,100.5点，连续第三个交易日下跌。Nvidia首席执行官黄仁勋被解职后，全球人工智能行业前景面临不确定性，周五的跌势延续。黄仁勋是推动全球人工智能热潮的关键人物。在Nvidia即将发布财报、Anthropic预计本周晚些时候在Nasdaq上市的背景下，投资者情绪依然谨慎；市场担心这一备受瞩目的上市可能吸引资金流向，从而令其他科技股失宠。成交清淡，成交额为158万亿韩元（$11.8 billion），共成交209.27 million股，下跌股以612对263大幅多于上涨股。外国投资者和机构分别净卖出1.38万亿韩元和451.26 billion韩元，个人投资者则净买入1.34万亿韩元。新韩证券分析师Kang Jin-hyuk表示：“在投资者等待Nvidia本周晚些时候发布财报和Anthropic上市之际，市场持续受到有关Nvidia的担忧和压力拖累，半导体及其他人工智能相关股票因此承压。”市值居首的Samsung Electronics下跌4.47%，报196,800韩元；芯片巨头SK hynix重挫7.89%，报1.12 million韩元。Samsung Electro-Mechanics下跌8.19%，报785,000韩元；SK hynix母公司SK Square暴跌9.71%，报688,000韩元。leading automaker Hyundai Motor下跌1.48%，报265,500韩元。截至下午3时30分，韩国元兑美元报1,335.7韩元，较前一交易日收盘价升值1.9韩元

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Democratic Party’s takeover of both chambers of the U.S. Congress will complicate pending negotiations between Seoul and Washington and Korea must step up efforts to explain its positions to U.S. lawmakers, said Rep. Hong Kee-won, vice chairman of the National Assembly’s Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee. Even though the two governments had already reached agreements on nuclear-powered submarines, uranium enrichment programs and investment in the U.S., Hong said the “situation has become more complex than when Republicans held the majority,” as advancing those initiatives requires congressional approval and legislation. “Previously, securing an agreement with the administration alone was enough, whereas now we must build a degree of consensus within Congress to move forward,” Hong said in an interview with The Korea Times on Wednesday. Hong, a two-term lawmaker with the ruling Democratic Party of Korea, previously served as a diplomat and presidential adviser specializing in China and trade. He was named vice chairman of the National Assembly committee on Aug. 11. His remarks came amid lingering friction in Seoul-Washington security and trade ties, ranging from delays in investment negotiations to restrictions on intelligence sharing about North Korea, with many expecting that the Democrats’ recent electoral victory may not necessarily benefit South Korea. Hong said uncertainty has grown on two fronts after Democratic governors-elect in Texas and Alaska took cautious positions. The first is a gas-fired power plant in Texas, selected as the first project under Korea’s $350 billion investment commitment under the joint fact sheet between the two countries. The plant is intended to supply electricity to data centers in the state. The second is the Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) pipeline project, which U.S. President Donald Trump has pressed Seoul to join. Unlike the Texas plant, the Alaska project has not been confirmed as part of the investment package; Seoul has made no commitment and is still reviewing its commercial viability. For Seoul, the electoral shift raises fresh doubts about commercial viability, which remains a point of contention between the two countries. “While the U.S. government needs to guarantee that offtake demand, the Texas power plant deal was made without such assurances. Now, with a Democratic governor-elect in Texas taking a cautious stance on data center expansion, uncertainty has grown over whether even the first project can be commercially viable and attract buyers for its electricity once the plant is built,” he said. Despite the differences, Hong said the alliance between Seoul and Washington remains “firm,” describing recent U.S. visa reviews and denials involving Korean lawmakers as individual cases resulting from stricter screening rather than a broader political signal. He called on Seoul to intensify its engagement with Washington to clear up misunderstandings and move negotiations forward. “Korea must step up outreach to Democratic lawmakers in the U.S. to build consensus. In particular, Seoul needs to reassure Congress that its nuclear-powered submarine and civilian uranium enrichment programs pose no proliferation risks,” he said, adding that Korean lawmakers should actively engage with their American counterparts through the Korea-U.S. Parliamentarians' Union, a group launched last year. On Coupang, the U.S.-headquartered e-commerce company whose treatment by Korean regulators has drawn criticism from some Republican politicians, Hong said claims of discrimination stem from a cultural misunderstanding. Insiders believe the dispute has weighed on pending bilateral negotiations. “Although Coupang is legally incorporated in the U.S., the vast majority of the South Korean public thinks of it as a Korean firm,” he said, as the company generates most of its revenue in Korea. “The claim that the company is being discriminated against or treated unfairly simply because it is a U.S. firm stems entirely from a misunderstanding rooted in cultural differences.” If anything, he added, Seoul may have extended more favorable treatment to U.S. companies on the basis of the alliance. “We hope the U.S. government and Congress will understand the matter in that context. Seoul is doing its best to explain its stance, but its lobbying power pales in comparison to Coupang’s, making it harder to get its message across and leading to misunderstandings.” Regarding Korea’s push to retake wartime operational control (OPCON) from the U.S., he said the transfer can take place without weakening allied readiness. "While the abstract nature of the conditions for the transfer leaves room for differing interpretations, the agreement on the transfer between Seoul and Washington remains firm … Even after OPCON is transferred, a Korean commander and a U.S. deputy commander will lead within the existing combined defense framework — ensuring the transition can move forward without weakening alliance readiness,” Hong said. He argued that Seoul should take responsibility for its own security rather than undermine its own defense posture by doubting its own capabilities. “Korea, a top-10 global economy and major defense power, must take responsibility for its own defense and strengthen its military readiness. So the argument that we cannot defend ourselves is simply unacceptable.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 得州民主党议员反对数据中心建设，可能给发电厂的商业可行性蒙上阴影
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 民主党接管了美国国会参众两院，这将使首尔与华盛顿之间正在进行的谈判更加复杂。韩国必须加强努力，向美国议员说明韩方立场。韩国国会外交统一委员会副委员长洪基元如此表示。尽管两国政府已就核动力潜艇、铀浓缩计划以及在美投资达成协议，但洪基元说，“如今的情况比共和党占多数时更加复杂”，因为推进这些举措需要获得国会批准并制定相关法律。洪基元周三接受《韩国时报》采访时说：“过去，只要与政府达成协议就够了；现在，我们必须争取国会在一定程度上形成共识，才能继续推进。”洪基元是执政的韩国民主党连续两届的议员，曾担任外交官和总统顾问，专长领域包括中国事务和贸易。他于8月11日被任命为韩国国会外交统一委员会副委员长。他说这番话之际，首尔与华盛顿在安全和贸易关系上仍存摩擦，问题从投资谈判延误到关于朝鲜的情报共享限制不等。许多人预计，民主党近期在选举中的胜利未必有利于韩国。洪基元说，得克萨斯州和阿拉斯加州当选的民主党州长采取谨慎立场后，局势在两个方面都增加了不确定性。第一是得克萨斯州一座燃气发电厂，该项目根据两国联合事实清单中被列为韩国3500亿美元投资承诺下的首个项目。该发电厂计划为该州的数据中心供电。第二是阿拉斯加州液化天然气（LNG）管道项目，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普一直敦促首尔加入。与得克萨斯州发电厂不同，阿拉斯加州项目尚未被确认为投资方案的一部分；首尔没有作出承诺，仍在评估其商业可行性。对首尔而言，选举格局的变化引发了对商业可行性的新疑虑，而这仍是两国争论的焦点。他说：“美国政府需要保障承购需求，但得克萨斯州发电厂交易达成时并没有此类保证。如今，得克萨斯州当选的民主党州长对扩大数据中心持谨慎态度，就连首个项目建成后在商业上是否可行、能否为其电力找到买家，也更充满不确定性。”尽管双方存在差异，洪基元说首尔与华盛顿之间的同盟关系仍然“稳固”，并称近期涉及韩国议员的美国签证审查和拒签个案，是更严格审查所导致的个别案例，而非更广泛的政治信号。他呼吁首尔加强与华盛顿的沟通，以消除误解、推动谈判取得进展。他说：“韩国必须加强与美国民主党议员的联络，以形成共识。尤其是，首尔需要向国会保证，其核动力潜艇和民用铀浓缩计划不会带来核扩散风险。”他还说，韩国议员应通过去年成立的美韩议员联盟积极与美国同行开展交流。谈到Coupang，这家总部位于美国的电子商务企业受到韩国监管机构的处理，引发部分共和党政治人物批评。洪基元说，有关歧视的说法源于文化误解。知情人士认为，这场争端已对尚在进行的双边谈判造成影响。他说：“尽管Coupang是在美国合法注册的公司，但绝大多数韩国公众都把它视为韩国企业，因为该公司大部分收入来自韩国。仅仅因为它是一家美国企业，就称其受到歧视或不公平对待，这种说法完全源于植根于文化差异的误解。”相反，他补充说，首尔可能基于同盟关系给予美国企业更优惠的待遇。他说：“我们希望美国政府和国会能在这一背景下理解此事。首尔正尽力说明自身立场，但其游说影响力与Coupang相比相形见绌，这使我们的信息更难传达，也造成了误解。”谈及韩国推动从美国收回战时作战指挥权（OPCON），他说，移交可以在不削弱盟军战备的情况下进行。洪基元说：“移交条件虽然具有抽象性，为不同解读留下了空间，但首尔与华盛顿关于移交的协议依然稳固……即使OPCON完成移交，韩国指挥官和美国副指挥官仍将在现有联合防御框架内共同指挥，确保移交工作能够推进而不削弱同盟战备。”他认为，首尔应为本国防务承担责任，而不是因怀疑自身能力而削弱自身防务态势。他说：“韩国是全球前十大的经济体和主要国防力量，必须为本国防务承担责任，并加强军队战备。因此，认为我们无法保卫自己的说法完全站不住脚。”

Jeong Yeon-doo, vice foreign minister for diplomatic strategy and intelligence, made the remarks in opening remarks at a forum on human rights in North Korea in Seoul.

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: South Korea should seek humanitarian cooperation with North Korea in healthcare, disaster response and other "feasible" areas to make progress in improving human rights, and contribute to peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula, Seoul's top nuclear envoy said Monday. Jeong Yeon-doo, vice foreign minister for diplomatic strategy and intelligence, made the remarks in opening remarks at a forum on human rights in North Korea in Seoul. "Efforts to explore transparent and sustainable humanitarian cooperation, starting with such feasible areas as healthcare and disaster response, could contribute to tangible improvements in human rights in North Korea, and peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula," Jeong was quoted as saying by the ministry. Jeong also outlined the government's vision and policies for easing tensions and achieving peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula, the ministry added. Participants also explored ways to pursue practical humanitarian cooperation with North Korea in healthcare, agriculture and disaster response, based on past international experiences and key cases, the ministry said

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.summary_zh: KakaoBank周一在韩国推出Apple Pay，结束了Hyundai Card作为唯一提供该移动支付服务的本地金融机构的长期垄断。年满14岁的客户可将KakaoBank的迷你卡（专为青少年设计的借记卡）添加至Apple Wallet。KakaoBank的加入给Hyundai Card自2023年3月在韩国推出Apple Pay以来一直主导的市场带来了竞争。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body: KakaoBank has launched Apple Pay in Korea, Monday, ending Hyundai Card's run as the only local financial institution offering the mobile payment service. The internet-only lender said customers can now add their debit cards to Apple Wallet and use them to make payments through Apple Pay. Users can make payments at participating offline stores, including major retailers, pharmacies, restaurants, cafes and convenience stores. To pay, they can simply double-click the side button on an iPhone or Apple Watch, authenticate the transaction using Face ID, Touch ID or a device passcode, and hold the device near a payment terminal. Apple Pay is also available for online and in-app purchases on iPhones, iPads and Macs, allowing users to check out without repeatedly entering their card numbers or delivery information. The service uses security features designed to protect users' payment information, the bank said. Actual card numbers are not stored on the device or Apple's servers. Instead, a unique Device Account Number is encrypted and stored in the device's secure element, a dedicated chip that securely stores payment information. The bank said the launch would also make Apple Pay accessible to a wider range of customers, including those who do not have credit cards. Customers aged 14 and older can add their KakaoBank mini cards — a debit card designed for teenagers — to Apple Wallet. KakaoBank's entry brings competition to a market Hyundai Card has dominated since introducing Apple Pay in Korea in March 2023. No other local financial institution had offered the service until now. "The launch will give customers more payment options and make everyday transactions more convenient. We will continue expanding our global payment services while working with industry partners to help develop Korea's domestic payment infrastructure," a KakaoBank official said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title_zh: KakaoBank推出Apple Pay，结束Hyundai Card的垄断
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body_zh: KakaoBank周一下午在韩国推出Apple Pay，结束了Hyundai Card作为韩国唯一提供这项移动支付服务的本土金融机构所占据的垄断地位。这家纯互联网银行表示，客户现在可以将借记卡添加到Apple Wallet，并通过Apple Pay进行付款。用户可在参与该服务的线下商店付款，包括大型零售商、药店、餐厅、咖啡馆和便利店。付款时，用户只需双击iPhone或Apple Watch的侧边按钮，使用Face ID、Touch ID或设备密码验证交易，然后将设备靠近支付终端。iPhone、iPad和Mac还支持通过Apple Pay进行在线及应用内购买，让用户结账时无需反复输入卡号或配送信息。银行表示，该服务采用旨在保护用户支付信息的安全功能。实际卡号不会存储在设备或Apple的服务器上。相反，一组唯一的设备账户号码经过加密后存储在设备的安全芯片中；这是一颗专门用于安全存储支付信息的芯片。银行表示，此次推出还将让更广泛的客户能够使用Apple Pay，其中包括没有信用卡的客户。年满14岁的用户可以将KakaoBank mini卡（专为青少年设计的借记卡）添加到Apple Wallet。自2023年3月在韩国推出Apple Pay以来，Hyundai Card一直主导着市场，如今KakaoBank的加入带来了竞争。在此之前，没有其他本土金融机构提供这项服务。KakaoBank一名官员表示：“此次推出将为客户提供更多支付选择，让日常交易更加便捷。我们将继续拓展全球支付服务，同时与行业合作伙伴合作，助力韩国本土支付基础设施建设。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: A Seoul court has overturned key resolutions passed at Korea Zinc’s annual shareholders’ meeting last year, ruling that the company’s incumbent management improperly used corporate assets to block the voting rights of the MBK Partners-Young Poong alliance, its largest shareholder, industry officials said Monday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 首尔一家法院推翻了Korea Zinc去年年度股东大会通过的关键决议。行业官员周一表示，法院裁定该公司现任管理层不当动用公司资产，阻挠其最大股东MBK Partners-Young Poong联盟的投票权。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: A Seoul court has overturned key resolutions passed at Korea Zinc’s annual shareholders’ meeting last year, ruling that the company’s incumbent management improperly used corporate assets to block the voting rights of the MBK Partners-Young Poong alliance, its largest shareholder, industry officials said Monday. In its Nov. 12 ruling, the Seoul Central District Court described the actions as “the private use of company assets” and said they “clearly violated directors’ duty of loyalty,” according to the alliance. The ruling marks a new development in the protracted battle for control of the world’s largest refined zinc smelter between Chairman Choi Yun-beom’s camp and the MBK Partners-Young Poong alliance that has dragged on since 2024. The lawsuit centered on Choi’s camp’s efforts to strip Young Poong of its voting rights at the March 2025 shareholders’ meeting. To do so, Korea Zinc’s management used two overseas subsidiaries — Sun Metals Corp. (SMC) and Sun Metals Holdings (SMH) — to invoke a Commercial Act provision that restricts voting rights in certain cross-shareholding arrangements. SMC, a subsidiary of Korea Zinc, bought more than 10 percent shares of Young Poong, which was itself a major shareholder of Korea Zinc. Under the law, this ownership structure allowed Korea Zinc to block Young Poong from voting its shares in the smelter. The court found that Choi’s camp had exploited the provision, which was intended to prevent distortions in corporate ownership and governance, in order to defend the incumbent management’s grip on control. The court also took issue with how SMC and SMH handled the shares. SMC used its funds to buy Young Poong shares, then transferred them to SMH as a dividend paid in shares rather than cash. The court described the sequence as “the expenditure of company funds or the transfer of company assets for the benefit of management,” concluding that it constituted the private use of company assets. As a result of the ruling, key resolutions passed at the March 2025 shareholders’ meeting were annulled. They included amendments to the company’s articles of incorporation, including a cap on the number of board seats, the election of five directors through cumulative voting, as well as the appointment of audit committee members and outside directors serving on the committee
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 法院裁定Korea Zinc管理层挪用公司资产，阻止MBK-Young Poong行使投票权
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 首尔一家法院推翻了韩国锌业公司去年年度股东大会通过的关键决议。行业官员周一表示，法院裁定该公司现任管理层不当动用公司资产，阻挠其最大股东MBK Partners-Young Poong联盟行使表决权。首尔中央地方法院在11月12日的裁决中将这些行为称为“擅自使用公司资产”，并称其“明显违反董事忠实义务”。据该联盟称，这是自2024年以来，董事长崔允范阵营与MBK Partners-Young Poong联盟围绕全球最大精炼锌冶炼厂控制权展开的长期争夺出现的新进展。这场诉讼的核心，是崔允范阵营试图在2025年3月股东大会上剥夺Young Poong的表决权。为此，韩国锌业管理层利用两家海外子公司——Sun Metals Corp.（SMC）和Sun Metals Holdings（SMH）——援引《商法》中一项限制特定交叉持股安排下表决权的规定。SMC是韩国锌业的子公司，购入了Young Poong超过10%的股份，而Young Poong本身是韩国锌业的主要股东。根据法律，这一持股结构使韩国锌业能够阻止Young Poong就其持有的冶炼厂股份行使表决权。法院认定，崔允范阵营利用这项旨在防止公司所有权和治理结构失衡的规定，以维护现任管理层对控制权的把持。法院还对SMC和SMH处理相关股份的方式提出异议。SMC动用自有资金购入Young Poong股份，随后以股份股息而非现金股息的形式将股份转让给SMH。法院将这一过程描述为“为公司管理层利益而支出公司资金或转让公司资产”，认定其构成擅自使用公司资产。根据该裁决，2025年3月股东大会通过的关键决议被撤销。这些决议包括对公司章程的修订，其中包括限制董事会席位数、采用累积投票制选举五名董事，以及任命在审计委员会任职的审计委员会成员和外部董事

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Remains of fallen Korean War soldier returned to family after 75 years
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The remains of a fallen Korean War soldier were returned to his family in a ceremony Monday, more than seven decades after he was killed in action during the 1950-53 conflict, the defense ministry said. Ahn's remains were first discovered in 2004 in the northeastern county of Goseong during an excavation operation by the defense ministry's war dead recovery agency.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国国防部表示，一名在朝鲜战争中阵亡士兵的遗骸于星期一移交其家属举行仪式，距他于1950年至1953年冲突中阵亡已逾七十年。安某的遗骸最初于2004年在东北部谷城郡被发现，当时国防部战争死者遗骸回收机构正在当地开展挖掘作业。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The remains of a fallen Korean War soldier were returned to his family in a ceremony Monday, more than seven decades after he was killed in action during the 1950-53 conflict, the defense ministry said. The ceremony honoring late Pfc. Ahn Dong took place in the southwestern city of Iksan, about 180 kilometers south of Seoul, about two months after authorities confirmed his identity through DNA testing, the ministry said in a release. Ahn's remains were first discovered in 2004 in the northeastern county of Goseong during an excavation operation by the defense ministry's war dead recovery agency. Although the agency obtained DNA samples from his family in 2019, it was unable to confirm a match until September of this year due to technological limitations. Ahn, born in 1928, enlisted in July 1951 and served in the Army's 8th Infantry Division. He is presumed to have been killed while fighting against North Korean forces during the Battle of Nojeonpyeong in the eastern border city of Inje in August 1951. Ahn is the 286th South Korean soldier whose remains have been returned to their family since the excavation and recovery project began in April 2000
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 阵亡朝鲜战争士兵的遗骸在75年后归还家属
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国国防部表示，一名在朝鲜战争中阵亡士兵的遗骸于星期一归还给他的家人，距他在1950年至1953年冲突中阵亡已有七十多年。该部在一份声明中说，悼念已故二等兵安东的仪式在西南部城市益山举行，该市位于首尔以南约180公里处；大约两个月前当局通过DNA检测确认了他的身份。安东的遗骸于2004年首次在东北部高城郡发现，当时国防部遗骸收殓机构正在那里开展挖掘作业。尽管该机构在2019年取得了其家人的DNA样本，但由于技术限制，直到今年9月才确认身份相匹配。安东生于1928年，1951年7月入伍，曾在陆军第8步兵师服役。据推定，他于1951年8月在东部边境城市仁川附近与朝鲜军队作战期间，在居津战役中阵亡。自2000年4月启动发掘与遗骸收殓项目以来，安东是第286名遗骸被归还给家人的韩国军人。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Naver shares slide on weak earnings, Nvidia leadership uncertainty
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Naver is facing a wave of brokerage price target cuts as disappointing third-quarter earnings and uncertainty surrounding Nvidia’s leadership transition put pressure on its shares, market analysts said Monday. Questions about the direction of Naver’s partnership with Nvidia have further unsettled investors following the resignation of the U.S. firm’s CEO, Jensen Huang, amid allegations of extramarital affairs.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 市场分析师周一表示，随着第三季度业绩不及预期，加上Nvidia领导层交接的不确定性，Naver正面临券商集中下调目标价的浪潮。在这家美国公司的首席执行官Jensen Huang因婚外情指控辞职后，有关Naver与Nvidia合作走向的疑问进一步令投资者不安。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Naver is facing a wave of brokerage price target cuts as disappointing third-quarter earnings and uncertainty surrounding Nvidia’s leadership transition put pressure on its shares, market analysts said Monday. With margins shrinking in its core platform business, investors are looking for evidence that the company’s substantial spending on artificial intelligence (AI) data centers can generate profits and support a stock recovery. Shinhan Securities cut its price target to 280,000 won ($210) from 310,000 won Monday, joining other brokerages in lowering their valuations. SK Securities previously reduced its target to 260,000 won from 320,000 won, while Meritz Securities lowered its target to 270,000 won from 330,000 won. Korea Investment & Securities and Hana Securities trimmed their targets to 300,000 won and 340,000 won from 360,000 won and 400,000 won, respectively. Shares of the country’s largest online portal operator tumbled 6.43 percent Thursday and 5.12 percent Friday, shedding about 11.2 percent over two sessions. The stock edged up 0.23 percent to close at 172,900 won Monday, recovering little of those losses. The firm’s market capitalization has fallen to around 26 trillion won, down more than 20 trillion won in roughly five months from about 47.7 trillion won in June, when its shares reached an intraday 52-week high of 304,000 won. At the heart of investors’ concerns is a widening gap between revenue growth and profitability. Third-quarter consolidated revenue increased 10.7 percent year-on-year to 3.47 trillion won, while operating profit fell 20.9 percent to 451.3 billion won, about 8.5 percent below the market consensus of 493 billion won. Spending on AI infrastructure, shopping and offline payments drove operating expenses up 17.7 percent to 3.02 trillion won. The operating margin fell to 13 percent from 18.2 percent a year earlier. “Profitability is expected to remain under pressure in the fourth quarter as Naver continues investing in internal infrastructure, commerce promotions and NPay payment terminals,” said Ko Jun-hyuk, an analyst at Shinhan Securities. Lee Hyo-jin, an analyst at Meritz Securities, similarly highlighted weakening margins in the company’s platform and financial businesses. “Higher investment costs could reduce earnings from existing operations before new businesses make a meaningful contribution,” Lee said. Questions about the direction of Naver’s partnership with Nvidia have further unsettled investors following the resignation of the U.S. firm’s CEO, Jensen Huang, amid allegations of extramarital affairs. Nvidia acquired a 4.3 percent stake through a roughly $1 billion share offering last month, becoming Naver’s third-largest shareholder. Huang’s subsequent departure has raised uncertainty over future investment and technical cooperation, given his role in driving the partnership. The change in leadership does not necessarily affect existing agreements, but the priorities of Nvidia’s new management could shape further collaboration, including access to next-generation graphics processing units (GPUs) and technical support. Nam Hyo-ji, an analyst at SK Securities, said GPU spending and procurement terms would be crucial to the economics of Naver’s AI data center business. “Negotiations with Nvidia over a large server order could offer opportunities to lower costs, while increased purchasing volumes could give Naver greater bargaining power,” Nam said. “Setup costs are likely to limit profits at first, but profitability should improve as the company wins more contracts and uses more of its data center capacity.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 盈利疲弱且Nvidia领导地位不确定，Naver股价下滑
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 市场分析师周一表示，随着第三季度业绩不及预期，加之围绕Nvidia领导层交接的不确定性，Naver正遭遇一轮券商下调目标价的浪潮。随着核心平台业务的利润率收缩，投资者正寻找证据，以确认公司对人工智能（AI）数据中心的大量投入能够创造利润并推动股价回升。新韩证券周一将目标价从310,000韩元下调至280,000韩元（210美元），加入其他券商下调估值的行列。SK证券此前已将目标价从320,000韩元下调至260,000韩元，Meritz证券也将目标价从330,000韩元下调至270,000韩元。韩国投资证券和하나证券分别将目标价从360,000韩元和400,000韩元下调至300,000韩元和340,000韩元。该国最大在线门户运营商的股价周四下跌6.43%，周五再跌5.12%，两个交易日累计蒸发约11.2%的市值。该股周一小幅上涨0.23%，收于172,900韩元，几乎未收复此前跌幅。公司市值已降至约26万亿韩元，较6月约47.7万亿韩元时缩水逾20万亿韩元；当时其股价盘中触及52周高点304,000韩元。投资者担忧的核心是营收增长与盈利能力之间的差距日益扩大。第三季度合并营收同比增长10.7%，至3.47万亿韩元；营业利润则下降20.9%，至4513亿韩元，比市场普遍预计的4930亿韩元低约8.5%。对AI基础设施、购物和线下支付的投入推动运营费用增长17.7%，至3.02万亿韩元。营业利润率从一年前的18.2%降至13%。新韩证券分析师Ko Jun-hyuk表示：“随着Naver继续投资内部基础设施、商务促销和NPay支付终端，预计第四季度盈利能力仍将承压。”Meritz证券分析师Lee Hyo-jin同样指出，该公司的平台和金融业务利润率正在走弱。Lee表示：“在现有业务贡献的新业务收入具有实质性意义之前，较高的投资成本可能会削减现有业务的收益。”在美国公司Nvidia首席执行官Jensen Huang因婚外情指控辞职后，Naver与Nvidia合作方向的疑问进一步令投资者不安。Nvidia上月通过一项规模约10亿美元的股份发行收购了4.3%的股份，成为Naver第三大股东。鉴于Huang在推动双方合作方面发挥的作用，他的离任令未来投资与技术合作的不确定性上升。领导层变动未必会影响现有协议，但Nvidia新管理层的优先事项可能影响进一步合作，包括能否获得下一代图形处理单元（GPU）以及技术支持。SK证券分析师Nam Hyo-ji表示，GPU支出和采购条款将是决定Naver AI数据中心业务经济效益的关键。Nam说：“与Nvidia就大规模服务器订单进行谈判，可能带来降低成本的机遇，而提高采购量则可增强Naver的议价能力。”“初期建设成本可能限制利润，但随着公司赢得更多合同并提高数据中心产能利用率，盈利能力应会改善。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title: Benchmark rate for banks' mortgage loans continues to rise
