COFIX, or the Cost of Funds Index, a benchmark lending rate for new mortgage loans, came to 3.62 percent last month, up 0.19 percentage point from the previous month, according to the data from the Korea Federation of Banks.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.summary_zh: 数据显示，10月银行抵押贷款利率基准连续第二个月上升，与市场利率高企走势一致。根据韩国银行联合会的资料，COFIX（资金成本指数）是新增抵押贷款的基准贷款利率，上月升至3.62%，较前一个月上涨0.19个百分点。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body: The benchmark rate for banks' mortgage rates increased for a second consecutive month in October in line with high market rates, data showed Monday. COFIX, or the Cost of Funds Index, a benchmark lending rate for new mortgage loans, came to 3.62 percent last month, up 0.19 percentage point from the previous month, according to the data from the Korea Federation of Banks. The rate was the highest since February 2024, when the corresponding reading was 3.62 percent. COFIX is calculated based on the funding costs of eight domestic banks in Korea. They include Nonghyup Bank, Shinhan Bank, Woori Bank and Citibank Korea. The Bank of Korea (BOK) kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged last month at 3 percent after two consecutive rate hikes to give the central bank time to assess economic conditions amid prolonged tensions in the Middle East and robust exports. The rate freeze came after the BOK raised the benchmark rate in its July and August meetings, citing "preemptive action" to curb mounting inflationary pressure and ensure macroeconomic stability
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title_zh: 银行按揭贷款基准利率继续上升
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body_zh: 数据显示，银行按揭贷款的基准利率在10月连续第二个月上调，与较高的市场利率保持一致。根据韩国银行联合会的数据，COFIX即资金成本指数这一新按揭贷款基准贷款利率上月升至3.62%，较前一个月上升0.19个百分点。该利率为2024年2月以来的最高水平，当时相应读数同为3.62%。COFIX根据韩国八家国内银行的资金成本计算，其中包括NH银行、新韩银行、友利银行和花旗银行韩国。韩国央行（BOK）上月将基准利率维持在3%不变，此前已连续两次加息，为该央行评估中东持续紧张局势和出口强劲表现下的经济状况留出时间。此次冻结利率之前，韩国央行曾在7月和8月的会议上上调基准利率，称此举是为采取“预防性行动”，遏制不断加剧的通胀压力并确保宏观稳定。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title: Banks court religious communities with tailored financial services
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.summary: Korea's major banks are courting religious communities to expand their customer base, offering tailored services such as mobile donation platforms and debit cards that double as membership cards for religious groups, industry officials said Monday. Religious organizations can also link transaction data to their financial management systems, making it easier to issue donation receipts for year-end tax deductions.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.summary_zh: 韩国大型银行正积极争取宗教群体，以扩大客户群。行业官员周一表示，这些银行提供量身定制的服务，例如移动捐赠平台，以及可兼作宗教团体会员卡的借记卡。宗教组织还可以将交易数据接入其财务管理系统，从而更方便地开具捐赠收据，供持有人在年底申报税务抵扣。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body: Korea's major banks are courting religious communities to expand their customer base, offering tailored services such as mobile donation platforms and debit cards that double as membership cards for religious groups, industry officials said Monday. Hana Bank's mobile donation service for religious organizations processed 68 billion won ($51 million) in donations from January through October this year, according to the bank. This is a sharp increase from the 350 million won recorded in 2020, when the service was first introduced. The service allows worshippers at churches and Buddhist temples to make donations using QR codes, without having to install a separate app. Religious organizations can also link transaction data to their financial management systems, making it easier to issue donation receipts for year-end tax deductions. Hana Bank also offers a trust product that allows customers to leave part or all of their assets to religious organizations after their death. Since launching the product in July 2021, the bank has partnered with 12 religious organizations and signed trust agreements worth a combined 24.8 billion won. Woori Bank's Catholic donation service, Catholic Pay, had attracted more than 110,000 registered users as of October, nearly nine times the 12,790 users recorded when it was launched in 2023. The service is integrated into the Archdiocese of Seoul's mobile app, allowing users to register their bank accounts and transfer Sunday offerings and other donations. Woori also signed an agreement with the archdiocese to support the 2027 World Youth Day, an international gathering of Catholic youth scheduled to take place in Seoul in August next year. KB Kookmin Bank also operates a donation transfer service that was initially launched for Christian communities in 2020 before being expanded to include Buddhist and Catholic groups in 2023. Its transaction volume rose 4.5 percent last year, according to the bank. Shinhan Bank, for its part, signed an agreement with the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism in March to develop a debit card that also serves as a membership card for Buddhist followers. The two sides also plan to build a digital platform to help temples manage their members. Banks' growing interest in religious communities comes as Korea had an estimated 20.73 million religious adherents in 2025, including 9.33 million Christians, 8.29 million Buddhists and 3.11 million Catholics, according to Gallup Korea. Mobile donation services first gained traction during the COVID-19 pandemic, when social distancing measures pushed religious groups to move worship services online. Their use has continued to grow since then, industry officials said. For banks, religious groups offer a way to expand their customer base and build lasting relationships. "Religious affiliation often runs in families. When parents start using a service, their children often follow suit, helping banks build customer relationships across generations. Services also tend to spread quickly through religious communities, as members recommend them to one another," a banking industry official said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title_zh: 银行以定制化金融服务争取宗教社群
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body_zh: 韩国大型银行正积极争取宗教团体，以扩大客户群并提供定制化服务，例如移动捐赠平台，以及兼作宗教团体会员卡的借记卡。业内人士周一表示。Hana Bank面向宗教组织的移动捐赠服务今年1月至10月共处理了680亿韩元（5100万美元）的捐赠。据该行称，这一数字较服务首次推出的2020年所记录的3.5亿韩元大幅增长。这项服务允许教堂和佛教寺庙的信众使用二维码捐款，无需另行安装应用程序。宗教组织还可将交易数据接入其财务管理系统，从而更方便地开具年末抵税所需的捐赠收据。Hana Bank还提供一项信托产品，允许客户去世后将部分或全部资产留给宗教组织。自2021年7月推出以来，该行已与12个宗教组织建立合作，并签署了总额248亿韩元的信托协议。截至10月，Woori Bank的天主教捐赠服务Catholic Pay吸引了超过11万名注册用户，接近该服务于2023年推出时记录的12790名用户的九倍。这项服务已接入首尔大主教的移动应用程序，允许用户登记银行账户并划转主日奉献及其他捐款。Woori还与首尔大主教签署协议，将支持2027年世界青年日。这一天主教青年国际聚会定于明年8月在首尔举行。KB Kookmin Bank也运营一项捐赠转账服务，该服务最初于2020年面向基督教团体推出，随后于2023年扩展至佛教和天主教团体。据该行称，其交易额去年增长了4.5%。Shinhan Bank则于3月与韩国佛教曹溪宗签署协议，开发一张兼作佛教信众会员卡的借记卡。双方还计划建立一个数字平台，帮助寺庙管理会员。据Gallup Korea称，2025年韩国估计有2073万名宗教信仰者，其中基督徒933万人、佛教徒829万人、天主教徒311万人。业内人士表示，移动捐赠服务在新冠疫情期间首次获得广泛使用，当时保持社交距离的措施促使宗教团体将礼拜活动转移到线上。此后，这类服务的使用量持续增长。对银行而言，宗教团体为扩大客户群、建立长久客户关系提供了一条途径。一位银行业人士表示：“宗教信仰往往会代代相传。父母开始使用某项服务后，其子女往往会效仿，帮助银行建立跨世代的客户关系。服务也容易通过宗教群体迅速传播，因为成员之间会相互推荐。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Ex-deputy national security adviser takes office as KOICA chief
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Oh Hyun-joo, a career diplomat who previously served as a deputy director at the presidential National Security Office, took office Monday as the 15th president of the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA), the state-run foreign aid agency.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 职业外交官Oh Hyun-joo曾任总统府国家安全办公室副主任，她于周一就任韩国国际合作机构（KOICA）第15任社长。该机构是韩国政府运营的对外援助机构。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Oh Hyun-joo, a career diplomat who previously served as a deputy director at the presidential National Security Office, took office Monday as the 15th president of the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA), the state-run foreign aid agency. KOICA is Korea’s main agency for carrying out the government’s grant aid programs for developing countries. It was founded in 1991. An inauguration ceremony was held the same day at its headquarters in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province. Oh graduated from Korea University with a degree in Spanish language and literature and earned a master’s degree in international relations from the University of Cambridge. She joined the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in 1994 after passing the foreign service exam. Her key posts include director of the ministry’s development cooperation division, counselor at Korea’s mission in Geneva, special adviser to the president of the United Nations Human Rights Council, director general for development cooperation and deputy ambassador to the U.N. In 2023, she became Korea’s first female ambassador to the Vatican. In June 2025, she was named third deputy director of the National Security Office, where she handled diplomatic and security issues related to economic and technology security. KOICA described Oh as a development cooperation expert with more than 30 years of experience in official development assistance, multilateral diplomacy and economic security. Official development assistance is aid that governments and public institutions give to support economic development and welfare in developing countries. “Based on the experience KOICA has built over the past 35 years, we will work closely with related ministries and agencies to leap forward as a unified KOICA that opens a new chapter in Korea’s development cooperation,” Oh said in her inaugural speech. She also pledged to support the participation and growth of partners such as young people and companies. She said KOICA would pursue development cooperation that balances the progress of partner countries with Korea’s national interests. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 前国家副安全顾问就任KOICA负责人

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/b.body: Actor Cha In-pyo novel expected to be the 1st work to be published Korean literature is set to reach more English-speaking readers through a new publishing imprint established by Oxford University's Korean studies center. The Oxford Centre for Korean Studies (OCKS) said Monday it had signed a memorandum of understanding with a local independent publisher, Oxford eBooks, to establish K-PRESS — a new imprint dedicated to translating Korean literature into English, according to Yonhap News Agency. The first title to be published will be “Mother Star,” the English edition of actor and novelist Cha In-pyo's debut novel. Jieun Kiaer, director of the center, told Yonhap that barriers to translation and publication remain high, with English-language editions concentrated among a small number of Korean writers and genres. She expressed hope that K-PRESS would introduce a wider range of stories reflecting Korean lives, emotions, humor and imagination. K-PRESS also plans to participate in the Oxford Indie Book Fair at the university campus on Sunday. First held in 2020, the event brings together about 150 independent publishers and authors. The partnership seeks to address the gap between international enthusiasm for Korean culture and the limited selection of Korean books available in major British bookstores. Despite heightened interest following novelist Han Kang’s 2024 Nobel Prize win in literature, Korean children’s and young adult books remain particularly underrepresented overseas. The center will be tasked with identifying aspiring writers and works, while Oxford eBooks, which has operated locally for more than two decades, will handle publishing contracts, production, distribution and marketing. Oxford eBooks head Andy Severn told Yonhap the venture was worth the effort and risk, despite larger publishers’ reluctance to take chances on unfamiliar works. “Mother Star” was translated by Kiaer and British poet and writer Kate Clanchy. The novel addresses the suffering of victims of Japan’s wartime military sexual slavery during its colonial rule of Korea. First published in 2009, the book drew renewed attention in 2024 after being featured at Oxford’s inaugural Korean Literature Festival. Cha told Yonhap he welcomed a dedicated British publishing outlet for Korean literature and hoped English-speaking readers would empathize with the pain experienced by the victims

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: President Lee Jae Myung’s push to revive Kosdaq as part of broader capital market reforms is drawing skepticism, with market participants saying Monday that his proposals lack concrete measures to attract investment. They support removing weak companies and broadening the investor base but question whether the measures outlined so far will bring sustained capital inflows. At a policy meeting at the Korea Exchange on Friday, Lee acknowledged widespread concerns about Kosdaq and called for stricter enforcement of delisting rules to swiftly remove financially troubled or underperforming companies. The meeting followed steep declines in both KOSPI and Kosdaq from record highs earlier this year, fueling concerns about financial market stability. Na Seung-doo, an analyst at SK Securities, welcomed the emphasis on addressing the market’s structural weaknesses. However, he added, “The discussion offered little detail on how to make Kosdaq more attractive to major investors, leaving the timing of a meaningful policy catalyst even less clear.” The market’s recent gains also provide limited evidence of a lasting recovery in demand, according to Na. Kosdaq rose more than 9 percent last week, supported by institutional buying, after concerns about tighter regulations on artificial intelligence data centers following the U.S. midterm elections pushed it as low as the 629 level intraday. “The rebound may reflect a temporary shift in funds as investors sought to diversify their exposure while KOSPI struggled with the fallout from the Nvidia shock,” Na said. He stressed that attracting longer-term investment would require a benchmark that pension funds and other institutions could use to guide their allocations. He called for the swift introduction of the Kosdaq Select Index discussed at the meeting, followed by more exchange-traded funds and other investment products tracking it. In addition, he urged incentives for listed companies to improve investor engagement, saying many small and midcap firms with large controlling shareholder stakes remain reluctant to meet investors and analysts. Questions also remain over how the broader capital market reforms will be implemented. At the meeting, Lee ordered the creation of a task force involving the government, ruling and opposition parties, the exchange and other market participants to assess conditions and clarify points of contention. He asked for a designated senior official to report directly to him on its progress. Supporters see the body as a way to resolve competing interests and advance stalled legislation. Critics argue that with government-party consultations and parliamentary discussions already in place, another body could lengthen the decision-making process. Some members of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) are particularly concerned that the task force could overlap with the party’s existing special committee on capital market reform. They fear the committee’s work could lose momentum before the new body is launched and that it could subsequently lose control of the agenda. Securing opposition participation poses a further challenge. Efforts to bring opposition parties on board could hold up legislation, while their participation could still entail lengthy negotiations over disputed measures. “The president appeared to be seeking both faster reforms and broader procedural legitimacy, but whether the task force could deliver both is in doubt,” a DPK official said, asking not to be named
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title_zh: 李在明推动KOSDAQ改革，但因缺乏具体措施而遭质疑
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body_zh: 李在明总统推动重振科斯达克，作为更广泛资本市场改革的一部分，此举正引发质疑。市场参与者周一表示，他的方案缺乏吸引投资的具体措施。他们支持剔除弱势公司并扩大投资者群体，但质疑迄今公布的措施能否带来持续资本流入。周五在韩国交易所举行的一次政策会议上，李承认外界普遍对科斯达克存在担忧，并要求严格执行退市规则，迅速将财务困难或表现不佳的公司摘牌。此次会议召开前，科斯达克和综合指数自今年早些时候创下的历史高点均大幅下跌，引发了人们对金融市场稳定的担忧。SK证券分析师罗胜杜对解决市场结构性弊端的重视表示欢迎。不过，他补充道：“此次讨论几乎没有说明如何提高科斯达克对大型投资者的吸引力，因此 meaningful政策催化剂何时出现就更不明确了。”据罗胜杜称，该市场近期上涨也仅为需求持续复苏提供了有限证据。上周，在美国中期选举后，市场担忧将加强对人工智能数据中心的监管，科斯达克盘中一度跌至629点，随后在机构买盘推动下上涨逾9%。罗胜杜说：“在Nvidia冲击余波令综合指数陷入困境之际，这轮反弹可能反映投资者寻求分散风险敞口时带来的资金暂时轮动。”他强调，要吸引长期投资，需要一个基准，供养老金和其他机构配置资产时参考。他呼吁迅速推出会上讨论的科斯达克精选指数，随后推出更多跟踪该指数的交易所交易基金及其他投资产品。此外，他敦促为上市公司加强投资者互动提供激励，并表示，许多控股股东持股比例较高的小型和中盘公司仍不愿与投资者和分析师会面。更广泛资本市场改革将如何落实，也存在疑问。会议期间，李要求成立一个工作组，由政府、执政党、反对党、交易所及其他市场参与者共同参与，评估市场状况并厘清争议点。他要求指定一名高级官员就工作组进展直接向他汇报。支持者认为，该机构有助于协调相互冲突的利益并推动陷入停滞的立法。批评者则认为，政府与各党的磋商及议会讨论已经在进行，再设立一个机构可能延长决策过程。执政的韩国民主党部分成员尤其担心，新工作组会与该党现有的资本市场改革特别委员会职能重叠。他们担心，在新机构成立前，特别委员会的工作会失去动力，而此后又可能失去议程主导权。让反对党参与进来也是一项挑战。争取反对党加入可能拖延立法进程，而即使反对党参与，围绕争议措施仍可能进行旷日持久的谈判。一名韩国民主党官员表示：“总统似乎既想加快改革步伐，又想扩大程序合法性，但工作组能否兼顾两者仍存疑。”该官员要求不具名

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body: A hidden hilltop park tucked just an eight-minute walk from Seoul’s bustling Sinchon university district is set to undergo a major transformation into a premier night tourism landmark by 2027. Seodaemun District said Monday that Changcheon Neighborhood Park, commonly known by locals as Baramsan (Wind Mountain) due to its breezy elevated terrain, has been selected for the Seoul Metropolitan Government's 2026 Seoul Starlight Attraction Creation Project. The district plans to invest up to 1 billion won in municipal funding following final budget reviews, supported by 50 million won in district funds already secured for initial master planning. The project aims to leverage Baramsan's sweeping urban views to create a dedicated sunset and night-view destination, linking the hilltop park directly to the vibrant commercial and dining strip along Yonsei-ro to stimulate nighttime tourism and local commerce. Spanning 6,322 square meters atop the hill, Changcheon Neighborhood Park has historically remained relatively unknown to the broader public despite its proximity to the busy subway station. Under the new plan, the district will upgrade existing facilities — including an elevator, viewing deck and landmark windmill structure — while preserving the natural topography. The park's entrance stairs will feature water features and landscape lighting to guide visitors upward, while the existing observation deck will be expanded into a curved sunset viewing lounge. Additional upgrades include shaded resting areas named "Wind Forest Lounge," seasonal gardens around the windmill and reinforced safety infrastructure. A district survey conducted in September showed that visitors prioritized benches and rest areas (53.7 percent) while citing safety concerns as the top issue for nighttime visits (46.3 percent). In response, the district will install additional CCTV cameras, emergency bells and restrained landscape lighting designed to minimize light pollution. Seodaemun District intends to integrate the park with nearby restaurants, cafes and performance venues along Yonsei-ro, creating a seamless loop where visitors can enjoy evening city views before returning to local dining and cultural spots. Survey data indicated that 82.9 percent of respondents are willing to patronize nearby commercial establishments in connection with a visit to Baramsan. The district plans to tie the park's opening into local revitalization initiatives such as the Sinchon Pass and the Seoul Vacation Festival. Upon completion in 2027, the district aims to increase nighttime visitors by more than 50 percent compared to pre-project levels while achieving an 80 percent user satisfaction rate. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.title_zh: 首尔拟于2027年前将新川一处隐秘山顶改造成日落及夜景公园
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body_zh: 距离首尔繁华的新村大学区步行仅8分钟，一座隐藏在山坡上的公园计划到2027年进行重大改造，升级为 premier 夜间旅游地标。西大门区周一表示，因地势较高且风势充足，当地居民通常将长川邻里公园称为“Baramsan（风山）”；该公园已入选首尔市政府2026年“首尔星光景点创建项目”。区计划在完成最终预算审查后投入最多10亿韩元市政资金；用于初步总体规划的5000万韩元区级资金已经到位。项目将利用Baramsan开阔的城市景观，打造专门的日落和夜景目的地，把山顶公园与延世路沿线充满活力的商业和餐饮带直接连接起来，以带动夜间旅游和本地商业。长川邻里公园占地6322平方米，位于山顶，尽管毗邻繁忙地铁站，却一直相对不为人知。根据新计划，区政府将在保护自然地形的同时，升级现有设施，包括电梯、观景台和标志性风车结构。公园入口楼梯将设置水景和景观照明，引导游客上山；现有观景台将扩建为弧形日落观景休闲区。其他升级项目包括以“风之森林休闲区”命名的遮荫休息区、风车周围的季节性花园，以及加强后的安全基础设施。区级部门9月开展的调查显示，游客最看重长椅和休息区（53.7%），并将安全问题列为夜间到访的首要顾虑（46.3%）。对此，区政府将增设监控摄像头、紧急呼叫铃和低亮度景观照明，以尽量减少光污染。西大门区打算把公园与延世路附近的餐厅、咖啡馆和演出场所整合起来，打造一条顺畅的游览环线，让游客欣赏夜间城市景观后，再回到当地餐饮和文化场所消费。调查数据显示，82.9%的受访者愿意在游览Baramsan期间光顾附近的商业机构。区计划把公园开放与新村通行证、首尔休闲节等本地振兴举措结合起来。工程预计于2027年完工，届时区政府的目标是让夜间访客较项目实施前增加50%以上，同时实现80%的使用者满意度。本文在生成式人工智能协助下发布，由《韩国时报》编辑

https://www.myjoyonline.com/no-new-taxes.summary_zh: 加纳纳税人联盟赞扬政府决定在2027年预算中不新增税种，称此举可能缓解家庭和企业的财务压力。该组织表示，在加纳人寻求经济纾困、提高购买力和改善经营环境之际，这项决定是一项值得欢迎的进展。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/no-new-taxes.body: Taxpayers League Ghana has commended the government for its decision not to introduce new taxes in the 2027 Budget, saying the move could ease financial pressures on households and businesses. The organisation described the decision as a welcome development at a time when Ghanaians are seeking economic relief, improved purchasing power and a more favourable business environment. In a press release signed by its Executive Director, Hopeson Adorye, on November 15, the League said taxation should not be viewed merely as a tool for generating revenue but should also serve as a means of promoting investment, stimulating production, protecting jobs and supporting economic growth. It said the government's decision, announced by Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson, signals a commitment to improving revenue mobilisation through stronger tax compliance, plugging revenue leakages and ensuring the effective collection of existing taxes. Taxpayers League Ghana also welcomed the government's earlier removal of several taxes, including the Electronic Transfer Levy (E-Levy), COVID-19 Levy, Emissions Levy, withholding tax on betting and lottery winnings, and VAT on motor vehicle insurance. According to the organisation, these measures provide an opportunity to rebuild public confidence in the tax system and strengthen the relationship between the government and taxpayers. However, it stressed that the absence of new taxes must translate into tangible economic benefits for ordinary Ghanaians. The League called for greater accountability and transparency in the management of public funds, intensified efforts to eliminate corruption and waste, and simpler tax administration to make compliance less burdensome for individuals and businesses. It also urged the government to prioritise job creation, infrastructure development and investment in productive sectors to ensure that economic stability leads to improved living conditions. The organisation further called on the government to maintain its no-new-tax commitment throughout 2027. “Ghana does not necessarily need more taxes to generate more revenue; it needs a more efficient, transparent and accountable revenue collection system,” the statement said

https://www.myjoyonline.com/no-new-taxes.body_zh: 加纳纳税人联盟称赞政府决定不在2027年预算中引入新税，并表示此举可能缓解家庭和企业的经济压力。该组织称，在加纳人寻求经济减负、提高购买力以及改善商业环境之际，此项决定是一个值得欢迎的进展。联盟在11月15日发布的一份由执行主任Hopeson Adorye签署的新闻公报中表示，税收不应仅被视为增加收入的工具，还应成为促进投资、刺激生产、保护就业和支持经济增长的手段。公报称，财政部长Cassiel Ato Forson博士宣布的政府决定表明，政府致力于通过加强税务遵从、堵住收入流失以及确保现有税款得到有效征收来改善财政收入动员。加纳纳税人联盟还欢迎政府此前取消多项税收，包括电子转账税（E-Levy）、COVID-19税、排放税、博彩和彩票收入预扣税以及机动车保险增值税。该组织表示，这些措施为重建公众对税收制度的信心以及加强政府与纳税人之间的关系提供了机会。不过，该组织强调，不征收新税必须转化为普通加纳人切实能够享受的经济利益。联盟呼吁加强公共资金管理和问责，提高透明度；加大力度消除腐败和浪费；并简化税务管理，以降低个人和企业的纳税负担。该组织还敦促政府优先促进就业、加快基础设施发展并投资生产性行业，确保经济稳定能够改善民众生活条件。该组织进一步呼吁政府在2027年全年维持不征收新税的承诺。公报称：“加纳未必需要通过增加税收来增加财政收入；加纳需要的是一个更高效、透明且问责到位的税收征管体系。”

https://www.myjoyonline.com/keep-new-tax.body_zh: 加纳纳税人联盟敦促政府维持承诺，在整个2027年不引入新税，同时要求在公共收入管理方面加强问责、透明度和效率。该组织表示，政府决定在2027年预算中维持不新增税收的政策值得肯定，但强调这一承诺必须转化为家庭和企业切实的经济利益。联盟于11月15日发布新闻声明，由执行主任Hopeson Adorye签署。声明称，这项政策应当减轻纳税人的财务负担、提高购买力，并为投资创造更有利的环境。联盟赞扬财政部长Cassiel Ato Forson博士宣布政府决定在2027年不引入新税，称此举是加强公众对税收制度信心的良机。联盟认为，政府可以通过加强纳税遵从、堵住收入流失漏洞以及确保现有税款得到有效征收，在不增加税收的情况下改善收入征集工作。联盟还欢迎取消若干税项，包括电子转账税（E-Levy）、新冠疫情税、排放税、博彩和彩票中奖所得预扣税，以及机动车保险增值税。然而，该组织表示，不新增税收的承诺必须伴随更严格的公共支出问责和透明度。联盟呼吁加大力度消除腐败和浪费、简化税收管理，并优先推动就业创造、基础设施建设和对经济生产性领域的投资。联盟进一步敦促私营部门、有组织劳工、公民社会和广大公众与政府开展建设性互动，确保2027年预算得到有效落实。该组织坚持认为，加纳的税收制度应以公平、效率、问责和经济增长为指导。声明称：“加纳未必需要通过增加税收来获得更多收入；它需要的是一个更高效、透明且问责有力的收入征收体系。”

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111617.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 윤보람 기자 = 가상자산 거래소 바이낸스 해킹의 배후로 북한이 지목된 가운데, 북한 해킹조직의 인공지능(AI) 활용도가 이미 '정착' 단계에 진입했다는 분석이 나왔다. 국가안보전략연구원(INSS)이 16일 발간한 'AI 도구 활용 국가배후 해킹조직(APT) 활동의 안보적 영향 분석' 보고서에 따르면, 마이크로소프트(MS)는 지난달 29일 낸 보고서에서 '제이드 슬릿'이란 북한 해킹조직에 대해 'AI 정착 단계'에 진입했다고 평가했다. 제이드 슬릿은 미국과 일본의 수사기관이 바이낸스 해킹 배후로 지목된 북한 정찰총국 소속 해킹조직 '트레이더트레이터'와 동일하게 분류해온 조직이다. 보고서에 따르면 바이낸스 사건에서 첫 침해 이후 공격자는 사내 AI 도구를 내부 확산 수단으로 악용해 배포 권한 토큰을 확보했다. 블록체인 분석업체 '엘립틱'은 자금 세탁 과정이 명백히 자동화됐고 최초 경유 지점을 선택한 주체가 인간인지 AI인지 판별할 수 없다고 밝혔는데, 이는 AI 개입 가능성을 열어둔 것으로 해석된다고 보고서는 짚었다. 북한의 다른 해킹조직인 '오닉스 슬릿'은 지난 8∼9월 한국 국민을 대상으로 한 표적 맞춤형 유인용 PDF 문서를 수 분 만에 수십 개씩 제작한 정황이 포착됐다. 북한 사이버전 인력은 2024년 8월 기준 약 8천400명으로 추산된다. 이는 한국의 '2022 국방 백서'에 수록된 6천800여명보다 약 1천600명이 늘어난 규모다. 보고서는 "과거 숙련 인력 다수가 필요하던 공격을 소수 운영자가 수행한 사례가 잇따라 확인돼 북한 사이버 인력의 공격 역량이 증대될 개연성이 있다"고 지적했다. 이어 "AI 도구 활용으로 해킹 수법이 정교해지면서 사후 대응만으로는 피해 차단에 한계가 있다"면서 "공격 징후를 조기에 포착하고 신속히 공유하는 예방 중심의 대응을 강화해야 한다"고 제언했다. 한편 북한 입장을 대변하는 재일본 조선인총연합회(조총련) 기관지 조선신보는 이날 디지털판에 '바이낸스 사건 배후 지목의 신빙성과 검증과제'란 제목의 논설을 싣고 "공개된 발표만으로는 조선(북한)을 배후로 지목한 판단의 근거와 검증 과정은 충분히 확인하기 어렵다"고 반박했다. 조선신보는 미 연방수사국(FBI)의 수사 결과 발표를 두고 "해당 지갑의 실제 통제자를 어떻게 확인하고 조선과의 연계를 무엇으로 입증하였는지에 대한 구체적인 설명은 없다"면서 "공개적인 검증을 거치지 않은 수사 결과를 확정된 사실처럼 내세워 압박을 정당화한다면 이는 대조선 적대시 정책을 강행하기 위한 구실에 불과하다"고 주장했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/16 20:37 송고 2026년11월16일 20시37분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111617.title_zh: 北方黑客组织将人工智能工具日常化……网络攻击能力将增强
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111617.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）尹宝拉记者＝在朝鲜被指认为虚拟资产交易平台Binance（币安）黑客攻击幕后黑手的情况下，有分析称，朝鲜黑客组织对人工智能（AI）的利用程度已经进入“成熟”阶段。国家安全战略研究院（INSS）16日发布的《利用AI工具的国家支持型黑客组织（APT）活动安全影响分析》报告称，微软（MS）上月29日发布的报告将朝鲜黑客组织“泥鳅小径”评价为已经进入“AI成熟阶段”。“泥鳅小径”一直被美国和日本的调查机构归类为与被指为Binance（币安）黑客攻击幕后黑手的朝鲜侦察总局所属黑客组织“TraderTraitor（贸易者）”相同的组织。报告称，在Binance（币安）事件中，首次入侵之后，攻击者滥用了公司内部的AI工具作为内部传播手段，获取了部署权限令牌。区块链分析公司“Elliptic（椭圆）”表示，资金洗钱流程显然已实现自动化，无法判断选择最初中转点的主体是人类还是AI；报告指出，这意味着AI介入的可能性依然存在。朝鲜另一个黑客组织“石斑鱼小径”被发现曾于8日至9月针对韩国国民，利用AI在数分钟内批量制作数十份以特定目标为诱饵的PDF文档。朝鲜网络战人员截至2024年8月估计约有8400人，比韩国《2022年国防白皮书》记载的约6800人增加约1600人。报告指出：“过去需要大量熟练人员实施的攻击，如今接连出现由少数运营者完成的案例，因此朝鲜网络人员的攻击能力有可能得到提升。”报告进一步称：“随着利用AI工具使黑客攻击手段日益精密，仅靠事后应对已难以阻止损害发生。应加强以预防为核心的有效措施，尽早发现攻击迹象并迅速共享信息。”另一方面，代表朝鲜立场的在日本朝鲜人总联合会（朝总联）机关报《朝鲜新报》当天在数字版刊登题为《Binance（币安）事件幕后黑手指控的可信度与验证课题》的评论文章，反驳称：“仅凭公开发布的信息，难以充分确认将朝鲜认定为幕后黑手的判断依据及验证过程。”《朝鲜新报》针对美国联邦调查局（FBI）公布的调查结果称：“相关说明并未具体交代如何确认该钱包的实际控制者，也未说明以何种证据证明其与朝鲜存在联系。”文章主张：“如果未经公开验证，便将调查结果作为既定事实加以展示，为施压寻找正当理由，那么这不过是推行对朝敌视政策的借口。”版权(c) 韩联社，禁止未经许可转载、再发布及用于AI学习和使用；2026年11月16日20时37分发稿。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/new-economy-.body: International corporate lawyer and entrepreneur Vicky Bright has welcomed the NDC government's proposed 2027 New Economy agenda but says its success will depend on a clear implementation plan that translates economic growth into jobs and improved living standards. The agenda seeks to boost local production, manufacturing, value addition and job creation, with the government targeting 8 per cent economic growth and a reduction in unemployment to 8 per cent by 2030. Speaking on the JoyNews AM Show on Monday, November 16, Ms Bright said the targets were worth pursuing but stressed that the government must demonstrate how its policies would deliver tangible benefits to Ghanaians. “I support the government's ambition to achieve this 8% economic growth and bring unemployment down to 8% by 2030. We need sustained growth,” she said. She acknowledged improvements in Ghana's macroeconomic stability and said the country's renewed appeal to international investors was encouraging. “If you look at where we were in 2024 as a nation and where we are now, and our attractiveness even to the international markets, I think people now want to invest in Ghana again,” she noted. Ms Bright also welcomed proposed measures to strengthen local textile manufacturing, process 50 per cent of Ghana's cocoa domestically and phase out expensive emergency power arrangements. She said the initiatives, together with plans to consolidate mineral-related investment funds to establish a sovereign wealth fund, could deliver significant economic benefits if properly implemented. However, she cautioned that economic growth would not automatically lead to a corresponding reduction in unemployment. “8% GDP growth does not automatically mean a corresponding reduction in unemployment,” she said. She identified agriculture, manufacturing, tourism and technology as sectors with considerable potential to create jobs, but argued that the infrastructure and support systems needed to drive growth in these areas must be strengthened. In agriculture, she said farmers needed access to storage facilities, reliable transportation, processing infrastructure and dependable markets for their produce. Manufacturers, she added, required affordable electricity, working capital and accessible markets to expand their operations and employ more people. Ms Bright also urged the government to pay attention to the quality and sustainability of jobs created, arguing that employment figures should distinguish between permanent positions, temporary construction work and training opportunities. Ms Bright identified institutional performance and the business environment as critical to the success of the New Economy agenda. She said businesses needed predictable tax policies, timely permits, reliable electricity and prompt payment for services delivered to the government. She warned that delays in settling government contracts could undermine businesses' cash flow, limiting their ability to expand and create jobs. “These everyday conditions influence whether an entrepreneur can expand and employ another 10 or 20 people, or they stay put because it's just too much,” she said. Ms Bright also called on the government to establish measurable commitments ahead of the 2030 target, particularly milestones that could be assessed by the end of 2028. She proposed quarterly, half-yearly and annual reviews to track progress and strengthen accountability. “2030 extends beyond the current presidential term. Long-term planning, very welcome. That's how we should be looking at things. But we need clear commitments for what will be delivered by the end of 2028,” she said. She maintained that the New Economy agenda could deliver significant benefits but said its credibility would depend on adequate financing, strong institutions and effective implementation. “I support the ambition. But I think we should have a clear delivery plan,” she stressed
https://www.myjoyonline.com/new-economy-.title_zh: 新经济议程需要清晰路线图，而不只是雄心勃勃的目标
https://www.myjoyonline.com/new-economy-.body_zh: 国际企业律师兼企业家Vicky Bright对NDC政府拟议的2027年“新经济”议程表示欢迎，但她说，该议程能否成功取决于一套明确的实施计划，将经济增长转化为就业机会和更高的生活水平。该议程旨在推动本地生产、制造业、增值加工和创造就业，政府的目标是实现8%的经济增长，并将失业率降至2030年的8%。Bright女士于11月16日星期一在JoyNews AM Show节目中表示，这些目标值得追求，但强调政府必须证明其政策如何为加纳人带来切实利益。她说：“我支持政府实现8%经济增长、到2030年将失业率降至8%的抱负。我们需要持续增长。”她承认加纳宏观经济稳定性有所改善，并表示该国重新吸引国际投资者的势头令人鼓舞。她指出：“如果你看看2024年我们作为一个国家所处的位置，以及我们现在所处的位置，还有我们甚至对国际市场所具有的吸引力，我认为人们现在又想投资加纳了。”Bright女士还欢迎拟议中旨在加强本地纺织制造业、在加纳境内加工50%可可以及逐步淘汰成本高昂的应急供电安排的措施。她说，如果这些举措得到妥善落实，并结合整合矿产相关投资基金以设立主权财富基金的计划，可能带来显著的经济效益。然而，她警告说，经济增长不会自动带来相应的失业率下降。她说：“8%的国内生产总值增长并不意味着失业率会相应下降。”她指出，农业、制造业、旅游业和科技业都是创造就业机会的巨大潜力领域，但必须加强推动这些领域增长所需的基础设施和支持体系。在农业方面，她说，农民需要获得储存设施、可靠的运输、加工基础设施以及稳定的农产品市场。她补充说，制造商需要负担得起的电力、营运资金和易于进入的市场，才能扩大经营并雇用更多人。Bright女士还敦促政府关注新增就业岗位的质量和可持续性，认为就业统计应当区分长期岗位、临时建筑工作以及培训机会。Bright女士认为，机构履职和营商环境是“新经济”议程取得成功的关键。她说，企业需要可预见的税收政策、及时发放的许可证、可靠的电力，以及政府及时支付其提供服务的款项。她警告称，政府合同结算延误可能破坏企业现金流，限制其扩张和创造就业的能力。她说：“这些日常经营条件决定着企业家能否扩大业务、再雇用10人或20人，还是因为困难重重而原地踏步。”Bright女士还呼吁政府在2030年目标之前作出可量化的承诺，尤其要设定能够在2028年底前接受评估的阶段性指标。她建议每季度、每半年和每年进行审查，以跟踪进展并强化问责。她说：“2030年超出了本届总统任期。制定长期规划非常值得欢迎，这正是我们看待问题的方式。但我们需要明确承诺，说明到2028年底将交付什么成果。”她坚持认为，“新经济”议程能够带来显著效益，但其可信度取决于充足的资金、强有力的机构和有效的落实。她强调：“我支持这一抱负，但我认为我们应当有一套明确的执行计划。”

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111611.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 옥성구 기자 = 한국이 유럽연합(EU)과 중국 등이 참여하는 국제 탄소시장 협력체인 '탄소시장연합'(OCCCM)에 14번째 신규 회원국으로 공식 가입했다. 이에 따라 한국은 탄소시장연합 고위급 회의에서 투표권을 확보하고 국제감축실적과 상쇄배출권 등 국제 탄소시장 규칙 수립 논의에 참여하게 됐다. 김성환 기후에너지환경부 장관은 16일 튀르키예 안탈리아에서 열린 제31차 유엔기후변화협약 당사국총회(COP31)를 계기로 개최된 탄소시장연합 고위급 회의에서 한국의 가입을 공식 발표했다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111611.summary_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者玉成圭＝韩国正式成为有欧洲联盟（EU）、中国等参与的国际碳市场合作机制“碳市场联盟”（OCCCM）第14个新成员国。因此，韩国将在碳市场联盟高级别会议上获得投票权，并参与制定国际减排成果和抵消排放权等国际碳市场规则的讨论。气候能源环境部长官金成焕16日在土耳其安塔利亚举行的《联合国气候变化框架公约》缔约方大会第31届会议（COP31）期间召开的碳市场联盟高级别会议上，正式宣布韩国加入。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111611.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 옥성구 기자 = 한국이 유럽연합(EU)과 중국 등이 참여하는 국제 탄소시장 협력체인 '탄소시장연합'(OCCCM)에 14번째 신규 회원국으로 공식 가입했다. 이에 따라 한국은 탄소시장연합 고위급 회의에서 투표권을 확보하고 국제감축실적과 상쇄배출권 등 국제 탄소시장 규칙 수립 논의에 참여하게 됐다. 김성환 기후에너지환경부 장관은 16일 튀르키예 안탈리아에서 열린 제31차 유엔기후변화협약 당사국총회(COP31)를 계기로 개최된 탄소시장연합 고위급 회의에서 한국의 가입을 공식 발표했다. 탄소시장연합은 온실가스 배출권거래제나 탄소세와 같은 의무 탄소시장 관련 경험을 공유하고, 산정·보고·검증(MRV), 탄소회계, 고품질 상쇄제도 등을 주제로 회원국 간 상호 이해와 협력을 촉진하는 국제협력체다. 지난해 COP30에서 브라질이 제안해 올해 5월 유럽연합(EU)·중국 등 주요 탄소시장 운영국 중심으로 출범했으며, 현재 13개국이 참여하고 있다. 회원국이 되기 위해서는 국가 또는 지역경제통합기구로 국내 의무 탄소시장 또는 탄소가격제를 보유하거나 개발 중이어야 한다. 김 장관은 회원국 가입 발표 발언에서 "대한민국은 2015년 동아시아 최초로 국가 단위 배출권거래제를 도입해 운영해왔다"며 "현재 국가 온실가스 배출량의 70% 이상을 관리하고 있다"고 말했다. 그러면서 "대한민국이 제조업 중심의 산업구조에서 구축한 산정·보고·검증(MRV) 체계와 시장 설계·운영, 배출권거래제 내 상쇄제도 운영 경험 등을 탄소시장연합 회원국과 공유하겠다"고 강조했다. 아울러 김 장관은 한국이 화석연료 기반 경제구조에서 벗어나 무탄소 전원 중심의 '전기국가'로 대전환을 추진하고 있다며, 지난달 정부가 발표한 '대한민국 녹색대전환'(K-GX) 전략을 소개했다. 이번 가입으로 한국은 파리협정 제6조에 따른 국제감축실적(ITMO) 생성과 고신뢰성 상쇄배출권 공통 원칙 수립 등 향후 국제 탄소시장 규칙 논의에 참여할 수 있게 됐다. 이날 고위급 회의에서는 신규 회원국 환영과 함께 탄소시장연합을 의무탄소시장 국제협력의 핵심 구심점으로 발전시키겠다는 내용의 '탄소시장연합 제31차 유엔기후변화협약 당사국총회 선언문'을 채택했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/16 20:30 송고 2026년11월16일 20시30분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111611.title_zh: 韩国加入国际“碳市场联盟”……成为第14个成员国
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111611.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者옥성구报道，韩国正式成为有欧洲联盟（EU）、中国等参与的国际碳市场合作机制“碳市场联盟”（OCCCM）第14个新成员国。韩国由此在碳市场联盟高级别会议上获得投票权，并参与制定国际减排成果、抵消排放权等国际碳市场规则的讨论。气候变化能源环境部长金龙焕16日在土耳其安塔利亚举行的《联合国气候变化框架公约》第31次缔约方大会（COP31）期间召开的碳市场联盟高级别会议上，正式宣布韩国加入。碳市场联盟是分享温室气体排放权交易制度、碳税等强制性碳市场相关经验，并围绕核算、报告和核查（MRV）、碳会计、高质量抵消机制等议题，促进成员国相互理解与合作的国际合作机构。该联盟由巴西在去年的COP30上提议成立，今年5月以欧洲联盟（EU）、中国等主要碳市场运营国为核心启动，目前已有13个国家参与。申请成为成员国须以国家或区域经济一体化组织为单位，拥有或正在开发国内强制性碳市场或碳定价机制。金部长在宣布韩国加入的发言中表示：“大韩民国于2015年率先在东亚引入国家层面的排放权交易制度并持续运行”，“目前管理着国家温室气体排放量的70%以上”。他强调：“韩国将与碳市场联盟成员国分享在制造业为主的产业结构下建立的核算、报告和核查（MRV）体系，以及市场设计、运营和排放权交易制度内抵消机制运营等方面的经验。”金部长还表示，韩国正推动摆脱以化石燃料为基础的经济结构，转型为以无碳电源为中心的“电气国家”，并介绍了政府上月公布的“大韩民国绿色转型”（K-GX）战略。通过此次加入，韩国得以参与今后国际碳市场规则的讨论，包括制定依据《巴黎协定》第6条生成国际减排成果（ITMO）以及高可信度抵消排放权共同原则等。当天的高级别会议还通过了《碳市场联盟第31次联合国气候变化框架公约缔约方大会宣言》，其中提出欢迎新成员国加入，并将碳市场联盟发展成为强制性碳市场国际合作的核心枢纽。报道可通过KakaoTalk okjebo获取。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、翻印及用于人工智能训练和利用。2026/11/16 20:30发稿，2026年11月16日20时30分发稿。

https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cmqx5.summary_zh: 尼日利亚总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布批准在新安全计划下增招28,000名士兵和50,000名警察，以应对尼日利亚的安全局势。他表示，总统已批准一项为期五年的安全计划，旨在强化国家安全部队，提高其应对恐怖主义、武装劫持、绑架及其他犯罪的能力。
https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cmqx5.body: Gwamnatin Shugaba Bola Ahmed Tinubu ta amince da ɗaukar ƙarin sojoji 28,000 da jami'an 'yan sanda 50,000 a wani bangare na sabon shirin da take yi na yaƙi da matsalar tsaro a Najeriya. Mai magana da yawun kwamitin yaƙin neman zaben shugaban ƙasa na jam'iyyar APCn, Dele Alake, ne ya bayyana hakan cikin wata sanarwa da ya fitar a Abuja ranar Lahadi, 15 ga watan Nuwamban 2026. Ya ce matakan na cikin wani shirin samar da tsaro na shekaru biyar da Shugaba Tinubu ya amince da shi, domin ƙarfafa rundunonin tsaron kasar da inganta yadda suke tunkarar matsalolin ta'addanci, da fashi da makami, da garkuwa da mutane da sauran laifuka. Sanarwar ta ce shirin zai mayar da hankali kan matakai biyar da suka hada da: Mataki na farko shi ne ƙara yawan jami'an tsaro ta hanyar daukar karin sojoji 28,000 da 'yan sanda 50,000. Haka kuma, gwamnatin ta samar da sabbin rundunonin sojoji guda huɗu tare da sake fasalin wasu rundunonin da ake da su, domin fadada ayyukan soji da bai wa dakarun damar kai dauki cikin gaggawa a wuraren da ake fama da matsalar tsaro. Sanarwar ta ce Shugaba Tinubu ya kuma amince da gina ƙarin cibiyoyin horas da sojoji guda biyu a Osogbo, da ke jihar Osun, da kuma Amasiri-Edda a jihar Ebonyi. An ce kowace cibiyar tana da damar horas da sababbin sojoji 6,000 a lokaci guda, wanda hakan zai sa a rika horas da sojoji 12,000 a cibiyoyin biyu. Mataki na biyu shi ne inganta tattara bayanan sirri da amfani da fasaha wajen gano barazanar tsaro tun kafin ta faru. Gwamnatin ta ce shirin zai samar da ingantacciyar hanyar haɗa bayanai tsakanin hukumomin tsaro, tare da tabbatar da cewa ana amfani da bayanan da aka tattara wajen tsara ayyukan soji da daukar matakan da suka dace. Wannan mataki na daga cikin kokarin gwamnatin na sauya tsarin yaki da rashin tsaro zuwa wanda ya fi dogaro da bayanan sirri, sa ido da kuma dakile barazana tun kafin ta rikide zuwa babbar matsala. Mataki na uku shi ne kara daidaita ayyukan rundunonin soji da sauran hukumomin tsaro domin kauce wa rashin fahimta da matsalolin rashin musayar bayanai. Sanarwar ta ce shirin zai samar da tsarin da zai bai wa hukumomin tsaro damar hada karfi da karfe wajen tunkarar matsalolin ta'addanci, da 'yan bindiga, da masu garkuwa da mutane da sauran masu aikata laifuka. Mataki na hudu shi ne karfafa karfin rundunonin tsaro ta fuskar horaswa, da samar da kayan aiki da inganta yanayin aikin jami'an tsaro. Gwamnatin ta ce tana kuma zuba jari wajen gina muhallan zama na sojoji da sauran muhimman kayayyakin more rayuwa da za su taimaka wajen inganta aikinsu. Daya daga cikin irin wadannan ayyuka shi ne gina barikin sojoji mai gidaje 700 a Ikere-Ekiti, da ke jihar Ekiti. A cewar sanarwar, wannan mataki zai taimaka wajen samar wa jami'an tsaro yanayin zama da aiki mai kyau, tare da inganta karfin rundunonin wajen gudanar da ayyukansu. Mataki na biyar shi ne tabbatar da cewa ana amfani da kudaden da ake warewa bangaren tsaro bisa bukatun da ake da su da kuma barazanar da kasar ke fuskanta. Sanarwar ta ce shirin zai taimaka wajen gano gibin da ake da shi a bangaren tsaro, tantance kayan aikin da ake bukata da kuma tabbatar da cewa ana amfani da kudaden yadda ya kamata ba tare da almubazzaranci ba. Tasharmu ta WhatsApp Yanzu za ku iya samun labaran BBC Hausa kai-tsaye a wayoyinku. A cewar Dr Kabiru Adamu, masanin harkokin tsaro a Najeriya, wannan ne karon farko da aka tsara wani cikakken shiri irin wannan, wanda ya fayyace matakan da za a bi wajen magance matsalar rashin tsaro da kuma yadda za a aiwatar da su dalla-dalla. Ya ce an tsara shirin ne domin ya zama taswirar da za a bi wajen yaki da matsalar tsaro a Najeriya cikin shekaru biyar masu zuwa. Ya ƙara da cewa: "Wannan shiri zai zama ma'aunin da za a rika amfani da shi wajen tantance kokarin da ake yi na magance matsalar tsaro. Za a iya duba shi a kowane lokaci domin a tantance ko an samu ci gaba ko ba a samu ba." Sai dai wani abin da ke janyo tambayoyi shi ne cewa Shugaba Tinubu zai sake neman wa'adin mulki a zaɓen da ke tafe, kuma ba a san ko zai ci gaba da mulki ba. Wannan ya sa wasu ke nuna shakku kan yadda za a ci gaba da aiwatar da shirin da kuma makomarsa idan aka samu sauyin gwamnati. Sai dai Dr Adamu ya ce shirin bai kamata ya tsaya ga gwamnatin Tinubu kawai ba, domin duk wanda ya karɓi ragamar mulkin Najeriya a nan gaba ya kamata ya ɗauke shi a matsayin wani muhimmin tsarin da ya dace a ci gaba da aiwatarwa, har sai an shawo kan matsalar rashin tsaro a ƙasar
https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cmqx5.title_zh: Tinubu 抵达 Matakai，接手五年前未完成的安全治理任务
https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cmqx5.body_zh:
尼日利亚总统舒加巴·博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布批准增派28,000名士兵和50,000名警察，参加一项旨在应对国内安全局势的新计划。尼日利亚执政党APC全国主席竞选委员会发言人Dele Alake周日在阿布贾发表声明，宣布了这项决定。他表示，这是蒂努布总统批准的五年期安全计划的一部分，旨在加强国家安全部队，提高其应对恐怖主义、武装劫持、绑架及其他犯罪的能力。

声明称，该计划将重点实施五个阶段：第一阶段是通过增派28,000名士兵和50,000名警察，增加安全人员规模。同时，政府将新建4个士兵营区，并整修现有营区，以扩大军队部署，并让部队能够迅速进驻安全形势紧张的地区。声明称，蒂努布总统还批准在奥孙州Osogbo和埃博尼州Amasiri-Edda增建两个士兵训练营。每个训练营一次可训练6,000名新兵，因此两处训练营合计可容纳12,000名士兵接受训练。

第二阶段是加强情报收集能力，并利用技术手段在威胁发生前识别安全风险。政府表示，该计划将建立安全机构之间的情报协调机制，并确保收集的情报用于规划军事行动和采取适当措施。这是政府将反恐模式从依赖安全部队，转向结合情报、监视和威胁预警，以在问题演变成重大安全危机前加以遏制的努力之一。

第三阶段是加强军队与其他安全机构的协同配合，以避免行动期间因信息不一致而出现误解。声明称，该计划将建立一套机制，使安全机构能够联合应对恐怖主义、持枪犯罪、绑架及其他犯罪活动。

第四阶段是通过训练提升安全部队的能力，并提供装备，改善安全人员的工作条件。政府表示还将投入资金建设士兵宿舍及其他重要生活设施，以帮助提高其工作效率。其中一项工程是在埃基蒂州Ikere-Ekiti建设一座可容纳700名士兵的宿舍。声明称，此举将为安全人员创造良好的工作和生活条件，并提升部队执行任务的能力。

第五阶段是确保依照需求和安全威胁合理使用安全部门获得的资金。声明称，该计划将帮助确定安全部门的资金分配，包括所需装备，并确保资金得到适当使用，不存在腐败现象。

订阅WhatsApp消息，即可直接在手机上获取BBC Hausa报道。

尼日利亚安全事务专家Dr Kabiru Adamu表示，这是政府首次制定此类完整计划，明确了应对安全问题的具体步骤和实施方式。他说，该计划旨在成为未来五年打击尼日利亚安全问题的行动路线图。他补充道：“这项计划将成为持续用于评估解决安全问题努力成果的工具。人们随时都可以用它来检验是否取得了进展。”

不过，仍有一个问题引发疑问，即蒂努布总统是否会在下一届选举中再次竞选连任，目前尚不清楚。这也令一些人对政府更迭后如何继续落实该计划及其成效表示怀疑。

但Dr Adamu表示，该计划不应仅仅停留在蒂努布政府层面，因为未来任何接管尼日利亚政府的人都应将其视为必须继续落实的重要框架，直至全国安全问题得到解决……

https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghanas-2027-.summary_zh: 《2027年预算》提出的加纳“新经济、新加纳”框架第三大支柱，旨在彻底改革国家能源架构。核能准备计划：《2027年预算》正式启动加纳向核能基荷电力转型的进程，将未来核电站定位为战略国家资产，而非独立发电商。《2027年预算声明与经济政策》标志着加纳坚定转向能源自主。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghanas-2027-.body: The intersection of energy reliability and industrial capacity remains the most critical determinant of economic growth in developing economies. Historically, Ghana's energy system has expanded, yet it has been burdened by high tariffs, distribution losses, weak revenue collections, and accumulated obligations to Independent Power Producers (IPPs). In 2025, the annual energy sector shortfall reached approximately US$1.4 billion, with arrears to IPPs and fuel suppliers standing at US$1.7 billion. Ghana's 2027 Budget Statement and Economic Policy appears to introduce a paradigm shift. The budget outlines a decisive move toward energy sovereignty, anchoring national industrialisation on state-owned, affordable, and reliable power generation. This article details the specific energy infrastructure projects, funding allocations, and policy frameworks embedded in the 2027 budget. Pillar Three of the New Economy, New Ghana framework in the 2027 budget is dedicated to overhauling the national energy architecture. The government has allocated US$2 billion to this pillar, aiming to end dependence on costly emergency power by 2030 and reduce generation costs from 16 US cents per kilowatt-hour (kWh) to 8 US cents/kWh or less. To secure baseload and peak power demands, the government is investing heavily in state-owned generation assets: • 1,450 MW Thermal Power Plant: Construction will commence in December 2026 at Kafodzidzi Abrobeano in the Central Region. The plant will be fully state-funded and owned. The first 600 MW will be operational by December 2028, and the remaining 850 MW by December 2030. It will utilise approximately 150 million standard cubic feet of additional gas per day from the Sankofa and Jubilee fields. • 600 MW Solar Power Plant & Battery Storage: A fully state-owned 600 MW solar facility will be constructed, supported by a massive 2,000 megawatt-hours (MWh) of battery storage. This storage capacity is designed to shift daytime solar generation into peak evening periods, ensuring grid stability. Recognising that generation capacity must be matched by efficient transmission and distribution, the budget outlines strict policy sequencing. • Transmission Modernisation: US$500 million is allocated from 2027 to 2030 to modernise the transmission system. GRIDCo will utilise these funds to strengthen the north-south network, connect new generation to demand centres, and provide dedicated connections to strategic industrial enclaves. • Distribution Efficiency: To combat distribution losses, the government will deploy 2 million prepaid meters. Furthermore, a performance-based private-sector participation model in electricity distribution will be fully implemented by the end of 2027, protecting strategic public assets while leveraging private-sector expertise. Nuclear Energy Readiness Programme The 2027 budget officially initiates Ghana's transition to nuclear baseload power, treating the future plant as a strategic national asset rather than an IPP. • Funding & Timeline: US$200 million is dedicated to a 24-month nuclear-readiness programme running from January 2027 to December 2028. • By December 2028, the goal is to complete site studies, technology selection, environmental assessments, financing, and licensing preparations, culminating in the signing of the EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) and financing contract. • The programme includes the training of over 2,000 scientists to build local expertise, ensuring technology transfer and domestic capability. Synergy with Industrialisation (Pillar Four: US$1.5 Billion Critical Minerals) Energy capacity is economic capacity. The energy infrastructure developed under Pillar Three is explicitly designed to power Pillar Four: a US$1.5 Billion investment in Critical Minerals Value Addition. The budget proposes creating a 24-hour critical-minerals processing enclave in the Western Region, powered directly by the new energy backbone. Key policy targets include: • Refining at least 70% of artisanal and small-scale (ASM) gold locally by December 2027, and 100% by December 2028 (prohibiting raw ASM gold exports). • Processing 50% of manganese and bauxite locally by 2028, and 100% by 2030. • Constructing a new railway line from Takoradi to Nyinahin (starting 2027) to transport minerals to the processing enclave. The following table and chart detail the specific financial commitments outlined in the 2027 Budget Statement regarding energy and related industrial infrastructure. The 2027 Budget Statement and Economic Policy represents a definitive pivot towards energy sovereignty for Ghana. By allocating US$2 billion to energy infrastructure and US$1.5 billion to mineral value addition, the government aims to eliminate the US$1.4 billion annual fiscal drain caused by energy sector shortfalls. Through strategic investments in state-owned generation, grid modernisation, and nuclear readiness, Ghana is laying the foundational infrastructure required to transition from an exporter of raw materials to a hub of green industrialisation and value-added manufacturing
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghanas-2027-.title_zh: 加纳2027年预算：投资加纳能源的未来
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghanas-2027-.body_zh: 能源可靠性与工业产能的结合，仍是决定发展中经济体经济增长的最关键因素。历史上，加纳的能源体系不断扩张，但一直受到高电价、配电损耗、收入回收不足以及对独立发电商（IPP）累积债务的拖累。2025年，能源行业年度资金缺口达到约14亿美元，拖欠独立发电商和燃料供应商的款项达17亿美元。加纳《2027年预算声明和经济政策》似乎带来了一种范式转变。预算提出果断迈向能源自主，并将国家工业化建立在国有、价格可负担且可靠的电力生产之上。本文详细介绍2027年预算中涉及的具体能源基础设施项目、资金分配和政策框架。《新经济、新加纳》框架第三大支柱着力于全面改造国家能源体系。政府已为该支柱拨款20亿美元，目标是到2030年结束对昂贵应急供电的依赖，并将发电成本从每千瓦时（kWh）16美分降至每千瓦时8美分或更低。为保障基荷电力和峰值电力需求，政府正大举投资国有发电资产：• 1,450 MW热电站：该电站将于2026年12月在中部地区Kafodzidzi Abrobeano开工建设，由国家全额出资并拥有。首批600 MW装机将于2028年12月投入运营，其余850 MW将于2030年12月投运。电站每天将使用Sankofa和Jubilee油气田新增供应的约1.5亿标准立方英尺天然气。• 600 MW太阳能发电厂及电池储能设施：将建设一座完全由国家拥有的600 MW太阳能设施，并配套容量达2,000兆瓦时（MWh）的大型电池储能系统。该储能容量旨在把白天的太阳能发电转移至傍晚用电高峰时段，确保电网稳定。鉴于发电能力必须与高效输配电相匹配，预算提出了严格的政策实施顺序。• 输电现代化：2027年至2030年间将拨款5亿美元用于输电系统现代化。GRIDCo将利用这笔资金加强南北输电网络，把新增发电能力接入需求中心，并为战略工业集聚区提供专用供电线路。• 配电效率：为减少配电损耗，政府将安装200万只预付费电表。此外，以绩效为基础的电力配电私营部门参与模式将于2027年底全面实施，在利用私营部门专业知识的同时保护战略公共资产。核能准备计划2027年预算正式启动加纳向核能基荷电力转型的进程，并将未来核电站定位为战略国家资产，而非独立发电商项目。• 资金与时间表：2亿美元将专门用于为期24个月的核能准备计划，实施时间为2027年1月至2028年12月。• 计划目标是到2028年12月完成选址研究、技术选择、环境评估、融资和许可准备工作，最终签署EPC（工程、采购、施工）及融资合同。• 该计划包括培训2,000多名科学家，以培养本地专业能力，确保实现技术转让并建立国内能力。与工业化的协同（第四大支柱：15亿美元关键矿产）能源能力就是经济能力。第三大支柱下建设能源基础设施，明确旨在为第四大支柱提供电力，即为关键矿产增值投入15亿美元。预算提议在西部地区建立一个24小时运转的关键矿产加工园区，由新的能源骨干网直接供电。主要政策目标包括：• 到2027年12月，至少在本地精炼70%的手工采金和小规模采矿（ASM）黄金，到2028年12月达到100%，同时禁止出口未经加工的手工采金和小规模采矿原金。• 到2028年，在本地加工50%的锰和铝土矿，到2030年达到100%。• 从Takoradi到Nyinahin修建一条新铁路（2027年开工），将矿产运往加工园区。下表和图表详细列出了《2027年预算声明和经济政策》就能源及相关工业基础设施提出的具体资金承诺。《2027年预算声明和经济政策》代表加纳正式转向能源自主。政府为能源基础设施拨款20亿美元，并为矿产增值投入15亿美元，目标是消除能源行业资金缺口每年造成的14亿美元财政流失。通过对国有发电、电网现代化和核能准备进行战略投资，加纳正在奠定必要的基础设施，推动国家从原材料出口国转型为绿色工业化和增值制造业中心。

His remarks came as China continued to exert maritime pressure in the South China Sea, a strategic waterway through which trillions of dollars in trade pass annually and where Philippine and Chinese vessels have been involved in recurring collisions and confrontations. Beijing’s claim is based on a nine-dash line map dating to the 1940s that encompasses the Philippines’ exclusive economic zone (EEZ), part of which Manila calls the West Philippine Sea. A United Nations-backed tribunal invalidated China’s claim in 2016, ruling that it had no legal basis under international law. “Strategic competition must never make coercion an accepted means of managing differences,” he said. “Preventing armed conflict remains essential, but preventing the gradual erosion of regional maritime order is primordial.” And he noted that a five-year horizon through 2031 will prove decisive in determining whether international rules prevail over “coercion and unilateral actions” in the South China Sea. “Several developments will shape this period, including China’s continuing military modernization, the Philippines’ next national security planning cycle, and Asean’s implementation of regional economic and security priorities,” Oban said. https://leadership.ng/2027-kaduna-govt-g.body: The commissioner for local government and chieftaincy affairs, Hon. Sadiq Mamman Lagos, who presented the vehicles on behalf of the state government, charged the beneficiaries to use them for grassroots mobilisation and ensure electoral victory for the party. He said the distribution was part of efforts to strengthen the party’s structures and enable its officials to reach communities, wards and polling units to canvass support for APC candidates. Mamman Lagos said similar distributions had been carried out in Zones Two and Three, adding that the exercise aimed to improve the party’s mobilisation capacity across the state. “We have done Zones Two and Three, and now we are doing Zone One. We are distributing these vehicles to you because we want you to deliver Zone One to us,” he said. He urged the beneficiaries to use the vehicles for peaceful, issue-based campaigns, voter education and public enlightenment. The commissioner also charged them with visiting communities, explaining the programmes and achievements of APC-led governments, and convincing residents to support the party through constructive engagement. Also speaking, former Kaduna State Governor and APC senatorial candidate for Kaduna North, Mukhtar Ramalan Yero, described the distribution as a welcome development, saying logistical support was necessary for effective grassroots mobilisation. He said the vehicles would enable party officials to reach communities and canvass support for candidates ahead of the elections. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism will host a forum Tuesday on how artificial intelligence (AI) is being used in culture, sports and tourism and on how these sectors should shift to AI. The ministry said Monday the fourth Culture, Sports and Tourism Digital Innovation Forum, themed “New Culture Through AI,” will be held at L Tower in Seoul’s Seocho District. About 400 people from government, public institutions and the private sector are expected to attend. State-affiliated bodies are co-organizing the event, including the Korea Culture Information Service Agency, Arts Council Korea, the Korea Sports Promotion Foundation, the Korea Tourism Organization and the Korea Creative Content Agency. The forum will open with an awards ceremony for 15 winners of an AI and cultural data contest. They were chosen in five categories across three fields: new technology, cultural data use and data analysis. Five winners will receive the culture minister’s award. Winning entries include an AI service that lets users talk with historical figures based on historical records and an AI service that rearranges music for people with cochlear implants. Another is a customized AI service for children based on traditional folk tales. A Sungkyunkwan University professor will give the keynote speech on how to live in a world being reshaped by AI. Four breakout sessions will follow on AI in culture and sports, the arts, tourism and content. Topics include responsible use of AI in artistic creation, robots and real-time translation in tourism and AI strategies for visual effects and gaming. At booths in the venue, visitors can try generative AI photo services, AI-based body shape analysis with personalized workout recommendations and real-time interpretation. “The ministry will continue to expand the use of cultural data and support the AI transition in the field to spread digital innovation that people can feel,” a ministry official said. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Pulmuone Food & Culture opened its first overseas contract catering operation in the United States, bringing Korean food to a workplace in Arizona as the company looks to expand its food service business across North America. The food service subsidiary of Pulmuone said Monday that it began operating a cafeteria at a Korean conglomerate's facility in Queen Creek, Arizona, marking its first overseas contract catering operation. The operation is run through Pulmuone FNC USA, the company's U.S. subsidiary established in January, and occupies 175 pyeong, or about 578 square meters, including dining and kitchen areas. The cafeteria currently serves lunch and dinner, with menus designed for both Korean employees and local staff. Its offerings follow a dual-track approach, combining traditional Korean dishes with familiar American meals. Korean options include galbijjim, or braised short ribs, and kimchi jjigae, a stew made from the pungent cabbage pickle, along with side dishes, gimbap and instant noodles. The facility also features a Korean Station serving restaurant-style dishes, a Grab & Go section for convenient Korean meals and a Private Dining Room offering full Korean meal sets. An American Station provides familiar local dishes for employees who prefer Western-style food. The company said the approach is intended to give Korean employees convenient access to familiar meals while introducing American workers to the cuisine amid growing local interest in Korean food culture. Lee Dong-hoon, CEO of Pulmuone Food & Culture, said the opening marked an important step in bringing the company's domestic catering expertise to overseas markets. “Launching our first North American operation is highly significant because it marks our first step into overseas markets, backed by recognition of the contract catering capabilities and menu competitiveness we have developed in Korea,” Lee said. “We will work to establish our first overseas operation quickly and grow into a competitive food service company in global markets,” he said. Pulmuone Food & Culture plans to use the Arizona operation as a base for expanding into facilities run by other Korean companies in North America. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title: NNPC’s ₦210 trillion question: Not missing is not the same as accounted for, By Posi Olatubosun
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary: Reviewing NNPC’s audited financial statements from 2017 to 2023, the committee identified about ₦103 trillion recorded as accrued expenses and about ₦107 trillion recorded as sundry receivables. NNPC’s former Chief Financial Officer told the committee that the company’s total revenue between 2017 and 2023 was about ₦54.5 trillion. He offered this as proof that ₦210 trillion could not be missing.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary_zh: 委员会审查了尼日利亚国家石油公司2017年至2023年的经审计财务报表，发现约₦103万亿被记作应计费用，约₦107万亿被记作其他应收款。尼日利亚国家石油公司前首席财务官向委员会表示，公司2017年至2023年的总收入约为₦54.5万亿。他以此为证，说明不可能有₦210万亿不翼而飞。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: The facts are not in dispute. Reviewing NNPC’s audited financial statements from 2017 to 2023, the committee identified about ₦103 trillion recorded as accrued expenses and about ₦107 trillion recorded as sundry receivables. The accrued expenses, according to lawmakers, covered items such as retention fees, legal fees and audit fees without specific breakdowns, and NNPC linked part of them to joint venture cash calls. The committee rejected that explanation, noting that the cash call regime had been abolished with effect from January 2017. The receivables, NNPC said, were owed by defunct banks and other entities, yet no debtors or amounts were named. At about $117 billion, the receivables alone are larger than the economy of many African countries. To understand why both sides can claim to be right, we must be clear about what these accounting terms mean, and this is where the public debate has gone astray. Accrued expenses are liabilities: costs the company says it has incurred but not yet paid. Receivables are assets: amounts the company says others owe it. Neither represents cash that has left the company. In that narrow sense, the former officials are correct that ₦210 trillion has not “disappeared”. But the narrow sense is the wrong test. The real test in accounting is whether a balance is supported by evidence. A liability nobody can itemise and an asset nobody can identify are not bookkeeping details; they are red flags. Consider the scale. NNPC’s former Chief Financial Officer told the committee that the company’s total revenue between 2017 and 2023 was about ₦54.5 trillion. He offered this as proof that ₦210 trillion could not be missing. Yet the same figure raises a harder question. How can a company accrue unpaid expenses of ₦103 trillion, almost twice its total revenue over seven years? How can it claim receivables of ₦107 trillion from debtors it will not name? Either these balances include large items that are not what their labels suggest, or they reflect unreconciled entries that have accumulated, possibly on both sides of the balance sheet, over many years. Neither explanation inspires confidence. The first concern, therefore, is the quality of the accounts. Under the International Financial Reporting Standards that NNPC applies, receivables must be assessed for recoverability. A debt owed by a bank that no longer exists is, by definition, unlikely to be collected, and should be impaired. If ₦107 trillion of receivables cannot be traced to identifiable debtors, the asset side of NNPC’s balance sheet may be materially overstated. Equally, accrued liabilities must be supported by obligations the company can identify and measure. Unsupported accruals are not prudence; they are a failure of control. The second concern is the role of the external auditors. The committee chairman put the question bluntly: if reconciliation was not done, why did the auditors sign off on the financial statements? International Standards on Auditing require auditors to obtain sufficient, appropriate evidence for material balances, including confirmations for significant receivables and support for accounting estimates. Where they cannot, they are expected to modify their opinion. In July, the committee gave NNPC’s auditors one week to provide a complete schedule of every component of the receivables and payables, and rejected their claims of confidentiality. Auditors are paid to stand behind the figures they certify. Nigerians are entitled to know what evidence supported these balances and what opinion was given. The third concern is governance. The dispute has dragged on for months, with written explanations rejected, summonses ignored and, in June, a warrant of arrest issued against Mr Kyari after he failed to appear. Whatever the merits of each side’s arguments, a public company that cannot produce a schedule of its own receivables after months of parliamentary scrutiny has a governance problem. The committee has raised other queries too, including about ₦5 trillion charged as direct production costs between 2017 and 2021 and an alleged ₦3.8 trillion duplication of subsidy deductions. Each deserves a documented answer, not a press statement. The fourth concern is the market. NNPC has signalled its intention to list on the stock exchange. After the success of the Dangote refinery offer, Nigerians have shown real appetite for owning shares in national energy assets. But no serious investor will buy into a company whose balance sheet contains ₦210 trillion of unexplained entries. Credible accounts are not a favour to the Senate; they are the price of access to capital. What should happen now? Four steps are needed, and each addresses a distinct weakness this dispute has exposed. First, NNPC should publish a full reconciliation of both balances, itemised by counterparty, date and nature, with supporting evidence. This is the starting point because every other step depends on it. A reconciliation turns two aggregate numbers into a list of specific claims that can be checked: who owes NNPC money, whom NNPC owes, since when and for what. It would quickly separate genuine obligations, such as amounts due from joint venture partners or government agencies, from legacy entries that no longer have any basis. Publication matters as much as preparation. NNPC manages the nation’s oil wealth on behalf of all Nigerians, so its accountability runs not only to the Senate but to the public. Months of written explanations exchanged behind closed doors have not settled the matter; open disclosure would. Second, an independent forensic audit, by a firm with no prior relationship with NNPC, should verify that reconciliation. A reconciliation prepared by management is only as credible as those who prepare it, and the same institution produced the balances now in question. A statutory audit tests whether financial statements are fairly presented; a forensic audit goes further, tracing transactions to their source documents and establishing whether any loss, error or misconduct occurred. Independence is essential. Firms that audited or advised NNPC during the affected years cannot credibly review their own work. Only an investigator with no stake in the outcome can produce an answer the public will accept. Third, the Financial Reporting Council of Nigeria should review the conduct of the audits for the affected years and act where standards were not met. Audit exists to give users of accounts reasonable assurance that material balances are supported by evidence. If auditors certified ₦210 trillion of balances without sufficient evidence, the failure is not only NNPC’s; it is a failure of the assurance system on which investors, lenders and citizens rely. The Council is the regulator charged with overseeing audit quality. Holding auditors to account in a case of this prominence would send a clear signal to the profession and strengthen confidence in every audited account in Nigeria, not just NNPC’s. Fourth, any receivables that cannot be substantiated should be impaired and any unsupported accruals reversed, with the effect on past results disclosed transparently. Financial statements must reflect economic reality. Carrying uncollectable receivables overstates assets and equity, while unsupported accruals distort liabilities and past profits. Both give a misleading picture of the company’s financial health and of what it should be remitting to the Federation Account. Correcting the balances under the relevant standards, including restating prior periods under IAS 8 where the errors are material, would give NNPC a clean starting point. Disclosing the effect openly would show that the company is prepared to confront its past rather than bury it, which is the minimum any future investor will expect. Ultimately, the issue is not whether ₦210 trillion was stolen; it is whether the national oil company’s accounts can be trusted at all. An entity that manages the country’s most valuable resource on behalf of every Nigerian must meet the highest standard of financial reporting, not the lowest. “Bookkeeping issues” on this scale are not a technicality to be explained away. They are a failure of accountability that must be fixed, transparently and in full, before NNPC asks Nigerians to trust it with their savings. Posi Olatubosun is a UK-based academic faculty member in accounting and finance
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司的210万亿奈拉之问：未失踪并不等于已有交代，作者：波西·奥拉图博松
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body_zh:
事实并无争议。审查尼日利亚国家石油公司2017年至2023年的经审计财务报表后，委员会发现约₦103万亿被记为应计费用，约₦107万亿被记为其他应收款。据议员称，这些应计费用包括保留费、律师费和审计费等项目，但没有具体明细；尼日利亚国家石油公司则将其中一部分与合资项目资本催缴款挂钩。委员会驳斥了这一解释，指出资本催缴制度自2017年1月起已经废除。尼日利亚国家石油公司称，这些应收款是已倒闭银行及其他实体所欠，但既未列明债务人，也未列明金额。仅应收款一项就约合1170亿美元，超过许多非洲国家的经济规模。要理解双方为何都能声称自己正确，就必须弄清楚这些会计术语的含义，而公众辩论的偏差恰恰在于此。应计费用是负债，即公司声称已经发生但尚未支付的成本。应收款是资产，即公司声称他人欠付给自己的款项。两者均不代表已经离开公司的现金。从这个狭义角度看，前任官员的说法是正确的，即₦210万亿并没有“消失”。但狭义标准并非正确标准。会计领域的真正标准，是一项余额是否有证据支持。无人能够逐项列明的负债和无人能够确认的资产，并非无关紧要的记账细节，而是危险信号。

Consider the scale. 尼日利亚国家石油公司前首席财务官告诉委员会，公司2017年至2023年的总收入约为₦54.5万亿。他以此证明₦210万亿不可能不翼而飞。然而，同一个数字也提出了一个更难回答的问题。一家公司怎么可能计提₦103万亿的未付费用，这几乎相当于其七年总收入的两倍？它又怎么可能声称拥有₦107万亿的应收款，却拒绝透露债务人身份？这些余额要么包含与其标签所示含义不符的大额项目，要么反映了多年来累积、且可能同时出现在资产负债表两侧的未核对分录。两种解释都无法令人信服。

因此，第一项关切是账目的质量。根据尼日利亚国家石油公司采用的《国际财务报告准则》，应收款必须评估可收回性。一家已不复存在的银行所欠债务，按定义就不太可能收回，因此应当计提减值。如果₦107万亿的应收款无法追溯至可识别的债务人，那么尼日利亚国家石油公司资产负债表的资产端可能被严重高估。同样，应计负债必须由公司能够识别和计量的义务提供支持。缺乏依据的应计项目不是审慎，而是控制失效。

第二项关切是外部审计师的作用。委员会主席直截了当地提出问题：如果没有进行核对，审计师为何仍会在财务报表上签字？《国际审计准则》要求审计师为重大余额获取充分、适当的证据，包括对重大应收款实施函证，以及取得会计估计的支持证据。在无法取得这些证据时，审计师应当修改审计意见。7月，委员会要求尼日利亚国家石油公司的审计师在一周内提供应收款和应付款各项组成部分的完整明细表，并驳回了他们以保密为由提出的异议。审计师领取报酬，就应当为自己所认证的数字负责。尼日利亚人民有权知道，这些余额得到了哪些证据支持，以及审计师出具了何种意见。

第三项关切是治理。这场争端已持续数月，书面解释遭到驳回，传票无人理会；6月，Kyari先生因未出庭而被签发逮捕令。无论双方论据的实质如何，一家公众公司在接受议会数月审查后，仍无法提供自身应收款的明细表，就存在治理问题。委员会还提出了其他疑问，包括2017年至2021年计入直接生产成本的₦5万亿，以及据称重复计算补贴扣减的₦3.8万亿。每项疑问都应得到有文件依据的答复，而不是新闻声明。

第四项关切是市场。尼日利亚国家石油公司已表示有意在证券交易所上市。丹格特炼厂发行获得成功后，尼日利亚人民已表现出持有国家能源资产股票的强烈意愿。但任何认真的投资者都不会投资一家资产负债表含有₦210万亿无法解释分录的公司。可信的账目不是参议院的恩惠，而是获得资本的代价。

现在该怎么办？需要采取四个步骤，每一步都针对这场争端暴露出的不同弱点。第一，尼日利亚国家石油公司应公布对两项余额的完整核对结果，并按交易对手、日期和性质逐项列明，同时提供支持证据。这是起点，因为其他每一步都依赖于此。核对会把两个汇总数字转化为可核查的具体债权清单：谁欠尼日利亚国家石油公司钱，尼日利亚国家石油公司欠谁的钱，欠了多久，因何而产生。它能迅速将合资伙伴或政府机构应付的款项等真实义务，与已经毫无依据的历史遗留分录区分开来。公布与编制同样重要。尼日利亚国家石油公司代表全体尼日利亚人民管理国家石油财富，因此它不仅对参议院负责，也对公众负责。数月来在闭门情况下 exchanged 的书面解释未能解决争端；公开披露则可以。

第二，应由一家与尼日利亚国家石油公司此前没有任何关系的公司开展独立法证审计，核验上述核对结果。由管理层编制的核对结果，其可信度取决于编制者，而相关余额正是同一机构形成的。法定审计检验财务报表是否得到公允列报；法证审计则更进一步，将交易追溯至原始凭证，并确定是否发生了损失、差错或不当行为。独立性至关重要。在受影响年度为尼日利亚国家石油公司提供审计或咨询服务的公司，无法令人信服地审查自己的成果。只有对调查结果没有任何利害关系的调查者，才能给出公众接受的答案。

第三，尼日利亚财务报告委员会应审查受影响年度审计工作的执行情况，并在审计标准未得到遵守时采取行动。审计的存在，是为了向账目使用者合理保证重大余额有证据支持。如果审计师在没有充分证据的情况下认证了₦210万亿的余额，失责的就不仅是尼日利亚国家石油公司，也是投资者、贷款人和公民赖以信赖的审计保证体系的失败。委员会是负责监督审计质量的监管机构。在如此引人注目的案件中追究审计师责任，将向审计行业发出明确信号，并增强公众对尼日利亚所有经审计账目的信心，而不只是对尼日利亚国家石油公司账目的信心。

第四，任何无法得到证实的应收款都应计提减值，任何缺乏支持的应计项目都应予冲销，并透明披露其对以往业绩的影响。财务报表必须反映经济现实。结转无法收回的应收款会高估资产和权益，而缺乏支持的应计项目会扭曲负债和以往利润。两者都会对公司财务健康状况及其应向联邦账户上缴的款项作出误导性描绘。依据相关准则更正这些余额，包括在错误金额重大时依据《国际会计准则第8号》重述以前期间，将为尼日利亚国家石油公司提供一个干净的起点。公开披露相关影响，将表明公司愿意面对过去，而不是将其掩盖；这也是未来任何投资者都会提出的最低要求。

归根结底，问题不在于₦210万亿是否遭到盗用，而在于国家石油公司的账目究竟能否信赖。一家代表每一位尼日利亚人民管理国家最宝贵资源的实体，必须达到财务报告的最高标准，而不是最低标准。如此规模的“记账问题”不是可以用技术性理由搪塞过去的细节，而是必须透明、彻底予以修复的失责问题，然后尼日利亚国家石油公司才能要求人民继续信任它管理自己的积蓄。Posi Olatubosun是一名常驻英国的会计与金融学教师。

MANILA, Philippines – Chinese Premier Li Qiang on Monday, November 16, hailed what he called “truly extraordinary” achievements of China and Southeast Asia in the face of global trade restrictions, expressing Beijing’s commitment to free trade at a summit ahead of US President Donald Trump’s arrival. In remarks to leaders of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations in Manila, Li said that at a time of growing unilateralism and protectionism and recurring geopolitical conflict, economic relations between China and ASEAN had only strengthened. “The past five years have been truly extraordinary, and the achievements we scored have not come easily,” he said, citing annual trade with the 11-member ASEAN last year of more than $1 trillion and cumulative two-way investment of more than $500 billion. “We remain firmly committed to safeguarding multilateralism and promoting free trade and endeavor to make the pie bigger,” he said. China is ASEAN’s biggest trading partner and a key source of investment, but the biggest economies of the bloc — which has a combined GDP of more than $3.9 trillion – are keen to expand ties with the United States amid trade and diplomatic uncertainty under the Trump administration. Trump is due to arrive in Manila on Tuesday, November 17, towards the end of the summit ahead of his trip to the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in Shenzhen, where a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin is scheduled. Anti-Trump protests are expected when he arrives in Manila, after four days of demonstrations and the burning of Trump effigies by leftist groups, students, and workers demanding an end to the Middle East war and the scrapping of the US-led Pax Silica initiative. In Manila, Trump will meet ASEAN leaders and attend his first meeting of the Quad group of Indo-Pacific powers — the US, Japan, Australia, and India — the first such gathering in two years. His predecessor Joe Biden saw the Quad as a signature foreign policy achievement and stressed the importance of maintaining it during his six meetings with the group. The Quad is widely considered an attempt to counterbalance China’s influence in the region, including by Beijing, although its members have said the grouping is not directed against any one country. ASEAN held talks on Monday with the leaders of Australia, South Korea and the United Nations, whose Secretary-General Antonio Guterres reiterated calls for a ceasefire in Ukraine and for greater humanitarian access in war-torn Myanmar. Referring to trilateral talks planned in Shenzhen on Thursday, Guterres also said the UN was ready to fully engage on any denuclearization initiative between the United States, Russia and China, despite a lack of certainty about such an outcome. Trump has previously said he thought a denuclearization deal with Russia and China was possible. China’s Foreign Ministry on Monday said the trilateral talks would “promote world peace and stability”. “This is what we would like to see,” Guterres said about denuclearization. “It’s not yet guaranteed that we will get there.” South Korean President Lee Jae-myung on Monday proposed new initiatives on AI and creative industries to ASEAN and said negotiations to expand their free trade deal were progressing. “We must respond proactively to the changing global trade environment and move forward together towards an era of $300 billion in annual trade,” he said. The ASEAN leaders’ summit ended on Sunday without completing a protracted code of conduct with Beijing to try to manage disputes over the South China Sea, which ASEAN chair the Philippines had hoped could be wrapped up this year. ASEAN also resolved to continue its policy of excluding Myanmar’s leaders from its summits, but left the door open for a return if “sustained and concrete progress” on a peace plan agreed long ago with ASEAN can be demonstrated. The meeting also saw an apology from Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto to neighbouring Singapore and Malaysia over the impact of sustained transboundary haze from months of wildfires. – Rappler.com Loading Related Topics Discover more through topics that were hand-picked by our editors in relation to this article. https://www.rappler.com/philippines/chin.title_zh: 在Trump访问前，中国总理赞扬与东盟的“非凡”关系
https://www.rappler.com/philippines/chin.body_zh: 你于2026年11月16日晚上6:10（PHT）关注了此话题 路透社 你关注了这位作者 收听本文 升级即可收听 由Speechify提供支持 已经拥有Rappler+？登录以收听开创性新闻报道。 中国领导人在东盟峰会上。 在马尼拉举行的第29届东盟—中国峰会暨东南亚国家联盟（东盟）第49届峰会期间，中国总理李强向菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯 Jr. 示意，越南总理黎明兴和新加坡总理黄循财在一旁观看拍照环节。 中国总理李强赞扬中国与东盟之间牢固的经济联系，强调尽管全球贸易面临挑战，双方贸易额仍超过1万亿美元，投资额达到5000亿美元。 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普准备抵达马尼拉之际，预计将有人抗议其政府的政策；与此同时，东盟领导人讨论区域合作以及推动无核化的工作。 本文由人工智能生成。 阅读文章以了解完整背景。报告错误。 马尼拉，菲律宾——中国总理李强于11月16日星期一赞扬了他所称中国与东南亚“真正非凡”的成就，表示尽管全球贸易限制不断增多，北京仍承诺推动自由贸易。 东盟峰会在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普抵达前举行。李强在马尼拉向东盟各国领导人发表讲话说，在单边主义和保护主义日益抬头、地缘政治冲突反复出现的情况下，中国与东盟之间的经济关系只会更加紧密。 “过去五年真正非同寻常，我们取得的成就来之不易，”他说。去年，他所在的11成员国东盟与中国的年贸易额超过1万亿美元，双向累计投资额超过5000亿美元。 “我们仍坚定致力于维护多边主义并促进自由贸易，努力把蛋糕做大，”他说。 中国是东盟最大的贸易伙伴和重要投资来源，但特朗普政府治下贸易与外交形势不确定，这个集团中最大的经济体都希望扩大与美国的关系。 特朗普预计于11月17日星期二抵达马尼拉，在峰会接近尾声时启程前往深圳参加亚太经济合作论坛；他将在那里参加与中国国家主席习近平、俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京举行的三方会议。 左翼团体、学生和工人持续进行了四天示威，并焚烧特朗普塑像，要求结束中东战争以及废弃美国主导的“Pax Silica”倡议，预计特朗普抵达马尼拉时将发生反特朗普抗议。 在马尼拉，特朗普将会见东盟领导人，并出席 Indo-Pacific 四大国集团——美国、日本、澳大利亚和印度——的首次会议，这是两年来该集团首次举行此类集会。 他的前任乔·拜登将四方安全对话视为其标志性外交政策成果，并强调在六次集团会议中维持这一机制的重要性。 外界普遍认为，四方安全对话是制衡中国在地区影响力的努力，包括对北京施加影响，不过其成员表示，该集团并非针对任何单一国家。 东盟星期一与澳大利亚、韩国和联合国的领导人举行会谈。 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯再次呼吁在乌克兰实现停火，并呼吁加强对战火破坏的缅甸的人道主义准入。 古特雷斯谈及计划于星期四在深圳举行的三方会谈时还说，尽管结果尚不确定，联合国仍准备全面参与美国、俄罗斯和中国之间的任何无核化倡议。 特朗普此前曾表示，他认为俄罗斯与中国达成无核化协议是可能的。 中国外交部星期一表示，三方会谈将“促进世界和平与稳定”。 谈及无核化，古特雷斯说：“这正是我们希望看到的。但目前还不能保证我们能够实现这一目标。” 韩国总统李在明星期一向东盟提出有关人工智能和创意产业的新倡议，并称扩大双方自由贸易协定的谈判正在取得进展。 “我们必须主动应对不断变化的全球贸易环境，共同迈向年贸易额3000亿美元的时代，”他说。 东盟领导人峰会于星期日结束，未能与北京完成旨在管控南海争端争议的长期行为准则。 担任东盟轮值主席国的菲律宾原本希望今年能够完成该准则。 东盟还决定继续将缅甸领导人排除在峰会之外，但表示，如果能够证明在东盟多年前达成一致的和平计划上取得“持续和具体进展”，仍为其重返峰会保留空间。 会议期间，印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃·苏比anto还就持续数月的野火造成的跨境烟霾影响，向邻近的新加坡和马来西亚道歉。 ——Rappler.com 加载 相关话题 通过我们的编辑为本文精选的相关主题，进一步发现更多内容。以上选择由人工智能生成。阅读文章以了解完整背景。报告错误。 通过我们的编辑为本文精选的相关主题，进一步发现更多内容。升级至Rappler+，获取独家内容和无限访问权限。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The US government is doubling down on its immigration control, with the State Department revoking over 6,000 visas belonging to foreigners engaged in or facilitating birth tourism. The department announced on Thursday, through its X handle, that its Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force had revoked the visas of people identified as involved in the practice. “The Department of State’s Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force has now revoked more than 6,000 visas from foreigners who engaged in or facilitated birth tourism,” the post read. It also said the task force is still identifying and “holding accountable everyone involved in this illicit practice.” This implies that more visas are likely to be revoked over this practice in the future. Birth tourism refers to travelling to another country, usually while pregnant, to give birth so the child can acquire that country’s citizenship or nationality by birth. The latest action signals a wider crackdown on both participants and facilitators, including those who help arrange such travel. Last month, the department announced that it had revoked over 4,000 visas, and that 700 of the revoked visas belonged to Chinese nationals. The latest statement, however, did not provide a breakdown by nationality. As such, it remains unclear whether Nigerians were among those affected. A core aspect of President Donald Trump’s “America first” policy and political campaigns has been a crackdown on immigration. The US leader, during his presidential campaigns, pledged to increase deportations of people living in the country, restrict asylum and refugee admissions, and tighten both illegal and some legal immigration pathways. Since resuming office, Mr Trump has implemented several policies aligned with this agenda. At the inauguration ceremony, for instance, he signed an executive order declaring illegal immigration a national emergency and ordered the speedy deportation of undocumented migrants. The United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement crackdown on migrants has, in the past year, been criticised for human rights violations. The Trump administration also imposed visa bans on several countries, including Nigeria. It is also planning to introduce a policy requiring foreign nationals in the US seeking to change their status from temporary visa holders to permanent residents to return to their home country to apply for a Green Card
