https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦财政部经济政策框架草案：能否带来超出另一份文件的成果？
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.body_zh: 在家庭苦苦维持收支平衡之际，政府却可能改善其财政状况。在企业面临高运营成本之际，投资公告数量可能增加。在公民切实感受到实质性纾困之前，经济指标也可能走强。经济政策面临的挑战，是将这些现实状况连接起来：把稳定转化为机遇，把更高的财政收入转化为有效的公共服务，把改革转化为更好的生活水平。这应当成为尼日利亚联邦财政部《尼日利亚经济政策框架》草案的核心检验标准。此次咨询于10月26日启动、11月27日结束，拟为历届政府连续制定经济政策确立持久有效的原则、决策规则和绩效衡量标准。该文件目前仍为草案，并向公众征求意见。这一举措值得认真参与。企业受益于可预测的政策。家庭需要确信，改革成本已经得到充分考虑。公共机构需要明确的职责和一致的标准，以便据此评估其绩效。关键问题在于，这一框架能否在实践中确立这些规范。其最有力的提案之一，是要求每项重大经济干预措施均提交政策影响说明。相关说明应审查证据、可选方案、分配效应、财政影响、执行能力、绩效指标和退出条件。草案还提议引入公开评分卡和独立评估。这些规定可以改善政府决策。然而，其成效取决于评估结果何时公布、受审查的程度，以及官员无视评估结果时会发生什么。除在明确定义的紧急情况下，政策影响说明都应在实施前公布。公民和企业需要有机会审查各项假设并提出疑虑，而此时政策调整仍有空间。最终框架还应审慎界定何谓重大干预措施。预算成本只是考量因素之一。监管限制可能几乎不增加政府成本，却会大幅提高企业和消费者的开支。受影响人数和后果严重程度也应决定审查的深度。额外收入可以为投资提供资金、减少债务、清偿未决义务或增强储蓄。但暂时性收益也可能助长难以持续兑现的承诺，尤其是在价格或产量下降时。稳健的框架应要求政府区分异常收入与可持续收入。框架应说明额外资源将如何使用，披露相关风险，并明确公民可以期待哪些益处。同样的方法也应适用于税收优惠和产业保护。扶持措施应具有明确的经济目的、可衡量的成果和审查日期。如果预期收益未能实现，政府应准备修订或撤销相关措施。不过，一致性仍须为民主选择留有空间。未来政府应保留根据证据、公众偏好和经济形势调整政策的权力。长期责任应落在透明地论证决策并评估其后果上。因此，源自该框架的任何立法，都应强化证据、协商、披露和评估标准，不应让一届政府偏好的经济选择变得难以重新审议。紧急情况下的灵活性同样不可或缺。政府有时可能需要迅速采取行动。在这种情况下，政府应公布行动理由、估算成本、持续时间以及后续审查安排。延长措施应要求提供新的证据。数字治理有助于使这些要求切实可行。每项重大干预措施都应建立易于访问的公开记录，将评估、预算、责任机构、实施里程碑和评估结果相互关联。采用统一标识符，将有助于追踪一项政策从批准、支出到最终成果的全过程。公开仪表板应由可下载数据、清晰的方法说明和修订记录提供支持。研究人员和记者必须能够审查官方结论背后的证据。个人信息，尤其是弱势受益人的个人信息，应受到保护。独立监督同样重要。统计测量、财务审计和政策评估承担着不同职能。相关机构的职责应明确界定，并应赋予相关机构权力和资源，使其能够在不受不当干预的情况下公布评估结果。框架还必须规定机构未能遵守要求时的后续处理。公布整改行动计划、责任人及完成期限，可以提供切实可行的起点。归根结底，评估经济表现时，家庭福利应占据重要分量。增长、财政收入和投资是重要基础。进展还应体现在购买力、就业质量、贫困减少，以及获得正常运转的学校、医疗保健和其他基本服务等方面。在可靠数据允许的情况下，全国性成果应细分列示，以显示不同地区和人口群体之间的差距。平均指标的改善可能掩盖长期存在的困苦。实施该框架需要明确责任归属、充足能力和切合实际的里程碑。现有报告体系应得到加强，各州和地方政府应在宪法规定的职责范围内参与其中。此次咨询提供了尽早展示这种做法的机会。财政部应说明公众意见如何影响了最终框架。尼日利亚需要能够改善决策并使成果更易核实的经济规则。当该框架的标准切实影响日常政府实践，并开始让全国各地的公民感受到其益处时，其价值便会清晰显现。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY MANILA, Philippines – Thousands of students from different parts of the Philippines staged protests on Friday, November 13, against the US-led Pax Silica initiative and US President Donald Trump’s expected arrival in the country for the ASEAN Summit. Filipinos have raised concerns about the initiative’s potential environmental impact and the possible displacement of indigenous peoples and farming communities. In Manila, students from the University of Santo Tomas (UST), Asia’s oldest Catholic university, walked out of their classrooms to join the protest. “Pax Silica is reported to generate hundreds of thousands of indirect and induced jobs. However, projections are not promises and promises are not guarantees, especially when dealing with a global power like the United States,” the UST Central Student Council Executive Board said. “It is not enough to ask what development Pax Silica can offer; we must also ask who stands to benefit from it, and more importantly, who will bear its costs,” it added. At De La Salle University, at least 1,500 students also walked out of their classrooms to protest against the initiative. Students from different campuses of the University of the Philippines, Polytechnic University of the Philippines, Miriam College, and Ateneo de Manila University also joined the demonstrations. In Benguet, around 9,000 students from various schools, including UP Baguio, Saint Louis University, and the University of the Cordilleras took to the streets to express their opposition to Pax Silica. Students from Central Luzon State University also staged a protest on Thursday, November 12. The signing of the Pax Silica agreement had reportedly been targeted for November, coinciding with Trump’s visit to the Philippines for the ASEAN Summit. However, Department of Trade and Industry Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo clarified that the Philippines would not sign the agreement during the 49th ASEAN Summit. “We do not want to distract attention or take away attention from the regional initiatives that ASEAN and the Philippines are proposing,” Rodolfo told reporters on Tuesday, November 10. Amid the protests, Palace Press Officer Claire Castro appealed to the public to reconsider holding demonstrations during the summit. “’ Kung ano man ang panawagan ito ay sana hindi dinadaan sa pagprotesta although ito ay kanilang karapatan. Pero sa panahon ngayon mas magandang nagkakaroon ng mas masinsinang paguusapan kung ano man ang concerns ng mga estudyante ,” Castro said during a press briefing on Saturday, November 14. (Whatever their demands may be, I hope these are not pursued through protests, although I recognize that this is their right. In these times, however, it would be better to have more in-depth discussions about whatever concerns the students may have.) https://www.politico.eu/article/us-sugge.body: The U.S. has floated the idea of Ukraine joining NATO in exchange for withdrawing from its eastern Donbas region as part of negotiations to end the war, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Friday. “The Americans raised a question: ‘What if Ukraine joins NATO? Would Ukraine withdraw from Donbas?’ This was the first time this had been raised,” Zelenskyy told reporters on Friday, a day after he met with U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Dublin . The Donbas region in Ukraine’s far east borders Russia, and Moscow declared it had annexed the region in 2022 after its full-scale invasion. The vast majority of the region is occupied by Russian troops. Giving up Donbas has long been part of the proposals put forward by U.S. President Donald Trump's administration, including the 28-part plan for a peace agreement proposed by the White House in 2025 . Russian President Vladimir Putin has previously demanded that Ukraine abandon its efforts to join NATO and accept strict limits on the size of its military. “I have said repeatedly: Ukraine is not retreating and is not giving up its land to terrorists,” Zelenskyy told reporters. The White House and U.S. State Department did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Zelenskyy said he was discussing a “comprehensive security package” with partners that would include specific guarantees from NATO and the EU, a strong Ukrainian army with adequate troops, weapons and financial support for a set period and a recovery plan with clear funding attached. “If the American side confirms precisely this to us, together with other NATO partners, then I will ask our Ukrainian society what it thinks: do we accept it or not? I have no right to make that decision on my own,” Zelenskyy said. "Of course, this would be without any recognition of the occupied territories as Russian," he added. “But we need specifics, and we don't have them yet. All of this is still under discussion,” the president said

https://www.politico.eu/article/us-sugge.body_zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基周五表示，美国提出了一种设想：作为结束战争的谈判的一部分，可以用乌克兰加入北约来交换其从东部顿巴斯地区撤军。泽连斯基周五在接受记者采访时说：“美国人提出了一个问题：‘如果乌克兰加入北约，乌克兰是否会撤出顿巴斯？’这是第一次有人提出这个问题。”此前一天，他曾在都柏林会见美国特使史蒂夫·维特科夫和贾里德·库什纳。顿巴斯位于乌克兰最东部，与俄罗斯接壤；莫斯科在2022年全面入侵乌克兰后宣布吞并该地区。该地区绝大部分目前由俄罗斯军队占领。长期以来，放弃顿巴斯一直是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府提出的方案之一，包括白宫于2025年提出的28项和平协议计划。俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京此前要求乌克兰放弃加入北约的努力，并接受对其军队规模的严格限制。泽连斯基对记者说：“我已经反复说过：乌克兰不会撤退，也不会把自己的土地拱手让给恐怖分子。”白宫和美国国务院没有立即回应置评请求。泽连斯基表示，他正在与合作伙伴讨论一项“全面安全方案”，其中将包括北约和欧盟提供的具体保障、一支拥有充足兵员和武器并在一定时期内获得资金支持的强大乌克兰军队，以及一项附有明确资金安排的重建计划。泽连斯基说：“如果美方能向我们明确确认这整套方案，并确认会与其他北约伙伴一道实施，那么我会询问乌克兰社会对此的看法：我们接受还是不接受？我无权独自作出这个决定。”他补充道：“当然，这不会以承认被占领领土属于俄罗斯为前提。”总统说：“但我们需要具体内容，而目前尚未具备。所有这些仍在讨论之中。”

https://www.myjoyonline.com/petrol-tippe.body: Petrol prices could fall by up to 8.23% from November 16, 2026, while diesel prices are also expected to decline, according to the Chamber of Oil Marketing Companies (COMAC). However, consumers of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) face a projected 21.10% increase per kilogram during the second pricing window of November. COMAC’s outlook points to lower international petrol and diesel prices, alongside a slowdown in the cedi’s depreciation. The projected LPG increase reflects the delayed impact of higher international prices from the previous pricing window. Data from COMAC indicates petrol could sell at GH¢15.62 per litre after the projected reduction. Diesel prices could fall by 1.79% to 4.42%, bringing the price to about GH¢18 per litre. These are projections, with actual retail prices dependent on the pricing decisions of individual marketing companies. COMAC attributes the expected reductions in petrol and diesel prices largely to falling international refined-product prices. Crude oil prices fell 16.14% to US$104.25 per barrel during the review period, marking their first significant drop since August 2026. According to the chamber, the decline reflected easing geopolitical risks, expectations of de-escalation in the Middle East and a recovery in OPEC+ output to 41.23 million barrels per day. International petrol prices fell 16.30%, while diesel fell 5.13%. LPG prices also dropped by 6.42%. Despite the international LPG decline, COMAC expects domestic prices to rise because earlier increases under the tender arrangement have not yet passed through. The chamber also noted that the cedi depreciated by just 0.15% between October 28 and November 11, limiting exchange-rate pressure on fuel prices. Meanwhile, the government–industry intervention continues to cushion diesel consumers against price pressures. Some oil marketing companies have already reduced petrol and diesel prices ahead of the November 16 window. It remains unclear whether they will make further adjustments in line with COMAC’s projections. Star Oil has reduced prices three times over the past week and is selling petrol at GH¢15.55 per litre and diesel at GH¢18.37 per litre. Allied is selling petrol at GH¢15.50 per litre and diesel at GH¢18.20. JP has also lowered its petrol price from GH¢16.43, quoted on October 16, to GH¢15.95. Its diesel price has fallen from GH¢18.97 to GH¢18.35. These adjustments mean some petrol prices are already below COMAC’s projected GH¢15.62 per litre. Petroleum pricing reviews take place on the first and 16th of each month. The National Petroleum Authority (NPA) has set minimum price floors of GH¢13.69 per litre for petrol and GH¢16.73 per litre for diesel. These figures are minimum benchmarks, not final retail prices. According to the NPA, they exclude premiums charged by International Oil Trading Companies, operating margins of Bulk Import, Distribution and Export Companies, and margins charged by Oil Marketing Companies and LPG Marketing Companies. The respective companies will determine those charges independently under the prescribed Petroleum Products Pricing Formula
https://www.myjoyonline.com/petrol-tippe.title_zh: 汽油价格预计将下跌8.23%，但液化石油气价格将上涨21%
https://www.myjoyonline.com/petrol-tippe.body_zh: 据石油营销商协会（COMAC）消息，自2026年11月16日起，汽油价格可能下调最多8.23%，柴油价格预计也将下降。然而，在11月第二个定价窗口期内，液化石油气（LPG）消费者预计每公斤将面临21.10%的涨价。COMAC的展望显示，国际汽油和柴油价格走低，同时塞地贬值速度放缓。预计LPG涨价反映了上一定价窗口国际油价上涨的滞后影响。COMAC的数据显示，汽油在预计降价后可能以每升GH¢15.62的价格出售。柴油价格可能下降1.79%至4.42%，降至每升约GH¢18。这些数字仅为预测，实际零售价格取决于各家营销公司的定价决定。COMAC认为，汽油和柴油价格预计下降主要是由于国际成品油价格下跌。评估期内，原油价格下跌16.14%，降至每桶US$104.25，这是自2026年8月以来的首次显著跌幅。该协会表示，这一跌幅反映出地缘政治风险缓解、市场预期中东局势降级，以及OPEC+产量回升至每日4123万桶。国际汽油价格下跌16.30%，柴油价格下跌5.13%，LPG价格也下跌了6.42%。尽管国际LPG价格下降，COMAC预计国内价格仍将上涨，因为此前在招标安排下实施的涨价尚未传导至零售端。该协会还指出，10月28日至11月11日期间，塞地仅贬值0.15%，限制了汇率对燃油价格造成的压力。与此同时，政府与行业采取的干预措施继续缓冲柴油消费者面临的价格压力。一些石油营销公司已在11月16日定价窗口前下调汽油和柴油价格。它们是否会根据COMAC的预测进一步调整价格，目前尚不清楚。Star Oil在过去一周已三次降价，目前汽油售价为每升GH¢15.55，柴油售价为每升GH¢18.37。Allied的汽油售价为每升GH¢15.50，柴油售价为GH¢18.20。JP也已将汽油价格从10月16日公布的GH¢16.43降至GH¢15.95，柴油价格则从GH¢18.97降至GH¢18.35。这些调整意味着，部分汽油价格已经低于COMAC预计的每升GH¢15.62。石油产品定价评估每月1日和16日进行。国家石油管理局（NPA）设定汽油最低价格下限为每升GH¢13.69，柴油最低价格下限为每升GH¢16.73。这些数字是最低基准，而非最终零售价格。NPA表示，这些数字不包括国际石油交易公司收取的溢价、散装进口、分销与出口公司的运营利润，以及石油营销公司和LPG营销公司收取的利润。相关公司将根据规定的石油产品定价公式自行确定这些费用

https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/14/us-f.body: Share Comments Add Euronews on Google Share Facebook Twitter Flipboard Send Reddit Linkedin Messenger Telegram VK Bluesky Threads Whatsapp Putin has indicated that Russia will not back down on territorial demands to control parts of Ukraine and has rejected the idea of foreign peacekeeping troops being deployed in the country. "The Americans raised a question: 'What if Ukraine joins NATO? Would Ukraine withdraw from Donbas?' This was the first time this had been raised," Zelenskyy told reporters on Friday in comments embargoed until Saturday, the AFP news agency reported. Zelenskyy added that Ukraine was discussing "specific security guarantees" from NATO and the European Union and that he would ask Ukrainians if they accepted the terms should Western nations confirm. It comes after Russian President Vladimir Putin met with US special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Moscow earlier this week. During their meeting, Putin signalled that Russia would not back down on territorial demands to control parts of Ukraine and rejected the idea of foreign peacekeeping troops being deployed in the country. The US envoys later met with Zelenskyy in Ireland on Thursday to discuss ongoing diplomatic efforts, with the trio announcing that, moving forward, Europe would have a "voice" in peace negotiations. "This will allow us to address the broader postwar European security arrangements alongside the territorial issues between Ukraine and Russia," Kushner wrote in a post on X. "They are striving by every means possible to join the negotiations, but, as our President has said, they must decide whether they want peace or the continuation of the war," he said

Meanwhile, the Democrats won 55 seats in the US Senate, leaving Republicans with 44 seats. https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111402.summary_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者金升旭 = 白宫官员13日（当地时间）宣布，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将于19日在中国西安举行史上首次美中俄三国元首会晤。据法新社等外媒报道，白宫新闻秘书奥利维娅·韦尔斯当天对记者表示，美中俄三国领导人将于19日举行三方会谈，契机是17日至19日在中国西安举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议。韦尔斯说：“特朗普总统已明确表示，除其他议程外，还将讨论全球核武器削减问题”，并解释道：“特朗普总统认为，此类核扩散极其危险。”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111402.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 김승욱 기자 = 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 시진핑 중국 국가주석, 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령이 19일 중국 선전에서 사상 첫 미중러 3자 정상회담을 개최한다고 백악관이 13일(현지시간) 밝혔다. AFP 통신 등 외신에 따르면 올리비아 웨일스 백악관 공보 담당은 이날 기자들에게 미중러 정상이 17∼19일 중국 선전에서 열리는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의를 계기로 19일 3자 회동을 한다고 밝혔다. 웨일스는 "트럼프 대통령은 다른 의제들과 더불어 전 세계 핵무기 감축 문제를 논의하겠다는 입장을 분명히 해왔다"며 "트럼프 대통령은 이러한 핵확산이 매우 위험하다고 보고 있다"고 설명했다. 미 정부 고위 당국자들에 따르면 트럼프 대통령은 이번 3자 회담에서 핵 감축과 함께 현재 진행 중인 대(對)이란 전쟁 문제를 의제로 올릴 예정이다. 다만, 우크라이나 전쟁은 논의하지 않을 전망이다. 익명을 요구한 미 고위 당국자는 "대통령은 시 주석, 푸틴 대통령과의 3자 회담에서 이란 문제를 논의할 의향이 있다"면서도 우크라이나 전쟁에 대해서는 미국이 러시아, 우크라이나와 함께 가동 중인 '완전히 별개의 협상 트랙'이 있다고 선을 그었다. 트럼프 대통령의 특사들은 최근 아랍에미리트(UAE) 아부다비에서 러시아, 우크라이나 측과 3자 비공개 협상을 벌였다. 미 고위 당국자는 "중국은 그 협상 트랙의 일원이 아니기 때문에 그 자리에서 우크라이나 문제를 논의하는 것은 적절하지 않다"고 말했다. 또한 한 미국 당국자는 트럼프 대통령이 다음 주 아시아 방문 기간 김정은 북한 국무위원장과 만나지 않을 예정이라고 말했다고 로이터 통신이 보도했다. 트럼프 대통령이 15∼17일 필리핀 마닐라에서 열리는 동남아시아국가연합(ASEAN) 정상회의나 17∼19일 중국 선전에서 열리는 APEC 정상회의에서 어떤 방식으로든 김 위원장과 만날 계획이 현재로서는 없다는 입장을 밝힌 것이다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/14 11:07 송고 2026년11월14일 11시07분 송고 지난 2019년 6월 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령(왼쪽)과 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 판문점 군사분계선 북측 지역에서 만나 인사한 뒤 남측 지역으로 향하고 있다. https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111402.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者金升旭报道称，白宫宫长办公室于13日（当地时间）宣布，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平以及俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将于19日在中国深圳举行史上首次美中俄三国领导人会晤。据法新社等外媒报道，白宫新闻秘书办公室负责新闻发布事务的奥利维亚·韦尔斯当天对记者表示，美中俄三国领导人将以17日至19日在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议为契机，于19日举行三方会晤。韦尔斯说：“特朗普总统已明确表示，除其他议程外，还将讨论全球核武器削减问题”，并称“特朗普总统认为，这种核扩散极其危险”。据美国政府高级官员透露，特朗普总统计划在此次三方会谈中，除核军备削减外，还将把目前进行中的对伊朗战争问题列为议题。不过，预计不会讨论乌克兰战争。一名要求匿名的美国高级官员表示：“总统有意在与习近平主席、普京总统的三方会谈中讨论伊朗问题”，同时强调，对于乌克兰战争，美国与俄罗斯、乌克兰正在开展的是“一条完全不同的谈判轨道”。特朗普总统的特使近期在阿拉伯联合酋长国（UAE）阿布扎比与俄罗斯和乌克兰方面举行了三方闭门谈判。一名美国高级官员说：“由于中国不是该谈判轨道的成员，因此在那个场合讨论乌克兰问题并不合适”。此外，据路透社报道，一名美国官员表示，特朗普总统预计在下周访问亚洲期间不会会见朝鲜国务委员会委员金正恩。特朗普总统明确表示，目前无论如何都没有计划在15日至17日在菲律宾马尼拉举行的东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）领导人会议，以及17日至19日在中国深圳举行的APEC领导人会议上，以任何方式与金正恩委员长会面。投稿邮箱：KakaoTalk okjebo。版权所有© 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、发行及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026年11月14日11时07分发布。2019年6月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（左）与朝鲜国务委员会委员金正恩在板门店军事分界线北侧地区会面并致意后，前往南侧地区。[摄影：裴载民]

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.summary_zh: 尼日利亚出口促进委员会（NEPC）执行董事兼首席执行官Nonye Ayeni女士在河套州霍尔港举行的国家单一窗口第二阶段出口宣传暨利益相关方论坛上说，该举措对于维持尼日利亚不断增长的非石油出口表现至关重要。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.body: Speaking at the National Single Window Phase 2 Export Sensitisation and Joint Stakeholders’ Forum in Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Executive Director/Chief Executive Officer of the Nigerian Export Promotion Council (NEPC), Mrs. Nonye Ayeni, said the initiative was critical to sustaining the country’s growing non-oil export performance. Represented by Mr. Ndubueze Okeke, Director, Trade Information, the NEPC chief executive disclosed that Nigeria generated $6.1 billion in non-oil export earnings in 2025, representing an 11.5 per cent increase from the $5.46 billion recorded in 2024. While describing the performance as encouraging, the NEPC boss stressed that increased production alone would not guarantee Nigeria’s emergence as a leading non-oil exporting nation without efficient trade facilitation systems. “Nigeria’s ambition to become a leading non-oil exporting nation cannot be achieved by production alone. It also requires efficient systems that enable our businesses to move their products from local markets to international destinations with minimal delays, reduced costs and predictable regulatory processes,” the executive director said. She explained that the National Single Window, a federal government initiative, would provide a unified digital platform for submitting and processing trade-related documents, permits and approvals, thereby improving inter-agency coordination, eliminating duplication and reducing administrative burdens on businesses. The NEPC boss disclosed that the council had commenced its engagement and onboarding process to integrate relevant export-related services into the platform, including its Exporter’s Certificate registration service. She emphasised the need for exporters to understand the relationship between the NSW platform, the Trade Monitoring System (TRMS), Forms NXP and NCX, as well as applicable registration, permit and certification requirements. “Our objective is to ensure a seamless transition that simplifies processes rather than creates additional burdens for businesses,” she stated. The executive director said the Phase 2 implementation was particularly significant to the South-South region, given its vast opportunities in agriculture, fisheries, aquaculture, agro-processing and manufacturing. She urged exporters and business operators to participate actively in the technical sessions covering exporter’s certificate registration, NSW trader registration, TRMS and the processing of Forms NXP and NCX. According to her, the success of the initiative would depend not only on technology but also on effective collaboration among government agencies and the willingness of private-sector operators to embrace the new processes. Meanwhile, the Director of the National Single Window, Mr. Tola Fakolade, said the first component of Phase 2 would go live on December 14, beginning with the digital issuance of export permits by regulatory agencies, including the Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON), the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC), and the Federal Produce Inspection Service. He added that the second component, covering Central Bank of Nigeria processes, would be deployed in the first quarter of 2027. Fakolade said the platform would strengthen regulatory compliance and curb revenue leakages, noting that the first phase had simplified import documentation by allowing traders to submit licences and permits through a single platform. “Because of the enforced compliance on the platform, it actually forces users to be compliant. And when there is compliance, then there is blockage of revenue leakages,” he said. Also speaking, Comptroller Aondona Fanyam, in charge of Compliance and Modernisation at the Nigeria Customs Service Headquarters, said the initiative would eliminate repeated submission of documents to multiple government agencies. He explained that traders would submit their documents once, while relevant agencies would access the required information electronically through the platform. Fanyam identified capacity gaps, change management and differences in the digital capabilities of regulatory agencies as some of the challenges encountered during Phase 1, adding that stakeholder sensitisation and practical training were being intensified ahead of the next phase. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.body_zh: 在河流州哈科特港举行的国家单一窗口第二阶段出口宣传暨利益相关方联合论坛上，尼日利亚出口促进委员会（NEPC）执行董事兼首席执行官诺妮耶·阿耶尼表示，这一举措对于保持尼日利亚不断增长的非石油出口表现至关重要。NEPC首席执行官在贸易信息总监Ndubueze Okeke先生代表出席的情况下透露，尼日利亚2025年获得61亿美元非石油出口收入，较2024年的54.6亿美元增长11.5%。NEPC负责人在形容这一表现令人鼓舞的同时强调，如果没有高效的贸易便利化体系，仅靠增加产量无法确保尼日利亚成为领先的非石油出口国。“尼日利亚成为领先非石油出口国的目标不能仅靠生产来实现。它还需要高效的体系，使我们的企业能够将产品从本地市场运往国际市场，同时将延误降至最低、成本降下来，并确保监管流程可预测，”这位执行董事说。她 explained that 国家单一窗口是联邦政府的一项举措，将提供一个统一的数字平台，用于提交和处理贸易相关文件、许可证和审批，从而改善机构间协调，消除重复工作，并减轻企业的行政负担。NEPC负责人透露，该委员会已启动与相关方的接洽及平台接入流程，将出口相关服务整合到该平台，其中包括出口商证书注册服务。她强调，出口商需要了解NSW平台、贸易监测系统（TRMS）、NXP表格和NCX表格之间的关系，以及适用的注册、许可和认证要求。“我们的目标是确保实现平稳过渡，简化流程，而不是给企业增加额外负担，”她表示。执行董事表示，鉴于该地区在农业、渔业、水产养殖、农产品加工和制造业方面拥有巨大机遇，第二阶段的实施对南部地区尤其意义重大。她敦促出口商和经营者积极参加有关出口商证书注册、NSW贸易商注册、TRMS以及NXP表格和NCX表格处理的技术会议。她说，该举措能否成功不仅取决于技术，也取决于政府机构之间的有效协作，以及私营部门经营者接受新流程的意愿。与此同时，国家单一窗口主任Tola Fakolade先生表示，第二阶段的第一部分将于12月14日上线，首先由各监管机构以数字方式签发出口许可证，包括尼日利亚标准组织（SON）、国家食品药品监督管理总局（NAFDAC）和联邦农产品检验局。他补充说，涵盖尼日利亚中央银行相关流程的第二部分将于2027年第一季度部署。Fakolade表示，该平台将加强监管合规并减少收入流失，并指出第一阶段已通过允许贸易商通过一个平台提交许可证和批准文件，简化了进口文件要求。“由于平台实行强制合规，它实际上会迫使用户遵守规定。而一旦实现合规，就能堵住收入流失的漏洞，”他说。尼日利亚海关总署合规与现代化负责人Aondona Fanyam总审计长也表示，该举措将消除向多个政府机构反复提交文件的问题。他解释说，贸易商只需提交一次文件，相关机构便可通过平台以电子方式获取所需信息。Fanyam指出，各监管机构在能力建设、变革管理以及数字化能力方面的差异，是第一阶段实施过程中遇到的部分挑战；下一阶段启动前，各方正加强利益相关方宣传和实务培训。THISDAY创刊于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办公室。对于政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级而言，THISDAY是尼日利亚最具权威性的全平台新闻媒体，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报秉持公众信任，专注于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育、社区以及人与社会的交汇点等各类议题。您可以发送电子邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

Unlock these with Subscription The fifth round of the India-Bangladesh consular dialogue will be held on a “mutually convenient date”, the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said on Friday (November 13). Speaking to the media during the bi-weekly media briefing, Randhir Jaiswal, Official Spokesperson of the MEA, reiterated that India seeks to build “positive, constructive and forward-looking” relations with Bangladesh. “The next round of the India-Bangladesh Consular Dialogue, which will also take up matters relating to the Revised Travel Arrangement, will be held on a mutually convenient date. India remains ready to discuss all bilateral issues with Bangladesh through these existing mechanisms, including at the technical level,” Mr. Jaiswal said. The Hindu had reported on Thursday (November 12) about the postponement of the consular talks that were to be held on November 17 and 18. “India desires a positive, constructive, and forward-looking relationship with Bangladesh. Accordingly, initiatives have been taken and meetings held under our structured mechanisms in such areas as trade, railways, water resources, and border management, among others,” said Mr. Jaiswal. Diplomatic sources had indicated that the postponement was because of the spike in tensions in view of the proposed return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to Bangladesh. Ms. Hasina has been in India since August 5, 2024 and she has said that she would return to Dhaka in December. The two sides started consular dialogue in 2017 to strengthen people-to-people contact by having a regular channel of communication on consular, visa, and mutual legal assistance cooperation matters. Four rounds of consular dialogue were held during the rule of the Awami League in Dhaka. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/c.title: China’s ICE Vehicle Push to Africa: What It Means for Nigeria
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/c.summary: China’s continued shipment of large numbers of internal combustion-engine (ICE) vehicles to Nigeria and other African markets is being driven less by a retreat from electric mobility than by a major restructuring of the Chinese automobile industry, with manufacturers increasingly looking overseas for markets, revenue and capacity utilisation.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/c.summary_zh: 中国继续向尼日利亚及其他非洲市场大量运输内燃机（ICE）汽车，其主要驱动力并非从电动出行领域退却，而是中国汽车行业正在进行重大重组；制造商越来越积极地到海外寻找市场、收入和产能利用空间。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/c.body: China’s continued shipment of large numbers of internal combustion-engine (ICE) vehicles to Nigeria and other African markets is being driven less by a retreat from electric mobility than by a major restructuring of the Chinese automobile industry, with manufacturers increasingly looking overseas for markets, revenue and capacity utilisation. The development has important implications for Nigeria, where weak charging infrastructure, unreliable electricity supply, high vehicle acquisition costs and limited consumer purchasing power continue to constrain the mass adoption of electric vehicles (EVs). China has become the world’s dominant vehicle manufacturing base while simultaneously undergoing one of the fastest transitions from petrol and diesel vehicles to new-energy vehicles. The result is a growing pool of conventional vehicles that manufacturers can still sell profitably in markets where the transition to electric mobility is slower. The International Energy Agency (IEA) said Chinese vehicle exports increased sharply in the first half of 2026 as domestic sales weakened, with total Chinese car exports rising 65 per cent year-on-year. Although electric-car exports grew even faster, ICE vehicles remain a major component of China’s overseas shipments. For Africa, the continent’s relatively young motorisation market makes it particularly attractive, according to IEA. Unlike Europe and some Asian markets, where stringent emissions regulations and EV incentives are accelerating the replacement of petrol and diesel vehicles, many African countries still depend heavily on conventional vehicles, particularly imported used cars. Nigeria is a major example. The country’s vehicle market remains overwhelmingly dependent on petrol and diesel technology, while the infrastructure required for large-scale EV adoption is still developing. China’s strategy therefore allows its automakers to serve different markets according to their level of technological transition. EVs can be targeted at markets with adequate charging networks and supportive policies, while ICE vehicles can continue flowing into markets where consumers prioritise affordability, driving range, easy access to mechanics and the availability of fuel. There is also a broader industrial dimension. China’s highly competitive automobile industry has experienced intense price competition and excess production capacity. Overseas markets provide manufacturers with an outlet for vehicles that may face declining demand at home. The IEA noted that Chinese automakers are increasingly relying on overseas markets as domestic growth slows, with major manufacturers setting ambitious export targets. For Nigeria, the influx presents both opportunities and risks. On the positive side, increased Chinese competition could make vehicles more affordable, expand consumer choice and force established global brands to reduce prices. It could also create opportunities for local assembly, component manufacturing, servicing and technical employment if Nigeria successfully links vehicle imports to an industrialisation strategy. But continued dependence on ICE imports could also slow Nigeria’s own transition to cleaner transportation. Nigeria’s Energy Transition Plan envisages a gradual shift towards electric mobility, while the country’s automotive policy seeks greater local vehicle production and increased EV manufacturing. The Nigerian Automotive Industry Development Plan, for instance, targets 30 per cent of locally produced vehicles being electric by 2032. The danger, therefore, is that Nigeria could become a dumping ground for ageing or declining ICE technology just as major manufacturers are moving their technological investments towards batteries, software and electric drivetrains. There is also an environmental and economic cost. Continued dependence on petrol and diesel vehicles means higher exposure to fuel-price shocks, import dependence and transport-sector emissions. Yet the answer is not necessarily to shut the door on Chinese ICE vehicles immediately. Nigeria’s transition must reflect its infrastructure realities. The government would need to expand charging infrastructure, stabilise electricity supply, establish battery and vehicle standards, develop local technical capacity and create incentives for manufacturers to assemble EVs locally. Importantly, 2035 is not a blanket deadline for China to stop producing or exporting every ICE vehicle. China’s official New Energy Vehicle Industry Development Plan says that by 2035, electric vehicles are expected to become the mainstream of new vehicle sales, while public transportation is expected to be fully electrified. A 2025 Chinese transport-energy guideline similarly states that by 2035, pure electric vehicles should become the mainstream of new vehicle sales. China’s target is market dominance by new-energy vehicles, not an announced universal ban on ICE vehicles by 2035. Conventional vehicles can therefore continue to be manufactured, sold or exported, particularly to markets such as Africa where demand remains strong. For Nigeria, this creates a policy dilemma: Chinese ICE vehicles may provide immediate, relatively affordable mobility, but an uncontrolled influx could lock the country into yesterday’s automotive technology just as the world’s largest vehicle manufacturing power accelerates towards tomorrow’s. He explained: “Let me be clear, we are not anti-China. We are pro-Nigeria. “We welcome Chery, Jetour, GAC, Changan, Geely, BYD. Their arrival has forced prices down. A Nigerian can now buy a brand new SUV for N28m instead of N55m. That is good for the consumer. Competition is good. But what we are seeing today is not competition. It is dumping. These are not assembled in Nigeria. Over 95% are imported fully built. Meanwhile, our own assemblers – Innoson in Nnewi, PAN in Kaduna, Nord in Lagos, Stallion in Lagos – are operating at less than 20% capacity. China is moving to EVs at home and pushing its excess ICE production to Africa. Nigeria is becoming the dumping ground. He said, “That is not a level playing field. That is policy failure. If you want to sell more than 1,000 cars a year in Nigeria, you must assemble in Nigeria within 3 years. If you sell cars in Nigeria, you must guarantee parts for 10 years and train Nigerian technicians. Nigeria should not replace tokunbo dependence with Chinese dependence. He stated that, “The biggest enemy of our sector is not China. It is our own policy inconsistency. “The National Automotive Industry Development Plan (NAIDP) says 35% for fully built, 10% for SKD, 5% for CKD. In practice, waivers are given to a few importers to bring fully built cars at 20%. That single waiver kills 10 assemblers.” a) Zero Waivers for Fully Built Cars. Publish all waivers. No secret waivers. b) 10-Year Policy Lock. No investor will build a $50m assembly plant if policy can change in 6 months. Lock it. Local Parts Manufacturing. Nigeria imports $180m in parts from China, $61m from Japan. We must give Pioneer Status to local brake pad, filter, battery and tyre manufacturers. And we must enforce SON standards – 60% of parts in our markets are fake.” Founded on January 22, 1995, THISDAY is published by THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD., 35 Creek Road Apapa, Lagos, Nigeria with offices in 36 states of Nigeria , the Federal Capital Territory and around the world. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/c.body_zh: 中国继续向尼日利亚及其他非洲市场大量运送内燃机（ICE）汽车，其驱动力并非中国放弃电动出行，而是中国汽车产业正在进行重大重组。制造商日益转向海外市场，以寻找销路、收入并提高产能利用率。这一趋势对尼日利亚具有重要影响，因为充电基础设施薄弱、电力供应不稳定、购车成本高昂以及消费者购买力有限，仍在制约电动汽车（EV）的普及。中国已成为全球主导的汽车制造基地，同时也在经历从汽油和柴油汽车向新能源汽车过渡的最快阶段之一。这一结果意味着，传统汽车的数量不断增加；在向电动出行转型较慢的市场，制造商仍能以盈利方式销售这些汽车。国际能源署（IEA）表示，2026年上半年，随着国内销售走弱，中国汽车出口大幅增长，中国汽车出口总量同比增长65%。尽管电动汽车出口增长得更快，但ICE汽车仍是中国海外出口的重要组成部分。IEA称，非洲相对年轻的汽车化市场尤其具有吸引力。与欧洲和部分亚洲市场不同，那里严格的排放法规和EV激励措施正在加速汽油和柴油汽车被替代，而许多非洲国家仍高度依赖传统汽车，尤其是进口二手车。尼日利亚就是一个典型例子。该国的汽车市场仍压倒性地依赖汽油和柴油技术，而大规模采用EV所需的基础设施仍在发展之中。因此，中国的战略使其汽车制造商能够根据不同市场的技术转型程度开展业务。EV可以瞄准充电网络完善且政策支持的市场，而ICE汽车则可以继续流入消费者重视价格可负担性、续航里程、便于维修以及燃油供应的市场。这背后还有更广泛的产业层面。中国竞争激烈的汽车行业经历了激烈的价格竞争，并面临产能过剩。海外市场为制造商提供了出口渠道，以消化那些在国内可能面临需求下降的汽车。IEA指出，随着国内增长放缓，中国汽车制造商越来越依赖海外市场，主要制造商还设定了雄心勃勃的出口目标。对尼日利亚而言，大量涌入既带来机遇，也带来风险。从积极一面看，中国企业加大竞争可能使汽车价格更加亲民，扩大消费者选择，并迫使成熟的全球品牌降价。如果尼日利亚成功将汽车进口与工业化战略相结合，竞争还可能为本地组装、零部件制造、维修服务和技术就业创造机会。但持续依赖进口ICE汽车，也可能拖慢尼日利亚自身向更清洁交通方式转型的进程。尼日利亚《能源转型计划》设想逐步转向电动出行，该国的汽车政策则寻求提高本地汽车产量并增加EV制造。例如，《尼日利亚汽车产业发展计划》提出，到2032年，本地生产汽车中30%应为电动汽车。因此，危险在于，正当主要制造商将技术投资转向电池、软件和电驱动系统之际，尼日利亚可能成为老旧或落后ICE技术的倾销地。这还会带来环境和经济代价。持续依赖汽油和柴油汽车意味着更容易受到燃油价格冲击，对进口依赖加深，并增加交通运输业排放。然而，解决办法未必是立即将中国ICE汽车拒之门外。尼日利亚的转型必须反映其基础设施现实。政府需要扩大充电基础设施、稳定电力供应、建立电池和汽车标准、发展本地技术能力，并为制造商在本地组装EV提供激励。重要的是，2035年并不意味着中国必须全面停止生产和出口所有ICE汽车。中国官方的《新能源汽车产业发展规划》提出，到2035年，电动汽车预计将成为新车销售的主流，公共交通预计将全面实现电动化。2025年中国交通能源指导文件同样指出，到2035年，纯电动汽车应成为新车销售的主流。中国的目标是让新能源汽车占据市场主导地位，而不是宣布到2035年对ICE汽车实施全面禁令。因此，传统汽车仍可继续生产、销售或出口，尤其是在非洲等需求依然强劲的市场。对尼日利亚而言，这造成了一项政策困境：中国ICE汽车可以立即提供相对廉价的出行方式，但若不加控制地大量涌入，就可能在全球最大汽车制造国加速迈向未来技术之际，把这个国家锁定在昨天的汽车技术上。他解释道：“我要明确说明，我们不反对中国，我们支持尼日利亚。“我们欢迎奇瑞、捷途、广汽、长安、吉利、比亚迪。他们的到来迫使价格下降。尼日利亚人现在可以花2800万奈拉买到一辆全新SUV，而不必花5500万奈拉。这对消费者有利。竞争是好事。但我们今天看到的不是竞争，而是倾销。这些车不是在尼日利亚组装的。超过95%都是以整车形式进口的。与此同时，我们自己的组装厂——位于恩韦的Innoson、位于卡杜纳的PAN、位于拉各斯的Nord和Stallion——产能利用率均不足20%。中国在国内转向EV，同时把过剩的ICE产能推向非洲。尼日利亚正在成为倾销地。他说：“这不是公平的竞争环境。这是政策失灵。如果你想在尼日利亚每年销售超过1000辆汽车，就必须在3年内于尼日利亚组装。如果你在尼日利亚销售汽车，就必须保证10年的零部件供应，并培训尼日利亚技术员。尼日利亚不应在摆脱对‘tokunbo’的依赖之后，又转而依赖中国。他表示：“我们这个行业最大的敌人不是中国，而是我们自身政策的不一致。“《国家汽车产业发展计划》（NAIDP）规定，整车进口税率为35%，SKD为10%，CKD为5%。但在实际操作中，少数进口商获得了20%的整车进口豁免。仅这一项豁免就足以让10家组装厂无以为继。a）对整车实行零豁免。公布所有豁免情况，不允许任何秘密豁免。b）锁定10年政策。如果政策6个月就能改变，没有投资者会建设一座价值5000万美元的组装厂。因此必须锁定政策。本地零部件制造。尼日利亚每年从中国进口1.8亿美元零部件，从日本进口6100万美元零部件。我们必须给予本地制动片、滤清器、电池和轮胎制造商‘先锋地位’。我们还必须执行SON标准——我们市场上60%的零部件都是假货。”THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-air-force.summary_zh: 美国空军表示，星期五晚间已对英国萨福克郡拉肯希思皇家空军基地上空“疑似未经授权的无人机活动”作出回应。英国国防部发言人对 BBC 表示，正在“与所有相关方协调”，并补充说，美国空军安全人员已对有关报告作出回应，局势已经解决。拉肯希思皇家空军基地驻扎着美国空军第48战斗机联队，又称“自由之翼”，其中有近7000名现役军人，部分人员驻扎在基地。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-air-force.body: The US Air Force said it responded to "suspected unauthorised drone activity" over RAF Lakenheath in Suffolk on Friday evening. No personnel, aircraft or infrastructure were affected, a spokesperson for the US Air Force said. It comes after unconfirmed reports that sirens were sounded at the base, which residents reported hearing from a nearby village. A Ministry of Defence spokesperson told the BBC it was "coordinating with all relevant parties", adding that US Air Force security personnel responded to the reports and the situation was resolved. "We are working closely with them to establish the facts," they added. West Suffolk MP Nick Timothy said he had been in touch with authorities at the base, and was told "there is no threat to the public, and the incident is now resolved". "Given the raised threat level, I continue to encourage everyone to report anything suspicious or out of the ordinary to the authorities," he added in a social media post. Earlier this week, at least 12 US Air Force aircraft departed the nearby RAF Mildenhall base. They included two Boeing Stratotanker KC-135 refuelling aircraft, with one apparently headed towards Germany and another seen landing at Prestwick Airport near Glasgow. There has been heightened security activity at US bases in the UK following an incident at RAF Fairford in September that Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Iran played a part in. Police said petrol but no explosives were found during searches of vans near the base. Two men have been charged by the Crown Prosecution Service over their alleged involvement in the incident. While Iran denied any responsibility, the US removed all of its bombers from the base in October. The Wall Street Journal reported the departure of the US aircraft from RAF Mildenhall this week was in response to a further threat from Iran but the BBC has not independently verified the claim. Earlier this week, Downing Street insisted British airbases were safe and that their security is a "top priority". RAF Lakenheath hosts the US Air Force's 48th Fighter Wing, or the Liberty Wing as it is also known, which has nearly 7,000 active-duty personnel, some of whom are stationed at the base. The Liberty Wing is the largest US fighter operation in Europe, its website says, employing four combat ready fighter squadrons
https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-air-force.title_zh: 美国空军称，已对英国皇家空军拉肯黑斯基地上空的“疑似无人机”作出回应
https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-air-force.body_zh: 美国空军表示，星期五晚间对英国萨福克郡RAF Lakenheath上空“疑似未经授权的无人机活动”作出回应。美国空军发言人说，没有人员、飞机或基础设施受到影响。此前有未经证实的报道称，该基地拉响了警报，附近村庄的居民称听到了警报声。英国国防部发言人对BBC表示，正在“与所有相关方协调”，并补充说，美国空军安全人员对有关报告作出回应，局势已经解决，对方还表示：“我们正与他们密切合作，以查明事实。”西萨福克郡议员Nick Timothy表示，他已与基地当局联系，并被告知“公众不存在威胁，事件目前已经解决”。他还在社交媒体帖子中补充说：“鉴于威胁等级已经提高，我继续鼓励所有人向当局报告任何可疑或异常情况。”本周早些时候，至少12架美国空军飞机从附近的RAF Mildenhall基地起飞，其中包括两架Boeing Stratotanker KC-135加油机，其中一架显然飞往德国，另一架则被发现在格拉斯哥附近的Prestwick机场降落。9月RAF Fairford发生事件后，英国境内的美国基地加大了安全行动力度，首相Andy Burnham称伊朗参与其中。警方表示，在基地附近搜查货车时发现了汽油，但没有发现爆炸物。皇家检察署已就两名男子涉嫌卷入该事件提出指控。尽管伊朗否认负有责任，美国仍在10月将所有轰炸机撤出该基地。《华尔街日报》报道称，本周美国飞机离开RAF Mildenhall是为了应对伊朗发出的进一步威胁，但BBC尚未独立核实这一说法。本周早些时候，唐宁街坚持称英国空军基地是安全的，保障其安全是“首要优先事项”。RAF Lakenheath驻扎着美国空军第48战斗机联队，也称“自由之翼”，拥有近7,000名现役人员，其中部分驻扎在该基地。该联队官网称，“自由之翼”是美国在欧洲规模最大的战斗机作战部队，配备4个战备fighter中队

He maintained that the footage released by the Presidency showed Tinubu leaving the mosque after observing the Friday congregational prayers.
https://leadership.ng/presidency-release.summary_zh: 总统府发布了一段视频画面，显示总统博拉·蒂努布在参加星期五主麻礼拜后离开清真寺，此举是为了反驳反对派支持者中流传的关于其行踪的说法。他坚持称，总统府发布的画面显示，蒂努布在参加星期五聚礼后离开了清真寺。
https://leadership.ng/presidency-release.body: The Presidency has released video footage showing President Bola Tinubu leaving a mosque after observing Friday prayers, in a move to counter claims circulating among opposition supporters about his whereabouts. Senior Adviser to the President on Digital and New Media, Otega Ogra shared the footage on his X handle on Friday, describing reports and videos being circulated by opposition supporters as misleading. In the post, Ogra accused the opposition of pushing a false narrative about the President, alleging that videos circulating online featured individuals he described as paid thugs at the mosque. He maintained that the footage released by the Presidency showed Tinubu leaving the mosque after observing the Friday congregational prayers. He added, “Contrary to the narrative being pushed by the opposition, with videos of their alleged paid thugs at the Mosque today, here is footage of Mr. President leaving the mosque after Friday prayers this afternoon.” The presidential aide accompanied the post with a message of support for Tinubu and the country, saying, “God bless our President. https://leadership.ng/presidency-release.body_zh: 总统府发布了一段视频，显示总统博拉·蒂努布在参加星期五礼拜后离开清真寺，以反驳反对派支持者中流传的关于其行踪的说法。总统数字与新媒体高级顾问奥泰加·奥格拉星期五在X账号上分享了这段视频，称反对派支持者传播的相关报道和视频具有误导性。奥格拉在帖子中指责反对派散布有关总统的虚假叙事，声称网上流传的视频出现了他所谓的受雇打手。他坚持表示，总统府发布的画面显示，蒂努布在参加星期五聚礼后离开了清真寺。他补充道：“与反对派散布的说法相反，他们今天在清真寺拍摄所谓受雇打手的视频。这里是总统先生今天下午参加星期五礼拜后离开清真寺的画面。”这位总统顾问随帖附上对蒂努布和尼日利亚的支持信息，称：“愿上帝保佑我们的总统。愿上帝保佑尼日利亚。”我们掌握前沿资讯。实时报道、独家爆料和独家视角将直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，全天候获取最新消息 →

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body: The First Lady of Nigeria, Senator Oluremi Tinubu, received a rousing welcome from thousands of residents and supporters during her visit to Zamfara State. On Tuesday, the Zamfara State Government hosted the APC North-West Women’s Mega Rally and Empowerment Programme at the Trade Fair Complex in Gusau. The event, led by Zamfara First Lady Huriyya Dauda Lawal, brought together former Zamfara governors, the first ladies of the North-West, ministers and other key All Progressives Congress stakeholders. Before the rally, Senator Tinubu met with the Zamfara State traditional rulers to seek their blessings. In her remarks, Mrs Tinubu described her visit as a powerful expression of solidarity and compassion, as well as a commitment to women’s welfare and advancement, especially for those facing insecurity, poverty and limited economic opportunities. She said, “This is the happiest day of my life. Except for Zamfara, I have been in all 36 states of Nigeria, including the FCT. I have always wanted to come to Zamfara, and today I have fulfilled that. Because it is now easy to come, this is just the beginning; I am coming back again. Mr President is also coming. “Before I start, I want to commiserate with you all for all the lives that were lost; they are very precious to us. May God forgive them, grant them Al-Jannatul Firdaus, and continue to be with us. “Today is Juma’at; we have to be fast; we have empowerment to give to women. This is the only party that empowers during the campaign, and it is not about the campaign; we have been empowering from day one. And that is why it is not politics. “Earlier, I was also given a title in Zamfara, the ‘Jagaban Matan Arewa’ by the Chairman of the Zamfara State Council of Chiefs and Emir of Anka, Alhaji Attahiru Muhammad Ahmad. I thanked all the Emirs. “I love Zamfara. I am happy to be here. Mr President said I should tell you he will continue working for you. Nigeria will continue to prosper, in sha Allah.” Earlier, Governor Dauda Lawal thanked Senator Tinubu for her continued support through the Renewed Hope Initiative, including its Food Outreach Programme. “Your Excellency, Mother of the Nation, your presence today represents more than an official visit. You have set a record in the history of our dear Zamfara State. “Your Excellency, Distinguished ladies and gentlemen, in Zamfara State, we firmly believe that empowering women is not only our responsibility as a government; it is a needed and bankable investment in social and societal morality, economic prosperity, family stability, and sustainable peace. “I assure Your Excellency that Zamfara’s government and people unwaveringly support Mr President’s second term. With the women here and the men supporting them, Zamfara and the North West will deliver for Mr President come January 2027.”
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.title_zh: 扎姆法拉迎宾第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布，举行大型集会；925054
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body_zh:
尼日利亚第一夫人、参议员奥卢雷米·蒂努布在她访问赞法拉州期间，受到数千名居民和支持者的热烈欢迎。周二，赞法拉州政府在古绍的贸易展览中心主办了全进步大会党西北部妇女大型集会暨赋权计划。活动由赞法拉州第一夫人胡里娅·达乌达·拉瓦勒主持，赞法拉州历任州长、西北部各州第一夫人、部长及全进步大会党其他重要人士齐聚一堂。集会前，蒂努布参议员会见赞法拉州传统 ruler，争取他们的祝福。蒂努布夫人在讲话中表示，此次访问有力体现了团结与关怀，也表明政府致力于改善妇女福祉、推动妇女发展，尤其关注那些面临安全局势恶化、贫困和经济机会有限的妇女。她说：“这是我一生中最快乐的一天。除了赞法拉州，我走遍了尼日利亚全部36个州，包括联邦首都区。我一直想来赞法拉州，今天终于实现了。因为现在来这里已经很容易了，所以这才是开始；我还会再来。总统先生也会来。

“开始之前，我想对所有失去生命的人表示深切哀悼；他们的生命对我们非常宝贵。愿真主宽恕他们，赐予他们天堂的福地，并继续庇佑我们。

“今天是主麻日；我们必须抓紧时间；我们还有赋权成果要交给妇女。这是唯一一个在竞选期间为妇女赋权的政党，而且这并不只是竞选活动；我们从第一天起就一直在推动赋权。也正因为如此，这并不只是政治。

“此前，我还被授予了赞法拉州‘Jagaban Matan Arewa’的头衔，授予者是赞法拉州酋长委员会主席兼安卡埃米尔阿塔希鲁·穆罕默德·艾哈迈德。我感谢所有埃米尔。

“我热爱赞法拉州。我很高兴来到这里。总统先生让我告诉你们，他会继续为你们而努力。尼日利亚将继续繁荣，安拉如此。”

此前，达乌达·拉瓦勒州长感谢蒂努布参议员通过“ renewed Hope Initiative ”持续支持赞法拉州，包括该倡议下开展的食物援助计划。她说：“阁下、尼日利亚母后，您今天的到来不仅仅是一次官方访问。您在我们亲爱的赞法拉州历史上树立了典范。

“阁下、尊敬的女士们和先生们，在赞法拉州，我们坚信，赋予妇女权能不仅是政府的责任，也是对社会道德、经济繁荣、家庭稳定和持久和平的一项必要且值得投资的举措。

“我向阁下保证，赞法拉州政府和人民将坚定不移地支持总统先生连任。有了在场的妇女以及支持她们的男士，赞法拉州和西北部将在2027年1月为总统先生交出令人满意的成绩。”

https://leadership.ng/oriire-abduction-p.title: Oriire Abduction: Presidency Fires Back At Makinde, Says Tinubu Acted Swiftly
https://leadership.ng/oriire-abduction-p.summary: His response followed Makinde’s disclosure during an interview that he did not speak with President Tinubu throughout the over 50 days the victims were held captive, despite attempts to reach the President through his aide. Addressing the governor directly, Ogra said the federal government remained focused on its mandate to secure and prosper Nigeria under President Tinubu.
https://leadership.ng/oriire-abduction-p.summary_zh: 他的回应紧随马金德披露的情况之后。马金德在采访中表示，在受害者被囚禁的50多天里，他始终没有与蒂努布总统说过话，尽管曾试图通过总统助理联系总统。奥格拉直接对州长表示，在蒂努布总统领导下，联邦政府仍专注于确保尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）安全与繁荣这一使命。
https://leadership.ng/oriire-abduction-p.body: Senior Special Assistant to the President on Digital and New Media, Otega Ogra, said the Federal Government immediately deployed military and intelligence assets to Oyo State following the incident. Ogra, in a post on his X handle, said the operations led to the successful rescue of all the abducted children and teachers on July 10, 2026. His response followed Makinde’s disclosure during an interview that he did not speak with President Tinubu throughout the over 50 days the victims were held captive, despite attempts to reach the President through his aide. Addressing the governor directly, Ogra said the federal government remained focused on its mandate to secure and prosper Nigeria under President Tinubu. He maintained that the President prioritised concrete action and results over political point-scoring in addressing security challenges. According to him, the administration has introduced measures to strengthen the country’s security architecture, including the creation of a new Homeland Security position, improved coordination under the Office of the National Security Adviser (ONSA), and better equipment and remuneration for the military. He added that the government had also improved welfare across the security and intelligence agencies. On Makinde’s comments regarding the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC), Ogra stressed that the anti-graft agency remained independent and carried out its statutory responsibilities without political interference. He said President Tinubu had consistently maintained a non-interference policy regarding agencies and regulatory bodies with statutory independence. Ogra, however, criticised the governor’s comments, urging him to concentrate on governance and issue-based campaigning. “In my opinion, sir, political leaders like your good self should prioritise governance or focus on issues-based campaigning rather than such grandstanding that is now becoming the hallmark of your campaign,” he said. https://leadership.ng/oriire-abduction-p.body_zh: 总统数字与新媒体事务高级特别助理奥泰加·奥格拉表示，事件发生后，联邦政府立即向奥约州调配了军事和情报资源。奥格拉在其X账号发帖称，相关行动于2026年7月10日成功解救了所有被绑架的儿童和教师。此前，马金德在一次采访中透露，在受害者遭拘禁的50多天里，尽管他曾试图通过总统助手联系蒂努布总统，但一直没有与总统通话。奥格拉直接回应州长称，在蒂努布总统领导下，联邦政府始终专注于确保尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）安全、实现繁荣这一使命。他坚持认为，在应对安全挑战时，总统更重视实际行动和成效，而非争取政治得分。据他介绍，当局已推出多项措施加强国家安全体系，包括新设国土安全职位、加强国家安全顾问办公室（ONSA）统筹协调，以及改善军队装备和薪酬。他还表示，政府也提升了安全和情报机构的整体福利。针对马金德有关经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）的评论，奥格拉强调，这个反腐机构仍保持独立，并在不受政治干预的情况下履行法定职责。他说，蒂努布总统始终奉行不干预依法独立运行之机构及监管部门的政策。不过，奥格拉批评了州长的言论，敦促他专注于治理和以具体问题为基础的竞选活动。他说：“依我之见，先生，像您这样优秀的政治领导人，应当优先关注治理或围绕具体问题开展竞选，而不是像现在这样大做姿态，而这正逐渐成为您竞选活动的标志。”我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕消息和独家视角，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地接收全天候最新消息 →

Biodun Ogunleye, Commissioner for Energy and Mineral Resources, Lagos State. The recognition underscores Genesis Energy Holdings’commitment to advancing reliable electricity supply, developing critical power infrastructure and supporting the transformation of Lagos State’s energy sector through strategic investments and partnerships. Through its subsidiary, GELMAK Power Solutions Ltd, the company operates the Banana Island Local Grid Project in Ikoyi, Lagos, an integrated power generation and distribution network providing reliable electricity to residential and commercial customers. Designed to reduce dependence on expensive and polluting diesel and heavy fuel oil (HFO) generators, the project currently records approximately 99% uptime. Its infrastructure capacity was recently doubled from 15MVA to 30MVA following the commissioning of an expanded substation, strengthening its ability to meet the growing electricity demand within the community. Further demonstrating its commitment to expanding electricity infrastructure across Lagos State , GENESIS is developing Project Echo, the 260MW Ikorodu Power Project, in partnership with the Lagos State Government under the CLEM initiative. With the Lagos State Market Operator as off-taker, the gas-fired power project is designed to deliver reliable, grid-integrated electricity, strengthening power supply across Ikorodu and supporting the development of a more resilient electricity market. Once operational, the project is expected to improve electricity availability for households, businesses and industries, while stimulating economic activity and supporting the area’s continued development. Commenting on the awards, Chairman and CEO of Genesis Energy, Mr Akinwole II Omoboriowo, said: “We want to extend our gratitude to Lagos State for giving us the opportunity to serve. We are most grateful for this recognition, which, for us, is both an honour and a call to action – a call to invest more. The business of energy is a very serious affair. Without energy, there can be no life. For us at GENESIS, it is not just a business; it is a lifelong commitment to uplifting our country and our continent, with Lagos State being at the forefront of that commitment.” These investments reflect the Group’s alignment with Lagos State’s electricity sector reform agenda, particularly the objectives of the Lagos State Electricity Law 2024, which provides a framework for developing a competitive, transparent and commercially viable electricity market. Since its establishment in 2005, Genesis Energy Holdings has developed and financed clean energy projects across Africa, with operations and project footprints spanning 11 African countries. The company deploys a diverse range of technologies, including solar photovoltaic (PV), battery energy storage systems (BESS), natural gas, wind, hydro and hybrid solutions, to develop reliable and sustainable energy infrastructure for businesses, governments and communities. Its Nigerian portfolio includes the 84MW gas-fired power project at the Port Harcourt Refinery Complex, one of Nigeria’s largest licensed private off-grid power plants and NIDI project in Kano. In 2025, the Group further expanded its engagement in Nigeria through a US$500 million Memorandum of Understanding with the Katsina State Government for the development, financing, construction, operation and maintenance of major energy infrastructure projects across the State. With a vision to “Light Up Africa One Community at a Time,” GENESIS remains committed to developing and deploying reliable, affordable and sustainable energy infrastructure that addresses the continent’s growing energy needs. Through strategic investments, innovative technologies and partnerships with governments and private-sector stakeholders, the company continues to advance energy access, strengthen energy security and support economic development across Africa

Biodun Ogunleye授予公司。这一认可凸显了Genesis Energy Holdings致力于推进可靠电力供应、建设关键电力基础设施，并通过战略投资与合作推动拉各斯州能源部门转型的承诺。公司通过子公司GELMAK Power Solutions Ltd运营位于拉各斯Ikoyi的Banana Island Local Grid项目。该项目是一体化发电与配电网络，为住宅和商业客户提供可靠电力，旨在减少对昂贵且污染严重的柴油和重燃油（HFO）发电机的依赖，目前运行时间占比约为99%。扩建变电站投运后，其基础设施容量近期从15MVA增至30MVA，增强了满足社区不断增长的用电需求的能力。GENESIS还与拉各斯州政府合作，在CLEM倡议框架下开发Echo项目，即260MW的Ikorodu电力项目，以进一步扩大拉各斯州电力基础设施。项目由拉各斯州市场运营商作为购电方，这座燃气发电项目旨在输送可靠、并网运行的电力，加强Ikorodu的电力供应，并支持建设更具韧性的电力市场。项目投入运营后，预计将改善家庭、企业和工业用电的可用性，同时激发经济活动并支持当地持续发展。Genesis Energy董事长兼首席执行官Akinwole II Omoboriowo先生谈及获奖时表示：“我们要向拉各斯州给予我们服务机会表示由衷感谢。我们非常感谢这份认可，对我们而言，它既是一份荣誉，也是一项行动号召——呼吁我们加大投资。能源事业是一项非常严肃的事业。没有能源，就没有生活。对GENESIS而言，能源不仅是一门生意，更是一项毕生致力于提升我们国家和我们大陆福祉的承诺，而拉各斯州始终走在这一承诺的最前沿。”这些投资体现着集团与拉各斯州电力部门改革议程的一致性，特别是对《2024年拉各斯州电力法》目标的支持。该法为建设竞争、透明且具有商业可行性的电力市场提供了框架。自2005年成立以来，Genesis Energy Holdings已在非洲各地开发并资助清洁能源项目，业务及项目遍及11个非洲国家。公司采用多种技术，包括太阳能光伏（PV）、电池储能系统（BESS）、天然气、风能、水电和混合能源解决方案，为企业、政府和社区建设可靠、可持续的能源基础设施。其在尼日利亚的项目组合包括位于哈科特港炼油厂的84MW燃气发电项目——这是尼日利亚规模最大的持牌私营离网电站之一——以及位于卡诺的NIDI项目。2025年，集团通过与卡塔琳娜州政府签署价值US$500 million的谅解备忘录，进一步扩大在尼日利亚的业务合作，开发、融资、建设和运营维护该州的大型能源基础设施项目。秉持“逐个社区点亮非洲”的愿景，GENESIS继续致力于开发和部署可靠、可负担且可持续的能源基础设施，应对非洲大陆不断增长的能源需求。公司通过战略投资、创新技术以及与政府和私营部门相关方的合作，持续推进能源可及性、强化能源安全并支持非洲各地经济发展。

https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.body: DUBLIN — Friday's widespread outage of Microsoft products has sparked a new wave of calls for Europe to control its own digital infrastructure — especially with the uncertain future of artificial intelligence at stake. "Only 20% of European digital services run on European infrastructure," Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch said in remarks Friday after he addressed EU national leaders during their first-ever meeting on artificial intelligence in Dublin. The money spent on foreign, U.S. or Chinese, technology "could be reinvested here, on infrastructure we control and [to] finance European research and development," said the boss of Europe's leading AI frontier lab. Mensch didn't specifically address the Microsoft outage, which lasted nearly 24 hours and affected millions of users in 74 countries. Still, the shutdown of key tools like Outlook email and Teams messaging impacted plenty of the tech and government leaders gathered in Dublin to chart Europe’s AI future. French President Emmanuel Macron closed the day with a post on X : “Our independence cannot be outsourced. It must be built here at home, in Europe,” he wrote. "When it comes to artificial intelligence, too, Europe has everything it takes to compete. We have no time to lose.” Tech sovereignty, including control over the cloud, chips and models that power AI, has been a rallying cry of the second mandate of European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, and was one of the key agenda items at Friday's gathering of the leaders of the EU's 27 member countries. "We have outsourced too much of our digital infrastructure to actors outside the EU," Finnish European Parliament lawmaker Aura Salla said in a press release Friday following the outage. She suggested that government contracts specifically "must support European technology." Others zoned in on the risk created by relying on digital infrastructure controlled by a couple of large companies. The Microsoft outage is a "reminder of the systemic risk created by concentrating digital infrastructure with a few global tech giants," said Sebastian Toffaletti, secretary general of the Digital SME Alliance, in a statement shared with POLITICO. In Germany, lawmaker Johannes Schätzl from the Social Democratic Party said it raised questions about public procurement. “Digital sovereignty must be measured by whether we can remain operational even during outages like this,” he said

https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.body_zh: 都柏林——微软旗下产品周五发生大范围故障，再次引发要求欧洲掌控自身数字基础设施的呼声，尤其是在人工智能前景存在不确定性的背景下。Mistral首席执行官Arthur Mensch周五发表讲话称：“欧洲只有20%的数字服务运行在欧洲的基础设施上。”他此前在都柏林举行的首次欧盟各国领导人人工智能会议上发表了演讲。这家欧洲领先的前沿人工智能实验室负责人说，花在外国、美国或中国技术上的资金“可以在这里重新投资，用于我们掌控的基础设施，并资助欧洲的研究与开发”。Mensch没有直接评论微软故障。这次故障持续近24小时，影响了74个国家的数百万用户。不过，包括Outlook电子邮件和Teams即时通信在内的关键工具中断，还是影响了许多齐聚都柏林、筹划欧洲人工智能未来的科技和政府领导人。法国总统Emmanuel Macron在X上发帖为当天收尾：“我们的独立不能外包。必须在这里、在欧洲亲手建设。”他写道：“谈到人工智能，欧洲同样具备参与竞争的一切条件。我们没有时间可以浪费。”包括掌控云、芯片和人工智能模型在内的技术主权，一直是欧洲委员会主席Ursula von der Leyen第二任期的号召，也是周五欧盟27个成员国领导人会议的主要议程之一。芬兰籍欧洲议会议员Aura Salla在故障发生后于周五发布的新闻稿中说：“我们已将太多数字基础设施外包给欧盟之外的参与者。”她建议，政府合同必须明确“支持欧洲技术”。其他人则将焦点放在依赖少数几家公司掌控的数字基础设施所带来的风险上。Digital SME Alliance秘书长Sebastian Toffaletti在与POLITICO分享的一份声明中说，微软故障“提醒人们，将数字基础设施集中在少数全球科技巨头手中，会造成系统性风险”。德国社会民主党的议员Johannes Schätzl表示，此事引出了有关公共采购的问题。他说：“数字主权必须以我们能否在此类故障期间仍保持运行为衡量标准。”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body: Nigeria’s High Commissioner to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, has presented his Letter of Credence to South African President Cyril Ramaphosa, marking the official commencement of his diplomatic assignment in the country. Mr Fani-Kayode presented his letter to Mr Ramaphosa at the Sefako Makgatho Presidential Guest House in Pretoria, the official residence of the South African Presidency, on Friday. The High Commissioner shared the development on X, describing the event as “great and historic.” Letters of credence are formal diplomatic documents issued by a country’s head of state to confirm the appointment of a High Commissioner or permanent representative. They officially introduce the envoy to the receiving authority, in this case, the South African president, and certify that the individual is empowered to speak and act on behalf of their nation. Mr Fani-Kayode presented his letter of credence alongside ambassadors from 14 other countries. Each was formally introduced and given the floor to speak. He pledged to strengthen diplomatic relations between both countries, describing the restoration of their historic friendship as a key priority of his diplomatic mission. The envoy, also accredited to Lesotho and Eswatini, conveyed President Bola Tinubu’s goodwill to Mr Ramaphosa. This comes amid tense relations between Nigeria and South Africa over xenophobic violence that forced many African states to evacuate their citizens residing in the country. Mr Fani-Kayode had previously condemned violence against Nigerian nationals by South African security officials. He estimated that at least 30 Nigerians have been killed by the state’s police in the last four years. 12 Nigerians have also been killed since the start of the year. In September, the High Commissioner said Nigeria’s patience was running thin. Speaking at the ceremony, however, Mr Fani-Kayode recalled Nigeria’s support for South Africa during the struggle against apartheid, saying both countries shared a longstanding history of solidarity and friendship. He described Nigeria and South Africa as major trading partners on the continent and stressed the importance of preserving their historical ties. “Part of my job here is to reset that relationship, to come and build that bridge, and to ensure that whatever concerns we have, we can work them out and move forward together,” he said. Mr Fani-Kayode added that closer cooperation between the two countries would strengthen Africa’s position and advance the interests of their citizens. “If Nigeria and South Africa work closely together, the destiny of our great continent will be more secure,” he said. The high commissioner also commended South Africa’s contributions to international diplomacy, particularly its role in BRICS, the Global South and the Group of 20 (G20). He described South Africa’s engagement in global affairs as important to strengthening Africa’s representation on the international stage. Meanwhile, Mr Fani-Kayode, on his X handle, complained that the South African presidential media team failed to live-stream his speech despite capturing those of the other ambassadors present. “Of all the 15 introductions and speeches that were made and delivered this morning, only Nigeria’s was cut out,” he said. “To be clear, I repeat, we were the ONLY ones that were left out.” “Clearly, some elements in South Africa do not want to hear what we have to say or see our faces, but we are here to stay as long as we are welcome and have the confidence of President Ramaphosa, which I am sure we do,” he noted further

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body_zh: 尼日利亚驻南非大使费米·法尼-卡约德向南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨递交国书，正式开始其在南非的外交任期。法尼-卡约德先生于星期五在比勒陀利亚的塞法科·马卡托总统迎宾馆——南非总统府官方官邸——向拉马福萨先生递交国书。大使在X平台分享了这一消息，称此次活动“重大而具有历史意义”。国书是由一国国家元首签发的正式外交文件，用于确认任命高级专员或常驻代表。国书向接受国主管机构正式介绍特使，本例中的接受国主管机构是南非总统，并证明该人士获授权代表本国发表言论和采取行动。法尼-卡约德先生与其他14个国家的大使一同递交国书。每位大使均获正式介绍，并获发言机会。他承诺加强两国外交关系，并将恢复两国历史友谊列为其外交使命的一项重点。该特使同时获派驻莱索托和斯威士兰，并向拉马福萨先生转达了博拉·蒂努布总统的友好问候。此前，尼日利亚与南非因针对外国人的暴力袭击而关系紧张，许多非洲国家被迫撤离居住在南非的本国公民。法尼-卡约德先生此前曾谴责南非安全官员针对尼日利亚公民的暴力行为。他估计，过去四年间，该国警察已造成至少30名尼日利亚人死亡。今年年初以来，又有12名尼日利亚人死亡。9月，大使表示尼日利亚的耐心已接近极限。不过，法尼-卡约德先生在仪式上回顾了尼日利亚在南非反抗种族隔离斗争期间对南非的支持，称两国共享源远流长的团结与友谊历史。他将尼日利亚和南非描述为非洲大陆的重要贸易伙伴，并强调维护两国历史联系的重要性。他说：“我在这里承担的工作之一，就是重置双方关系，前来搭建这座桥梁，并确保无论双方有何关切，都能共同解决分歧，携手向前。”法尼-卡约德先生补充说，两国加强合作将增强非洲的立场，并促进两国公民的利益。他说：“如果尼日利亚和南非紧密合作，我们这个伟大大陆的未来将更加稳固。”大使还赞扬南非对国际外交的贡献，尤其是南非在金砖国家、全球南方和二十国集团（G20）中的作用。他表示，南非参与全球事务对于加强非洲在国际舞台上的代表性至关重要。与此同时，法尼-卡约德先生在其X账号上抱怨，尽管南非总统媒体团队拍摄了其他在场大使的演讲，却未对本国演讲进行直播。他说：“今天上午进行的15次介绍和发言中，唯独尼日利亚的发言被剪掉了。”“明确地说，我再重复一遍，我们是唯一被排除在外的。”他进一步指出：“显然，南非某些人士不希望听到我们要说的话，也不希望看到我们的面孔；但只要我们受到欢迎，并得到拉马福萨总统的信任，我们就会留在这里。我确信我们确实得到了他的信任。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary_zh: 韩国产业部表示，在国际油价高企和中东地区持续紧张局势的背景下，韩国政府周五连续第五个周期维持燃油产品最高限价不变。自6月26日下调后，政府已将最高限价维持在当前水平20周。政府于3月中旬推出燃油最高限价，旨在稳定因美伊战争在中东引发的供应链中断而出现波动的国内燃油价格。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body: The Korean government on Friday kept its price caps on fuel products unchanged for a fifth consecutive period amid elevated international oil prices and continued tensions in the Middle East, the industry ministry said. The maximum prices at which local refiners can supply gasoline, diesel and kerosene to gas stations will remain unchanged at 1,784 won ($1.3), 1,773 won and 1,380 won per liter, respectively, for the four weeks beginning Saturday, according to the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources. The government has kept the caps at their current levels for 20 weeks since June 27, following a reduction on June 26. "International oil prices fell below $100 per barrel, with Brent crude reaching $96 per barrel on Nov. 12. However, the price remains more than $20 higher than at the end of June," the ministry said. The freeze is aimed at easing upward pressure on consumer prices amid elevated oil prices and high ocean freight costs, it added. The government introduced the fuel price caps in mid-March to stabilize domestic fuel prices amid supply chain disruptions stemming from the U.S.-Iran war in the Middle East. It plans to adjust the emergency measures as necessary while closely monitoring developments in the Middle East and economic conditions at home
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.title_zh: 中东局势紧张之际，首尔冻结燃油价格上限
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body_zh: 韩国政府周五表示，在国际油价高企和中东地区持续紧张的背景下，连续第五个周期维持燃油产品价格上限不变。根据韩国贸易、工业和资源部消息，自周六起四周内，本地炼油商向加油站供应汽油、柴油和煤油的最高价格将分别维持在每升1,784韩元（1.3美元）、1,773韩元和1,380韩元。自6月26日下调价格上限以来，政府已连续20周将上限维持在当前水平。该部称：“国际油价已跌破每桶100美元，布伦特原油在11月12日降至每桶96美元。然而，油价仍比6月底高出20多美元。”该部补充称，冻结价格上限旨在缓解油价高企和海运费高企给消费者价格带来的上行压力。政府于3月中旬推出燃油价格上限，以稳定因美伊战争在中东引发供应链中断而上涨的国内燃油价格。政府计划在密切监测中东局势和国内经济状况的同时，必要时对这些紧急措施作出调整。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary: Former official drops chamber folk album adapting classic sonnets Yong Ho-seong, former vice minister of culture, sports and tourism, is stepping into a bold new chapter of his creative life by using artificial intelligence (AI) technology to set classical literature to music. 10, breathing contemporary musical life into 15 of William Shakespeare's sonnets through AI-assisted composition and vocals.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 前官员推出商会民谣专辑，改编经典十四行诗。前文化、体育和旅游副部长 Yong Ho-seong 正利用人工智能（AI）技术为古典文学谱曲，开启艺术生涯大胆崭新的篇章。他借助 AI 辅助作曲和演唱，为威廉·莎士比亚的15首十四行诗注入当代音乐生命力，共推出10张唱片。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Former official drops chamber folk album adapting classic sonnets Yong Ho-seong, former vice minister of culture, sports and tourism, is stepping into a bold new chapter of his creative life by using artificial intelligence (AI) technology to set classical literature to music. Performing under the stage name Dr. Dragon, Yong released his debut full-length album, "Fragile Beauty," on Nov. 10, breathing contemporary musical life into 15 of William Shakespeare's sonnets through AI-assisted composition and vocals. The release marks the first installment of "DiVerse," an ambitious ongoing project to set all 154 of Shakespeare's sonnets to modern music. The idea was sparked by a hardcover edition of Shakespeare's complete sonnets that a British friend gifted him during his tenure as director of the Korean Cultural Centre UK. "The name reflects both Shakespeare's original verse and the newly written lyrics, as well as the diverse musical genres used to reimagine centuries-old classics," Yong told The Korea Times during an interview in Seoul, Thursday. The former vice minister explained that the album's sound production leans into late-1960s avant-garde folk and chamber folk, driven by nylon-string guitars, upright contrabass, cellos, violas, flutes, harmoniums and bass clarinets, while featuring the contralto tones of his AI vocal persona NikkiD. "Rather than big, sweeping arrangements, the quiet, intimate sound of late-1960s chamber folk felt like the right fit for these poems," Yong said. Yong’s journey into music creation is rooted in a lifelong passion. Long before entering government service, he studied classical music and jazz extensively and built a massive personal collection of over 10,000 records. While serving as a government official, he also debuted as a music critic in 1993 after winning an annual music criticism competition hosted by the prominent performing arts magazine Auditorium. He has also spent decades playing drums in jazz and rock bands. After retiring from his career as a high-ranking bureaucrat last year — during which he played a pivotal role in establishing major cultural institutions and drafting key legislation — Yong turned his sights toward AI. In July, he won the AI.LOVE.JAZZ. composition competition in Montreux, Switzerland, with "Frozen Edge," a vocal jazz piece inspired by Shakespeare's Sonnet 97. For Yong, AI is not a replacement for human artistry, but an essential creative tool. "AI is a loyal assistant that expands the possibilities of songwriting and production," the creator said. "I write detailed prompts spanning a full page to specify rhythm, instrumentation and musical references, and sometimes regenerate a track 30 or 40 times before editing individual tracks myself until I find the exact sound I envision." Comparing AI to the historical introduction of digital sampling in popular music decades ago in the 1980s, the former official believes that technology ultimately broadens the base of music creators rather than diminishing human value. Rather than requiring years of formal composition training, individuals with a clear artistic perspective can now use these tools to bring their musical concepts to life, he added. "Just like sampling decades ago, AI acts as a faithful assistant that expands the pool of people who can create music, making the process far more efficient for everyone," Yong said. Looking ahead, he envisions how this collaborative approach could even transform traditional education by allowing students to turn personal stories and daily emotions into original songs. "When students learn to turn their daily experiences into melodies, music becomes a powerful tool for self-expression," Yong said. Following the release of "Fragile Beauty," Yong plans to issue a new sonnet-inspired album every month, spanning genres from jazz and blues to hip-hop, rap-metal and K-pop. He has already reached out to various Shakespeare-related societies, associations and academic institutions around the world to explore educational and cultural collaborations. He is also developing progressive rock operas based on Shakespeare's tragedies, such as "Hamlet" and "Macbeth," alongside a project reinterpreting the poetry of Joseon Dynasty poet Yi Mae-chang (1573-1610). "Just as I am reimagining Shakespeare, I wanted to bring the poignant and soul-searching poetry of Yi Mae-chang into contemporary folk and blues," Yong said. While the former vice minister devotes up to six hours a day to composing and two hours of practicing drums, Yong said his creative ventures are fueled by personal fulfillment rather than commercial success. He recently earned his first-ever revenue as a musician by composing a theme song for T&C Foundation, a public interest foundation, though the ex-official primarily views his creative output as a natural extension of a well-prepared second act in life. "For me, happiness is not about the high intensity of achievements, but the frequency of joyful moments," Yong said. "Whether it is practicing drums in the morning or giving classical literature a new voice through modern music, I am simply enjoying a life where I can freely explore what I love."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 前副部长借助人工智能音乐让莎士比亚鲜活起来
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh:
前官员发行室内民谣专辑，以人工智能改编古典十四行诗
前文化、体育和旅游部副部长龙浩成正以人工智能（AI）技术为古典文学谱曲，开启创意人生的大胆新篇章。他以艺名“Dragon博士”演出，11月10日发行首张完整专辑《脆弱之美》，通过人工智能辅助作曲和人声演绎，为威廉·莎士比亚的15首十四行诗注入当代音乐生命力。这次发行是“DiVerse”计划的第一部分；该雄心勃勃的持续项目旨在将莎士比亚全部154首十四行诗谱成现代音乐。这一构想源于一位英国朋友在他担任韩国文化中心英国主任期间送给他的《莎士比亚十四行诗全集》精装版。龙浩成周四在首尔接受《韩国时报》采访时表示：“这个名字既反映莎士比亚的原诗，也体现新创作的歌词，以及重新演绎百年经典时采用的多样音乐类型。”这位前副部长介绍，专辑的声音制作以20世纪60年代末的前卫民谣和室内民谣为主，由尼龙弦吉他、立式低音提琴、大提琴、中提琴、长笛、风琴和低音单簧管支撑，并展现其人工智能人声形象NikkiD的女中音音色。龙浩成说：“与宏大、层层铺陈的编曲相比，20世纪60年代末室内民谣安静而亲密的声音，更适合这些诗。”
龙浩成投身音乐创作，源于一生的热爱。早在进入政府部门之前，他就广泛学习古典音乐和爵士乐，并收藏了1万多张唱片。担任政府官员期间，他还在1993年赢得知名表演艺术杂志《Auditorium》主办的一年一度音乐评论比赛，首次以乐评人身份登台。他还花了数十年时间在爵士和摇滚乐队中担任鼓手。去年从高级官僚职位退休——任职期间，他在建立重要文化机构和起草关键立法方面发挥了关键作用——后，龙浩成将目光转向人工智能。今年7月，他凭借受莎士比亚第97首十四行诗启发创作的声乐爵士作品《冰冻边缘》，在瑞士蒙特勒赢得AI.LOVE.JAZZ.作曲比赛。这位创作者表示，对龙浩成而言，人工智能不是人类艺术创作的替代品，而是一种不可或缺的创作工具。他说：“人工智能是一名忠实的助手，扩大了歌曲创作和制作的可能性。我会写满整整一页的详细提示词，规定节奏、乐器配置和音乐参考，有时还会将一首曲子重新生成30或40次，再亲自编辑各个音轨，直到找到自己设想的确切声音。”
这位前官员将人工智能与20世纪80年代数字采样技术首次引入流行音乐作比较，认为技术最终拓宽了音乐创作者的群体，而非削弱人的价值。他补充说，人们不必再经过多年的正规作曲训练，只要拥有清晰的艺术视角，如今就能利用这些工具让音乐构想成为现实。龙浩成说：“就像几十年前的采样一样，人工智能是一名忠实的助手，扩大了能够创作音乐的人群，让每个人的创作过程都高效得多。”
展望未来，他设想这种协作方式甚至可以改变传统教育，让学生能够将个人故事和日常感受转化为原创歌曲。龙浩成说：“当学生学会把日常经历化为旋律时，音乐就成为自我表达的强大工具。”继《脆弱之美》发行后，龙浩成计划每月推出一张受十四行诗启发的专辑，涵盖爵士、布鲁斯、嘻哈、说唱金属和K-pop等多种风格。他还联系了世界各地与莎士比亚有关的社团、协会和学术机构，探讨教育与文化合作。他也在根据莎士比亚的悲剧创作前卫摇滚歌剧，如《哈姆雷特》和《麦克白》，同时推进一个重新诠释朝鲜王朝诗人李梅昌（1573—1610）诗歌的项目。龙浩成说：“就像我重新演绎莎士比亚一样，我也希望把李梅昌那些动人、直击灵魂的诗歌带入当代民谣和布鲁斯。”
这位前副部长每天最多投入六小时作曲，并花两小时练习鼓乐。龙浩成说，他的创作动力来自个人满足感，而非商业成功。他最近通过为公益基金会T&C Foundation创作主题曲，首次获得音乐人生的第一笔收入；但这位前官员主要把自己的创作成果视为充分准备的人生第二幕的自然延伸。龙浩成说：“对我来说，快乐不在于成就的高强度，而在于欢乐时刻的频率。无论是清晨练鼓，还是通过现代音乐为古典文学赋予新声，我只是在享受一种能够自由探索所爱之物的生活。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: The Korean government said Friday that Google has complied with security requirements imposed as a condition for allowing the transfer of high-precision map data overseas. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport said a government-led consultation body reviewed Google's implementation of security measures following its conditional approval in February to export 1:5,000-scale digital map data.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 韩国政府周五表示，Google已经遵守相关安全要求；这些要求是获准向海外传输高精度地图数据的附加条件。国土交通部表示，政府牵头的咨询机构审查了Google落实安全措施的情况。该机构曾于2月有条件批准Google出口比例尺为1:5000的数字地图数据。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: The Korean government said Friday that Google has complied with security requirements imposed as a condition for allowing the transfer of high-precision map data overseas. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport said a government-led consultation body reviewed Google's implementation of security measures following its conditional approval in February to export 1:5,000-scale digital map data. The review found that the global tech giant had implemented measures to prevent the exposure of geographic coordinates, as well as sensitive military and security facilities, on its global Google Maps and Google Earth services, including web and mobile platforms. To meet the requirements, Google developed a dedicated control system for Korea and introduced safeguards to block app updates if they risk exposing restricted geographic coordinates. In August, Google also signed an agreement to obtain satellite imagery processed for security purposes by the National Geographic Information Institute (NGII) through a local partner. Google is said to have chosen the local navigation company, TMAP Mobility, to process base map data, according to industry sources. Under the agreement, Google must replace existing imagery on its map services as soon as it receives the security-processed images, without making any modifications. Currently, Naver Map, operated by the local portal giant Naver Corp., is the most widely used service in the country, with monthly active users of 31.2 million in October, according to data from market tracker Mobile Index. TMAP came next with 15.1 monthly active users, followed by Kakao Map with 13.8 million users and Google Map with 10.5 million users locally
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 韩国政府：Google遵守韩国对高精度地图数据的安全要求
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 韩国政府周五表示，Google 已遵守相关安全要求；这些要求是允许其向海外传输高精度地图数据的附加条件。国土交通部表示，政府牵头的咨询机构审查了 Google 在2月获准出口比例尺为1:5,000的数字地图数据后所采取安全措施的落实情况。审查发现，这家全球科技巨头已在旗下 Google Maps 和 Google Earth 服务（包括网页端和移动端）实施相关措施，防止泄露地理坐标以及敏感的军事和安全设施。为满足有关要求，Google 为韩国开发了一套专用控制系统，并设置安全防护机制，在应用更新可能暴露受限地理坐标时予以阻止。今年8月，Google 还签署了一项协议，将通过一家本地合作伙伴获取由国家地理信息院（NGII）出于安全目的处理的卫星图像。据行业消息人士称，Google 选择了本地导航企业 TMAP Mobility 处理基础地图数据。根据该协议，Google 在收到经过安全处理的图像后，必须立即替换其地图服务中的现有图像，且不得作任何修改。据市场追踪机构 Mobile Index 的数据，目前由本地门户网站巨头 Naver Corp. 运营的 Naver Map 是韩国使用最广泛的服务，10月月活跃用户达到3120万。TMAP 以1510万月活跃用户紧随其后，Kakao Map 和 Google Map 在当地的月活跃用户分别为1380万和1050万

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.title: 조현 "한반도 中 건설적 역할" 당부…왕이 "정책 변함없다"(종합)
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.summary: (베이징·서울=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 김지헌 기자 = 조현 외교부 장관이 13일 한반도 문제와 관련한 중국의 건설적 역할을 당부했다. 왕이 중국 외교부장은 중국의 한반도 정책에는 변함이 없다면서 한반도 평화·안정을 위한 건설적 역할을 지속해 나갈 것임을 재확인했다. 외교부는 두 장관이 이날 오후 중국 베이징 댜오위타이(釣魚臺) 국빈관에서 3시간에 걸쳐 외교장관회담과 만찬을 갖고 한중 관계와 한반도 문제 등 상호 관심사에 대해 의견을 교환했다고 밝혔다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.summary_zh: （北京、首尔=韩联社）韩中首席特派记者金智宪报道：外交部长赵显13日就朝鲜半岛问题呼吁中国发挥建设性作用。中国外交部长王毅表示，中国对朝鲜半岛的政策没有改变，并将继续为朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定发挥建设性作用。外交部表示，两位外交部长当天下午在北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行会谈并共进晚餐，双方就韩中关系、朝鲜半岛问题等共同关心的事项交换了意见，会谈持续3小时。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.body: (베이징·서울=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 김지헌 기자 = 조현 외교부 장관이 13일 한반도 문제와 관련한 중국의 건설적 역할을 당부했다. 왕이 중국 외교부장은 중국의 한반도 정책에는 변함이 없다면서 한반도 평화·안정을 위한 건설적 역할을 지속해 나갈 것임을 재확인했다. 외교부는 두 장관이 이날 오후 중국 베이징 댜오위타이(釣魚臺) 국빈관에서 3시간에 걸쳐 외교장관회담과 만찬을 갖고 한중 관계와 한반도 문제 등 상호 관심사에 대해 의견을 교환했다고 밝혔다. 조 장관은 한반도의 평화·안정이 한중 양국의 공동 이익임을 강조했고 한반도 비핵화와 평화 실현을 위한 정부의 노력을 설명했으며 북한의 대화 복귀 등 한반도 문제에서 중국의 역할을 당부했다. 왕 부장은 이에 대해 답하면서 '비핵화' 표현을 명시적으로 쓰지 않는 최근의 태도를 이어갔지만, 비핵화가 포함되는 기존의 중국 대한반도 정책에 변함이 없다는 입장을 반복했다. 왕 부장은 지난 8월 서울에서 조 장관과 외교장관회담을 벌였을 때도 '한반도 문제에 대한 중국의 입장은 연속적이고 안정적'이라는 취지로 언급한 바 있다. 회담에서 조 장관은 정부가 작년 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 의장국으로서 내주 개최되는 선전 APEC 정상회의의 성공적 개최를 기원한다고 했다. 이어 선전에서 양국 정상 간 교류가 한중 전략적 협력 동반자 관계를 더욱 성숙하게 발전시키는 중요한 계기가 될 수 있도록 잘 준비해 나가자고 했다. 왕 부장은 한중 관계의 긍정적 흐름이 작년 경주에서 선전으로 이어지고 있음을 평가하면서 이재명 대통령의 선전 APEC 계기 방중을 환영하며 충분한 예우를 갖춰 이번 방문이 성공적으로 이루어질 수 있도록 하겠다고 화답했다. 양 장관은 작년과 올해 양국 정상의 상호 국빈방문을 통한 한중관계 전면 복원의 흐름이 구체 성과로 나타나고 있음을 평가하고, 내년 수교 35주년을 맞아 양국 국민이 체감할 수 있는 실질적인 성과를 지속 창출해 나가기 위한 여러 방안에 대해 논의했다. 특히 한중 자유무역협정(FTA) 서비스·투자 협상 진전을 통해 양국의 수평적·호혜적 경제협력의 기반을 강화해 나가는 한편 양 국민 간 인적교류를 확대하고 우호정서를 증진하기 위한 노력도 강화해 나가자는 데도 의견을 같이 했다. 조 장관은 서해 문제 등 사안에서 한국의 원칙적 입장을 전달했으며 중국 내 한국 국민의 안전과 권익 보호를 위한 중국 정부의 노력도 당부했다. 이와 관련해 양 장관은 이런 사안들이 양국 관계 발전에 걸림돌이 되지 않도록 세심하게 관리해 나가자는 데 공감했다고 외교부가 전했다. 회담의 본격적 시작에 앞서 조 장관은 모두발언을 통해 "한반도 문제는 대한민국의 사활적 이익이며 한반도 평화와 안정은 양국의 공동이익"이라며 "한반도 정세 진전을 위해 양국 간 전략적 소통을 계속 강화해 나가기를 기대한다"고 말했다. 이어 "다음 주 선전에서 양국 정상이 10개월 만에 다시 만나 한중 전략적 협력 동반자 관계를 더욱 성숙하게 발전시켜 나가는 중요한 계기를 만들 것으로 기대한다"며 "경주에서 시작된 두 정상 간 우정과 신뢰의 이야기가 베이징을 거쳐 선전으로 이어지면서 한중 관계도 더욱 돈독해지기를 희망한다"고 말했다. 조 장관은 지난해 11월과 올해 1월 양국 정상의 상호 국빈 방문 이후 한중 관계가 전면 복원의 흐름을 공고히 해왔다고 평가했다. 그러면서 "올해 한중 인적 교류는 1천만명을 돌파할 것으로 예상된다"며 "한중 간 교역도 40% 넘게 증가했다"고 말했다. 이어 "이는 양국 정상 간 전면적 관계 복원에 대한 공동 인식을 이행하기 위해 양국 정부가 긴밀히 소통하며 함께 노력해온 결과"라고 강조했다. 조 장관은 이번 회담을 통해 다음 주 양국 정상의 만남이 성공적으로 이뤄질 수 있도록 협의하기를 기대한다고 덧붙였다. 왕 부장은 모두발언에서 "지난해 말과 올해 초 시진핑 국가주석과 이재명 대통령의 성공적인 상호 방문으로 중한 관계가 개선과 발전의 정상 궤도로 돌아왔다"고 평가했다. 이어 "다음 단계의 고위급 접촉을 준비하는 것이 매우 필요하다"며 "내년 중한 수교 35주년을 계기로 양국이 함께 노력해 전략적 협력 동반자 관계를 올바른 궤도로 발전시켜 나가야 한다"고 강조했다. 왕 부장은 올해 양국 교역액이 사상 최고치를 기록할 것으로 전망하면서 인적 왕래도 연간 1천만명 수준을 회복할 것으로 기대했다. 그는 다음 주 선전 APEC 정상회의에 이 대통령을 비롯한 여러 회원국 정상이 참석하기로 확정됐다며 한국이 지난해 경주 APEC 정상회의를 성공적으로 개최했다고 평가했다. 그러면서 "중한 양국이 잇따라 APEC 회의를 개최하는 만큼 손을 맞잡고 아시아태평양 공동체 건설을 함께 추진해 역내 공동 발전과 번영을 촉진해야 한다"고 말했다. 왕 부장은 한국이 중국의 APEC 개최 준비에 적극적으로 참여하고 기여한 점도 높이 평가하며 선전 정상회의가 양국 관계에 새로운 동력을 제공할 것이라는 기대를 나타냈다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/13 23:47 송고 2026년11월13일 23시47분 송고 (베이징=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 = 13일 오후 https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.title_zh: 赵兑烈呼吁中国在半岛问题上发挥建设性作用；王毅表示政策没有改变（综合）
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.body_zh: （北京、首尔＝韩联社）韩中阁特派记者金智宪报道＝外交部长赵显13日敦促中国在朝鲜半岛问题上发挥建设性作用。王毅表示，中国对朝鲜半岛的政策没有变化，并重申将持续为朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定发挥建设性作用。外交部表示，两国外长当日下午在北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行会谈并共进晚餐，历时3小时，就韩中关系、朝鲜半岛问题等双方共同关心的问题交换了意见。赵部长强调，朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定符合韩中两国的共同利益，并介绍了韩国政府为半岛无核化与和平实现所作的努力，同时敦促中国在朝鲜重返对话等半岛问题上发挥作用。王毅在回应时延续了近来未明确使用“无核化”表述的做法，但再次强调，中国既有的半岛无核化政策没有变化。王毅还表示，去年8月在首尔与赵部长举行外长会谈时曾提及，中国对半岛问题的立场具有连续性和稳定性。会谈中，赵部长表示，作为去年亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议主席国，韩国政府希望下周在宣城举行的APEC领导人会议取得圆满成功。他接着说，双方应做好充分准备，使两国领导人之间的交流成为推动韩中全面战略合作伙伴关系进一步成熟发展的重要契机。王毅评价，韩中关系的积极势头正从去年庆州延续至宣城，并表示欢迎李在明总统借APEC会议之机访问中国，将给予充分礼遇，确保此次访问取得成功。两位外长评价，通过去年和今年两国领导人相互进行国事访问所推动的韩中关系全面恢复趋势正在转化为具体成果，并就迎接明年建交35周年、持续为两国国民带来切实成果的多种方案进行了讨论。双方尤其同意，将通过推进韩中自由贸易协定（FTA）服务与投资谈判，进一步夯实两国平等、互利的经济合作基础，同时加强扩大两国国民之间的人员交流以及促进友好感情的努力。赵部长转达了韩国在黄海问题等议题上的原则立场，并敦促中国政府为保护在中国韩国国民的安全和权益而努力。外交部介绍，围绕这些议题，双方同意将审慎管控，避免其成为两国关系发展的障碍。会谈正式开始前，赵部长在全体发言中表示：“朝鲜半岛问题关系到韩国的切身利益，朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定符合两国共同利益。”“我们期待韩中两国继续加强战略沟通，为半岛局势取得进展作出贡献。”他接着说：“我们期待下周在宣城，两国领导人时隔10个月再次会晤，并以此为重要契机，推动韩中全面战略合作伙伴关系进一步成熟。”他还说：“希望从庆州开启的两位领导人之间的友谊与信任故事经由北京延续到宣城，同时期待韩中关系更加亲近。”赵部长评价，去年11月和今年1月两国领导人相互进行国事访问后，韩中关系全面恢复的趋势进一步巩固。他强调：“预计今年韩中人员交流将突破1000万人次，两国之间的贸易额也增长了40%以上。”“这是两国政府为落实两国领导人全面恢复关系的共同共识而紧密沟通、共同努力的结果。”赵部长补充说，希望通过此次会谈协商，推动下周两国领导人会晤取得成功。王毅在全体发言中评价：“去年底和今年初，习近平主席与李在明总统成功进行相互访问，推动中韩关系重回改善与发展的正确轨道。”他接着强调：“为筹备下一阶段的高层接触，必须做好充分准备。”“明年正值中韩建交35周年，两国应以此为契机共同努力，推动全面战略合作伙伴关系沿着正确轨道发展。”王毅预计，今年两国贸易额将创历史新高，人员往来也将恢复到每年1000万人左右的水平。他表示，包括李在明总统在内的多个成员国领导人已确定出席下周在宣城举行的APEC领导人会议，并评价韩国去年成功举办庆州APEC领导人会议。他表示：“既然韩中两国接连举办APEC会议，两国就应携手并进，共同推进建设亚太命运共同体，促进地区共同发展与繁荣。”王毅还高度评价韩国积极参与并助力中国筹备APEC会议，并期待宣城领导人会议为两国关系提供新动力。图片来源：KakaoTalk okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习和应用> 2026/11/13 23:47发稿 2026年11月13日23时47分发稿（北京＝韩联社）韩中阁特派记者＝13日下午，在中国北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行韩中外长会谈，外交部长赵显、中国外交部长王毅等人出席。2026.11.13.
